Overall, my experience at McCarran Airport was a mixed bag, but it leaned more towards the positive side. The efficient tram system and friendly TSA personnel made a big difference in my overall impression of the airport. I also appreciated the early announcements of gate changes, which helped to reduce stress and uncertainty. The availability of free Wi-Fi was a nice touch, and I was able to stay connected and productive while waiting for my flight.

However, the early closure of restaurants and food places was a major letdown, especially considering that Las Vegas is known for its 24/7 lifestyle. The long wait times at Terminal 3 security were also frustrating, and the lack of outlets and charging stations was a significant inconvenience. Despite these drawbacks, I would still recommend McCarran Airport to travelers, especially those who are familiar with the Vegas area. With a few tweaks to address the negative issues, McCarran could easily become one of the top airports in the country. For now, it's a solid choice, and I would give it 3.5 stars out of 5.

The prices were reasonable, and the portions were generous, which is always a plus. I appreciated that they included a few extra condiments and utensils with our order, which showed they were considerate of their customers' needs. However, I did think that the packaging could be improved - the containers were a bit flimsy, and the lids didn't fit very securely, which made me nervous about spills during transport.

Despite the minor issues, I was pleased with the overall experience, and I'm willing to give them another try. Perhaps dining in will be a different story, and I'll get to experience the full range of their menu and service. For now, I'd recommend them to others who are looking for decent Thai food, but not necessarily the best. If you're in the area and don't feel like cooking, they're a solid option. Just be prepared to pick up your order, and don't expect to be blown away by the flavor or presentation.

It's worth noting that I've had better Thai food at other restaurants, but this place has potential. With a few tweaks to their recipes and packaging, they could easily become a top contender in the area. For now, I'll keep them on my list of acceptable options, and I might even venture back to try some of their other dishes. After all, a good Masaman curry is hard to find, and I'm willing to forgive a few missteps for the sake of a satisfying meal.

As I reflected on our disastrous experience at the Sugar Factory, I couldn't help but think about the stark contrast between their establishment and the numerous other restaurants we visited during our trip. The lack of attention to detail, the unfriendly staff, and the overall disorganization were a far cry from the exceptional service and warm hospitality we encountered at other venues. It's astonishing that a restaurant with such a prime location on the strip could be so poorly managed.

The fact that we were left standing for an extended period, waiting for a table to be cleaned, was not only frustrating but also a clear indication of the restaurant's inadequate staffing and lack of priorities. The waiters' complaints and the manager's dismissive attitude only added to our disappointment. It's unacceptable for customers to be treated with such disrespect, especially when they're eager to spend their money and enjoy a meal.

What's even more surprising is that the Sugar Factory is a well-known brand with multiple locations, which makes their subpar service even more inexcusable. It's clear that they're relying on their reputation and location rather than focusing on providing a quality experience for their customers. Our experience was a stark reminder that even the most popular restaurants can fall short if they don't prioritize their customers' needs.

In contrast, our experience at Gordon Ramsay's Burgr restaurant was a breath of fresh air. The staff was friendly, attentive, and knowledgeable about the menu. The food was exceptional, and the atmosphere was lively and inviting. It's clear that the staff at Burgr takes pride in their work and is committed to providing an outstanding dining experience.

As we left the Sugar Factory and headed to Burgr, we couldn't help but feel relieved to have escaped the chaos and frustration. Our experience at the Sugar Factory was a hard lesson in the importance of prioritizing customer service and ensuring that every aspect of the dining experience is well-executed. Unfortunately, the Sugar Factory failed to deliver on both counts, and we would not recommend it to anyone. On the other hand, Gordon Ramsay's Burgr restaurant is a must-visit for anyone looking for a exceptional dining experience in Las Vegas.

Overall, the experience was mediocre. The patio ambiance was nice, but the slow service and average sushi made it not worth the price. With some improvements to their service and food preparation, this place could reach its full potential, but for now, it's just an okay option for sushi lovers.

I've been playing around with it nonstop since I got it, and I'm impressed by how seamlessly all the components work together. The Keyport light blade is a great addition, providing a convenient and compact light source that's perfect for navigating in the dark. I've also been experimenting with the different accessories available, and I'm excited to see what other possibilities there are for customization.

One of the things that really stands out to me is the build quality of the Keyport. It feels solid and well-made, and I have no concerns about it withstanding the wear and tear of daily use. The fact that it's so compact and lightweight is also a huge plus, making it easy to carry around without weighing me down.

I've already recommended the Keyport to several friends and family members, and I'm confident that they'll be just as impressed as I am. The combination of form and function is really unbeatable, and I think it's a game-changer for anyone who's tired of dealing with bulky keychains. Overall, I'm thoroughly satisfied with my purchase, and I'm excited to see how Keyport continues to innovate and improve their products in the future. With its unique design and exceptional customer service, I have no doubt that Keyport will remain a leader in the industry.

As I sat there, fuming at the manager's response, I couldn't help but think about the numerous other options available in the area that offer far superior quality and value. The fact that Café Zupas claims to be a healthy alternative to fast food is laughable, especially when they fail to provide even the most basic nutritional information. It's not only frustrating but also misleading to customers who are trying to make informed decisions about their diet.

The lack of transparency is just the beginning of the problems with this establishment. The food itself is subpar, with tiny portions and a clear lack of attention to detail in preparation. The chicken tortilla soup, which I was expecting to be a hearty and flavorful dish, was nothing more than a salty broth with a few pieces of tasteless chicken. And don't even get me started on the "gourmet" salad, which was essentially just a bowl of cheap iceberg lettuce with a few token toppings.

But what really takes the cake is the management's response to customer complaints. When I tried to speak with the manager, I was initially ignored, and when she finally did come over, she seemed more interested in following company policy than actually addressing my concerns. The fact that she refused to provide a refund, even after acknowledging the problems with my meal, is a clear indication that customer satisfaction is not a priority at Café Zupas.

In contrast, restaurants like Olive Garden and Sweet Tomatoes offer a far better experience for customers. Not only do they provide a wider variety of options, but they also offer unlimited soups and salads at a comparable price point. And, perhaps most importantly, they actually seem to care about their customers' experiences, with friendly and attentive staff who are eager to address any concerns.

In conclusion, my experience at Café Zupas was a disaster from start to finish. From the lack of nutritional information to the subpar food and poor management response, it's clear that this restaurant is not worth visiting. If you're looking for a healthy and affordable meal, there are far better options available. Save your time and money, and avoid Café Zupas at all costs. With so many other great restaurants in the area, it's hard to see how this place stays in business. Perhaps it's time for Café Zupas to reevaluate their priorities and focus on providing a better experience for their customers, rather than just trying to make a quick buck. Until then, I would strongly advise against visiting this overpriced and underwhelming establishment.

As we delved deeper into the menu, we discovered more innovative twists on classic dishes. The Buffalo Lollipops, which consisted of crispy fried chicken strips tossed in spicy buffalo sauce and served with a side of blue cheese dressing, were addictive and flavorful. The Doritos Mac-n-Cheese, a creative take on the comfort food classic, was creamy and indulgent, with a satisfying crunch from the crushed Doritos on top. 

We also tried the shoestring fries, which, as I mentioned earlier, were elevated to new heights by the ingenious combination of Sriracha and ketchup. It's amazing how such a simple condiment can completely transform a dish. The portions were generous, and the prices were reasonable, making it an excellent value for the quality and quantity of food.

The lively atmosphere, complete with loud music and interactive menu, made for a fun and casual dining experience. While the waitress may have been a bit aloof at times, her friendly demeanor when attending to our table made up for it. Overall, First Food is a great spot for those looking for a unique and enjoyable dining experience without breaking the bank. Be sure to try the Skittle martini flight and indulge in the creative twists on classic dishes – you won't be disappointed! With its quirky personality and delicious food, First Food has definitely earned a spot on our list of favorite restaurants to visit on the strip.
Fantastic flavors and generous portions make this spot a regular destination for me always highly recommended.

Overall, my experience was decent but not impressive, considering the high prices. The service was attentive, with the dim sum cart coming by frequently, but it didn't make up for the expense. The Thai tea was a highlight, but not enough to justify the cost. For the price, I expected more flavorful and authentic dim sum, but what I got was just average. Unless you're a hotel guest looking for convenience, I'd recommend exploring other dim sum options in the city for better value and quality. The Paris Hotel location is nice, but not worth the premium.

Overall, my staycation at Green Valley Ranch was a letdown due to the excessive resort fee and holds on my credit card. The lack of a coffee pot and complimentary coffee in the room was also a disappointment, feeling like a tactic to get me to spend more money at their cafe. The fact that they provide wine glasses but no coffee amenities seems like a misguided priority. Furthermore, the alleged theft of my expensive sunglasses from the room has left a bad taste in my mouth. The combination of these issues and the subsequent fraudulent activity on my credit card has made me wary of recommending Green Valley Ranch to others. Despite its beautiful grounds and amenities, the resort's policies and alleged security lapses have overshadowed my experience, making it unlikely that I will return or suggest it to friends and family.

The quality of their ingredients is consistently high, and their presentation is always visually appealing. I appreciate the attention to detail and the generous portions, making it a great value for the price. Highly recommend for sushi lovers like myself.

The service was friendly, but our server seemed overwhelmed with the number of tables she was managing. We had to ask multiple times for refills on our drinks. The atmosphere was modern and sleek, but the noise level made it difficult to carry on a conversation. Overall, our experience at Firebirds was disappointing, especially considering the high prices. For a steakhouse, the quality of the steak should be exceptional, but unfortunately, it fell short. We left feeling that there are better options available for a similar price point, and we wouldn't rush back to Firebirds anytime soon.

The lack of transparency and communication from the staff is appalling, and it's clear that their priority is making a quick buck rather than providing a positive experience for their customers. The fact that they would resell a table without notifying the occupants is not only rude, but it's also a blatant attempt to take advantage of unsuspecting patrons. The behavior of the security guards was completely unacceptable, and their aggressive posturing was a clear attempt to intimidate and silence us. It's shocking that a business would allow their staff to behave in such a manner, and it's even more disturbing that the promoter seemed to be either complicit or clueless. Overall, my experience at this establishment was a disaster, and I would strongly advise others to avoid it at all costs. The unprofessionalism, disrespect, and outright dishonesty of the staff make it a place to be avoided, and I hope that by sharing my story, I can prevent others from falling victim to their shady practices.

But despite that, the scenery is still lovely and perfect for a relaxing stroll. You can enjoy the views of the surrounding landscape and the lake, and take some great photos. The park is well-maintained, with clean walkways and plenty of trash cans. There are also benches and shaded areas where you can sit and take a break. If you're looking for a place to unwind and get some fresh air, Tempe Beach Park is a great option. Just remember to bring plenty of water and sunscreen, as the Arizona sun can be intense. Overall, I'd recommend Tempe Beach Park as a fun and casual spot to spend time with family and friends, or even just to enjoy some solo time outdoors. It's a unique spot in Arizona that's worth checking out.

The overall experience was a complete disaster, and the financial mishap was the cherry on top. It's clear that the staff is poorly trained and the management is lacking. The multiple taxes listed on the receipt are also a major red flag, raising concerns about the business's transparency and honesty. We demand a refund for the overcharged amount and expect a thorough explanation for the suspicious tax charges. Until then, we strongly advise others to avoid this place and take their business elsewhere to avoid similar frustrating experiences. One star is even too generous for this terrible establishment.
The staff seemed completely unbothered by the filthy conditions and rude service, making for a thoroughly unpleasant experience that I will not soon forget or recommend to anyone.

As I sat at Gordon Ramsay's restaurant, I couldn't help but feel a sense of disappointment and disillusionment. The entire experience was a letdown, from the subpar drinks to the overcooked and overly salty food. The atmosphere, which I'm sure was intended to be quirky and charming, came across as forced and cheesy. The hostess's attempt at creating a sense of drama and flair with her "leaving Paris and entering London" line fell flat, and the "art" she was referencing was, in my opinion, a mess.

The veal chops, which I was looking forward to, were a disaster. Not only were they overcooked, but the steak knife provided was barely able to cut through the tough meat. The waiter's excuse that the veal should have been cooked longer was laughable, and it only added to my frustration. The fact that every dish we ordered was salty to the point of being inedible was a clear indication of a lack of skill and attention to detail in the kitchen.

In contrast, my experience at Le Cirque the following night was a breath of fresh air. The food was expertly prepared, the service was top-notch, and the atmosphere was elegant and refined. It was a stark reminder of the difference between good food and bad, and it only served to highlight the shortcomings of Gordon Ramsay's restaurant. If you're looking for a truly exceptional dining experience, I would strongly advise against wasting your time and money at Gordon Ramsay's. Instead, opt for a restaurant that has a proven track record of serving high-quality, expertly prepared cuisine. In my opinion, French food is the way to go, and Le Cirque is a prime example of how it's done right.

For the rooms we stayed at the West Tower for spring break and got a serious rash from the water or bed, the water had serious chlorine in it. Just had a thin-ish blanket as the main blanket. Bed was really comfy though besides that. View was pretty good.

The food was alright drinks were not worth the money stayed away from the buffet because of the line, but thank god we didn't go there from the other reviews. Went the caesars palace for the buffet even though it was 30$/person it was worth it. The 24 hour deli was horrible, my sister got a chicken salad from there and it was just a big leaf with a scoop of pre-made chicken salad you put on sandwiches.

The whole place was filled with smoke, me and my sister got bloody snot from the second hand smoke, for a child's hotel went to all the others like the Mirage and Luxor and all those others it smelt way better and didn't have and barely any smoke.

The midway was just the same as the one in Reno but a little bigger and but had seats for the free act. I am surprised that people actually bring their little ones to this hotel/Las Vegas in General. This place was way understaffed, there was no room service and had water for $3.00 at the vending machine so, we just went to Walmart and got some big jugs of water for $1.00. The only pool was outside by the RV camps, there was no indoor one.

In summery its like the owner doesn't even care about their hotel/casino. Please just stay away from this and go to another one. Next time if we come back to LV we're just going to stay at the Mirage or one of the casinos that the monorail goes to.

Overall, our experience at this hotel was a major letdown, especially considering it's marketed as a family-friendly destination. The lack of attention to detail and prioritization of guest comfort was staggering. From the subpar food options to the overwhelming smoke and limited amenities, it's clear that this hotel is not invested in providing a quality experience for its guests. The fact that we had to seek out alternative options, such as dining at Caesars Palace and purchasing water from Walmart, speaks volumes about the hotel's inadequacies. Unless significant changes are made, I would strongly advise against staying here and recommend exploring other options in the Las Vegas area. With so many other excellent hotels and resorts to choose from, it's simply not worth settling for a subpar experience.

As I sat there enjoying my Blueberry Waffles, I couldn't help but feel a sense of disappointment with the service. It's understandable that mistakes can happen, especially during a busy lunch period, but the way our server handled the situation was less than ideal. When my dining companion politely informed the server about the mistake with the eggs, the server seemed put off and didn't apologize or offer to correct the issue. Instead, they just took the plate back and brought it out again, still with the eggs on it. This lack of attention to detail and concern for food allergies was alarming, and it's what ultimately led my dining companion to decide not to return to The Farm at South Mountain.

Despite the service issues, I was impressed with the quality of the food. The Blueberry Waffles were cooked to perfection, with a crispy exterior and a fluffy interior. The fresh blueberries on top added a burst of sweetness and flavor, and the whipped cream was the perfect finishing touch. The breakfast potatoes that came with my dining companion's American Breakfast were also delicious, with a nice balance of seasonings and a crispy texture. It's clear that the kitchen at The Farm at South Mountain is capable of producing high-quality dishes, but the front-of-house staff needs to step up their game to match.

The ambiance of the farm is definitely a major draw, and it's what initially attracted me to this restaurant. The organic farm, rose garden, and picnic tables create a charming and peaceful atmosphere that's perfect for a relaxing brunch or lunch. The shade trees provide a nice respite from the Arizona sun, and the overall vibe is one of casual elegance. It's a great place to come with friends or family, and the scenery is definitely Instagram-worthy.

As I finished my meal and prepared to leave, I couldn't help but feel a sense of mixed emotions. On the one hand, I was disappointed with the service and the mistakes that were made. On the other hand, I was impressed with the quality of the food and the ambiance of the farm. I think that with a few tweaks to their service and attention to detail, The Farm at South Mountain could be a truly exceptional dining experience. For now, I'm willing to give them another chance, and I hope that my next visit will be a more positive one. Perhaps if I come earlier in the day, they'll have more menu items available, and the service will be more attentive. Until then, I'll remain cautiously optimistic about this restaurant and its potential.

As you wander through the town, you'll notice the unique blend of natural beauty and small-town charm, making it an ideal destination for those seeking a relaxing getaway or a peaceful place to call home. The community comes together to host various events throughout the year, including concerts, festivals, and farmers' markets, which showcase the town's warm and welcoming spirit. With its rich cultural scene, excellent schools, and abundance of outdoor activities, Fountain Hills is a hidden gem that offers something for everyone. Whether you're an avid hiker, a foodie, or simply looking for a tranquil retreat, this desert oasis is sure to captivate your senses and leave you feeling refreshed and inspired. As the town continues to grow and evolve, it remains committed to preserving its natural beauty and small-town charm, making it a truly special place to visit or live. Overall, Fountain Hills is a must-visit destination for anyone looking to escape the hustle and bustle of city life and connect with nature, community, and themselves. With its perfect blend of relaxation, recreation, and cultural experiences, it's no wonder that Fountain Hills has become a beloved haven for visitors and residents alike.

The crust is perfectly cooked, crispy and flavorful, and the toppings are generously portioned. I'm hooked on their gluten-free option and can't wait to go back for more, it's a game-changer for those with dietary restrictions or just looking for a delicious twist.

The lack of accountability and poor customer service was appalling. We were really looking forward to trying this restaurant, but the combination of the unpleasant odor and the hostess's rudeness was a major turnoff. The fact that they lost our reservation and didn't even apologize or offer a solution was inexcusable. We ended up having a wonderful dinner across the street, which only made our experience at this restaurant even more disappointing. Needless to say, we will never be returning and would not recommend it to anyone. The rude service and unclean environment are major red flags that can't be ignored.

Needless to say, my experience was underwhelming. The atmosphere felt pretentious and overhyped. I left feeling ripped off and still hungry. For the prices they're charging, I expect top-notch quality and freshness, which RA clearly failed to deliver. Unless they revamp their menu and quality control, I'd advise others to take their sushi cravings (and wallets) elsewhere.

Unbelievable and unprofessional, leaving customers in the dark. No communication or refunds offered, a complete waste of time and money. Yelp should remove their listing to prevent further financial losses, it's irresponsible to promote a defunct business with fake deals.

Their inflexibility and lack of understanding is appalling, especially considering our excellent payment history. It's clear that their priority is collecting unnecessary fees rather than maintaining a positive relationship with tenants. The fact that they would penalize us for a circumstance beyond our control is unacceptable. I urge others to beware of their unfair practices and explore alternative rental options. With our experience coming to an end, I'm relieved to be leaving their management behind and warning others to avoid the hassle and frustration we've endured. Renters deserve better treatment and respect.

With those expectations in mind, our experience at Benihana in the LV Hilton was pleasantly surprising. The food was tasty and plentiful, with generous portions of steak, chicken, and seafood. Our chef's teppanyaki skills were impressive, and he even managed to engage our rowdy group with some fun tricks and banter. While the meal wasn't particularly sophisticated, it hit the spot after a long night of celebrating. The service was also friendly and attentive, despite the chaos of New Year's Eve. Overall, we left feeling satisfied and ready to take on the rest of the night. Given the circumstances, Benihana exceeded our expectations and provided a fun, memorable dining experience for our group.

Overall, I'd say Hawthorne's is a solid choice for a casual night out with family or friends, especially if you're looking for a relaxed atmosphere to catch a game. The staff is friendly and attentive, even when it's busy. The prices are reasonable, and the portions are generous. I've never had a bad experience at any of the locations, which speaks to the consistency they've managed to maintain across the board. If you're a fan of Italian food, or just looking for a dependable spot to grab a bite, Hawthorne's is definitely worth checking out. Just be prepared for a potential wait for parking, and consider arriving early if you want to secure a spot. With its kid-friendly atmosphere, delicious food, and convenient take-out options, Hawthorne's has become a go-to spot for me, and I'm sure I'll be back again soon. Whether you're in the mood for pizza, meatballs, or just some amazing garlic knots, Hawthorne's has got you covered.
The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, with a lovely Italian ambiance, making our dining experience truly enjoyable and memorable overall.

Overall, my experiences have been disappointing due to the poor service. Despite the tasty food and generous portions, the lack of hospitality and enthusiasm from the staff is off-putting. It's clear that they're not interested in providing a welcoming atmosphere, which is a shame. I've tried to give them the benefit of the doubt, but the consistent bad attitude is a major turn-off. Unless they work on improving their customer service, I wouldn't recommend this place to others, no matter how good the food may be. A friendly smile and prompt service can go a long way.

I was a bit concerned when they had to replace it, but they stood by their work and didn't charge me for the new part or the labor to install it. This kind of integrity and commitment to customer satisfaction is hard to find, and it's one of the reasons I've remained loyal to Thunderbird for so long. Over the years, I've referred numerous friends and family members to them, and every single one has had a positive experience. They're not just mechanics, they're trusted advisors who genuinely care about their customers and want to help them make informed decisions about their vehicles. Whether it's a routine oil change or a major repair, I know I can count on Thunderbird to do the job right and charge a fair price. In fact, I've often found that their prices are lower than other shops, even though they're using high-quality parts and performing the work with meticulous attention to detail. As my truck continues to age, I'm grateful to have Thunderbird in my corner, helping me keep it running smoothly and safely. If you're looking for a reliable, honest, and affordable mechanic, look no further than Thunderbird – you won't be disappointed! With their exceptional service and unwavering commitment to customer satisfaction, it's no wonder they've earned a loyal customer base, including mine, for so many years.

Overall, the experience was underwhelming and felt like a lazy attempt at comedy. The comedians' forced laughter and lack of originality made it feel like a stale routine. With a small audience, you'd think they'd try to engage and tailor their jokes, but it seemed like they were just going through the motions. The absence of tonic was a minor annoyance, but it added to the overall sense of disappointment. Unless they revamp their act, I'd advise others to skip this show and look for something more entertaining. Not worth the time or money.
The tacos and burritos were flavorful, with generous portions and affordable prices, making it an excellent choice for a casual, no-frills meal with friends or family, offering great value.

The service was also top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff. Our server checked in on us frequently, ensuring we had everything we needed. The atmosphere was lively and inviting, making for a great overall experience. With its extensive happy hour menu and excellent service, I'm already looking forward to my next visit. The combination of good food, great deals, and pleasant ambiance makes this place a must-try for anyone in the area.

The hotel's overall ambiance and amenities were subpar, making it a less-than-desirable choice for anyone seeking a comfortable stay. However, the attached casino did offer some affordable entertainment options, including low-stakes blackjack tables and live shows like Thunder from Down Under. The midway game center was also a unique feature, providing a fun distraction for both kids and adults. Despite these few redeeming qualities, I would still caution against staying here unless absolutely necessary. For a slightly higher price, there are far nicer hotels in the area that can provide a much more enjoyable and clean experience.

I've become a regular at Island Fresh and can confidently say that the quality of their dishes remains consistent. The Portuguese Sausage and eggs are always cooked to perfection, and the Spam Eggs and Rice is a unique twist on a classic comfort food. The Red Velvet Pancakes are a must-try, and the Cream Cheese Syrup is the perfect accompaniment. Although the wait time can be a drawback, the friendly staff and lively atmosphere make it worth the wait. I'm excited to try more of their menu items, especially the cookie butter French toast, which I've heard rave reviews about. Overall, Island Fresh is a hidden gem that serves delicious Hawaiian-inspired cuisine at an affordable price.

The flavors are bold and authentic, with each bite a delight. Service is friendly and attentive, making for a warm atmosphere. The generous portions and affordable prices make Pio Pio a standout. Overall, a fantastic dining experience that will keep me coming back for more of their delicious chicken and traditional sides, all at a remarkable value.

Moi c'est tout comme Camille L.!

Une fois de temps en temps, un peu de Bling-Bling ne vous tue pas. Bien au contraire, un peu de Bling-Bling peut beaucoup vous amuser! Et au Bellagio, c'est le carton plein assuré! Un chouette casino, un hotel kitschissime (mais j'ai encore fait pire à Vegas, je vous assure!), bref, de quoi réussir votre séjour.

Mais si vous voulez profiter du Bellagio sans payer, il existe une alternative: allez profiter du spectacle des fontaines à l'extérieur: les jeux d'eau des fontaines sur "Con Te Partiro", c'est quand même beau:).

Le spectacle des jeux d'eau est tous les quarts d'heure entre 20h et minuit.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=whqgVUuIN9M

J'ai personnellement adoré ce spectacle gratuit, c'est vraiment magique et romantique. Les lumières, les sons et les mouvements des fontaines sont parfaitement synchronisés, créant une expérience inoubliable. Je vous recommande vivement d'aller voir cela si vous êtes à Las Vegas, c'est un must-see !

I am extremely disappointed in the quality of work and the lack of attention to detail. As a customer, I expect a certain level of professionalism and care, especially when dealing with a high-end designer dress. The fact that the hem was uneven, the front was cut too short, and jewels fell off is unacceptable. To make matters worse, the dress was not ready on time, and now my daughter is stressed about wearing it to her formal dance on Saturday. I had chosen this alteration service because of its convenience, but the end result is a disaster. I will be seeking a refund or a significant discount for the poor workmanship and inconvenience caused. The owner needs to take responsibility for the mistakes made and ensure that their customers receive the quality of service they deserve. I would not recommend this alteration service to anyone, and I hope that they take steps to improve their work and customer satisfaction.

I'm extremely disappointed and frustrated with the service I received from this glass shop. The level of incompetence and carelessness is appalling. Not only did they damage my vehicle, but they also showed a complete lack of respect for my property. The fact that they used rubbing alcohol on my leather dash and damaged the paint job is unacceptable. The owner's response was unprofessional and unhelpful. I will be filing a claim and seeking compensation for the damages. I would not recommend this glass shop to anyone and will be taking my business elsewhere in the future.

The incompetence and lack of attention to detail at this location is staggering. As I mentioned, my daughter's happy meal was the only correct order, but that's where the positives end. The fact that they got two out of three orders wrong is unacceptable, especially when we were the only ones in the drive-thru line. It's not like they were busy and overwhelmed, they just simply didn't care.

The cashier's attitude was also appalling. When I pointed out the mistakes, she seemed completely unbothered and unapologetic. Her response to my questions about the straws and ketchup was dismissive and unhelpful. It's clear that she was not trained properly and was not interested in providing good customer service.

I'm extremely disappointed in the "Fast Service" that this location claims to provide. It's clear that they are more focused on getting customers in and out as quickly as possible, rather than ensuring that their orders are correct. The fact that they didn't even bother to include straws or ketchup with our order is just lazy.

As I said, I think it's time for us to take our business elsewhere. Tropical Smoothie is a great alternative that offers healthy options for both kids and adults. At least there, we can expect to receive our orders correctly and with a smile. I'll be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere, and I would advise others to do the same. This location needs to seriously revamp their customer service and attention to detail before they can expect to retain customers. Until then, I'll be enjoying my healthy smoothies and sandwiches at Tropical Smoothie.

The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, prices were reasonable, and portions were generous, making it an excellent choice for families and casual dining, leaving us already planning our next visit to try more of their delicious menu options.

As we finished our meal and prepared to leave, the gentleman and his wife came over to chat with us, inquiring about our experience and if everything met our expectations. Their genuine interest in our satisfaction was palpable, and we left feeling not only full, but also appreciated as customers. The prices were very reasonable, and the portions were generous, making it an excellent value for the quality and quantity of food received. What truly impressed me, however, was the personal touch and attention to detail that the owners brought to the table. It's clear that they take pride in their establishment and are dedicated to providing a welcoming atmosphere for their patrons. I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone seeking a delicious, no-frills Chinese meal served with a side of exceptional customer service. We will certainly be returning, and I'm excited to try more of their menu offerings. Overall, our experience was a resounding success, and I'm confident that this hidden gem will continue to thrive due to its outstanding service and satisfying cuisine. With its cozy ambiance and top-notch hospitality, this restaurant has earned a loyal customer in me, and I'm sure in many others as well.
despite the initial impression, the exceptional cuisine and attentive service that followed made for a memorable dining experience.

Overall, the charm and character of this family-owned restaurant make up for any inconsistencies in service. The food is consistently delicious, and the prices are very reasonable. I've tried several other Greek restaurants in the area, but none of them compare to this one. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, with traditional Greek music playing in the background. The owners are often present, greeting regulars and making sure everything runs smoothly. Despite the summer closure, which can be a bit inconvenient, I always look forward to returning to this restaurant. The gyro sandwich remains my go-to order, and I've even tried to replicate it at home, but it's just not the same. If you're in the area, I highly recommend giving this place a try – just be prepared for a possible wait, especially during peak hours.

I must note that my experience at this establishment was a mixed bag, with both positive and negative aspects. On the one hand, the therapist was indeed skilled and attentive, taking the time to work out the knots and kinks in my muscles. The rooms, as I mentioned earlier, were nicely decorated and had a calming ambiance, which helped to set the tone for a relaxing experience. However, the issues I encountered, such as the bright lighting and paper-thin walls, made it difficult for me to fully unwind and enjoy the treatment.

The lack of back work was a significant disappointment, as I have come to expect this as a standard part of a Thai massage or reflexology treatment. It's not just about the physical benefits, but also the mental and emotional relaxation that comes with a comprehensive treatment. I hope that the management will take my feedback to heart and consider revising their treatment protocol to include back work.

Despite these issues, I do think that this place has potential, and with a few tweaks, it could become a top-notch reflexology spot. For now, I would recommend it to those who are in the area and have no other options, but I would caution against making a special trip just to visit this establishment. Perhaps with some changes, I would be willing to give it another try and revise my opinion, but for now, it remains a mediocre experience in my book.

I completely agree with the sentiment that everyone leaves the Golden China with a big smile on their faces. The value for money is exceptional, and the portions are generous to say the least. We've tried a variety of dishes on the menu, and each one has been expertly prepared and presented. The crispy wontons are a must-try, with a delicate balance of crunch and flavor. The hot and sour soup is a personal favorite, with a depth of flavor that's hard to find elsewhere. The egg plant and tofu dish is another standout, with a perfect balance of textures and tastes.

One of the things that sets the Golden China apart from other Chinese restaurants is the genuine care and attention that Peter and Nancy bring to every aspect of the business. They're always willing to go the extra mile to ensure that customers are happy, and it shows in the food and the service. The restaurant itself is clean and well-maintained, with a warm and welcoming atmosphere that makes you feel like you're part of the family.

Whether you're in the mood for something familiar and comforting or wanting to try something new, the Golden China is a great choice. With its unbeatable prices, generous portions, and exceptional food, it's no wonder that this restaurant has become a favorite among locals and visitors alike. We'll definitely be back, and we can't wait to try more of the delicious dishes on the menu. If you haven't been to the Golden China yet, do yourself a favor and give it a try – you won't be disappointed!

The combination of the flaky crust and fresh strawberries was absolute perfection. I appreciated the attention to detail in the presentation, making it a delightful treat for the eyes as well. For the price, I was thoroughly impressed with the quality and flavor. It's definitely a must-try when visiting, and I'm already planning my next purchase. The strawberry tart has earned a spot as one of my favorite desserts.

I'm hooked on their unique flavors and generous portions. The staff is friendly and the shop is clean. I've tried several locations and the quality is consistent. Overall, I'm a fan and will continue to indulge in this delicious treat, guilt-free or not, it's a game-changer for this ice cream lover.

Great atmosphere and huge portions, fantastic value for the price, will definitely return when in the area again, highly recommend to anyone looking for a delicious breakfast spot with top-notch service.

The staff's hospitality makes up for the average food, creating a welcoming environment. Despite the culinary shortcomings, I continue to visit for the pleasant ambiance and friendly service, making it a decent spot to meet friends, albeit not my top choice for exceptional Italian cuisine, but a reliable option for casual gatherings.

Overall, my experience at this establishment was underwhelming, to say the least. The dark and stormy drink was a highlight, but everything else fell short of expectations. The burger and fries, which are typically staples of any restaurant, were unremarkable and failed to impress. But the real disappointment was the bread pudding dessert, which was not only cold and hard but also lacked any redeeming qualities. The caramel sauce attempted to salvage it, but it was too little, too late. 

The service was also subpar, with our waiter seeming put off by my honest feedback. His attempts to clear our plates and drinks before we were finished were not only annoying but also inconsiderate. It's understandable that mistakes can happen, but the lack of attention to detail and poor service made our experience even more disappointing. Given the plethora of dining options in uptown, I wouldn't go out of my way to recommend this place or return unless someone else suggests it. Perhaps with some improvements to their food and service, they can elevate their reputation and become a more desirable late-night eating option.
Consistently delicious, perfect blend of spices, and a cozy atmosphere to enjoy every single time always.

As I continued to explore the store, I noticed that the shelves were well-organized and fully stocked, even after the chaos of Black Friday. The employees were still friendly and helpful, despite the crowds and long hours they must have endured. I was impressed by the store's ability to maintain its high standards of cleanliness and customer service, even during the busiest shopping period of the year.

The store's layout is also worth mentioning. The aisles are wide and easy to navigate, making it simple to find what you're looking for. The signage is clear and concise, and the store's departments are well-defined. I particularly appreciated the dedicated section for electronics, which made it easy to compare different models and brands.

One thing that did strike me as odd was the lack of customers in certain areas of the store. While the electronics and toy sections were bustling with activity, other areas, such as the clothing and home goods sections, were relatively deserted. This could be due to the fact that the store is still relatively new and hasn't yet built up a loyal customer base.

Despite this, I was pleased to see that the store was still offering a wide range of products and services, including a pharmacy, optical center, and photo studio. The store's services are convenient and well-integrated, making it a one-stop shop for many of your everyday needs.

Overall, my experience at this Target store was overwhelmingly positive. The employees were friendly and helpful, the store was clean and well-organized, and the products were well-stocked and competitively priced. While the store may not be as busy as some of the other Targets in the area, it's clear that the management is committed to providing excellent customer service and a pleasant shopping experience. I would definitely recommend this store to anyone in the North Las Vegas area, and I look forward to seeing how it continues to grow and develop in the future.

I was extremely impressed with the quick turnaround and affordable prices at Bear Claw. The owner is very friendly and accommodating, making it a pleasure to do business with her. I have already recommended Bear Claw to my colleagues and will definitely be back for any future watch repair needs. The convenience of the location and the exceptional service make it the perfect spot for anyone in need of watch repairs. I appreciate the honesty and integrity of the owner, and I'm glad I found such a trustworthy and reliable watch repair service near my office.

Overall, my experience at this upscale restaurant was underwhelming, to say the least. Despite the beautiful ambiance and attentive service, the food fell far short of my expectations. The lack of creativity and flavor in the dishes, combined with the tiny portions, made it feel like a waste of money. I understand that Restaurant Week can be a challenging time for kitchens, but that's no excuse for serving subpar food. The fact that I left hungry and unsatisfied is a major red flag. While I appreciate the romantic atmosphere and the tender chicken, it's not enough to redeem the restaurant's shortcomings. Unless they revamp their menu and portion sizes, I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone looking for a satisfying fine dining experience. For now, I'll have to take my business (and my appetite) elsewhere. Perhaps with some tweaks to their culinary approach, they can live up to their upscale reputation, but until then, I'm disappointed and unimpressed.

The staff were friendly and attentive, making our stay even more enjoyable. Overall, Aria exceeded our expectations, offering a perfect blend of comfort, technology, and entertainment, making it our top choice for future visits to the city. We can't wait to come back and experience it all again.
Prices are reasonable, and the atmosphere is cozy, making it perfect for a romantic dinner or a night out with friends, leaving you feeling full and eager to return to this hidden gem.
"Always a fun atmosphere, with plenty of TVs for sports and outdoor seating area, making it perfect for any occasion, highly recommend."

Terrible customer service and ridiculously long wait times. The lack of attention and apology from the staff was appalling. For a place with such potential, it's disappointing to see it fall short due to poor management and inattentive waiters. Needless to say, our experience was a complete letdown.

The portion size was still generous, but the quality had taken a significant hit. Unfortunately, my experience was a perfect example of how a place can go downhill over time. With so many other great options available, it's hard to justify returning to a restaurant that no longer prioritizes the taste and freshness of its food. Unless they revamp their menu and cooking techniques, I would advise others to explore alternative dining options that can deliver both flavor and value without the negative aftermath. Overall, a disappointing end to a once-enjoyable experience.

Unfortunately, the loud music took away from our overall experience, as we had to strain to hear each other's conversations. Despite this, the quality of the food remained exceptional, and we were impressed by the consistency. Our chef friend was particularly enthusiastic about the unique flavor combinations and the presentation of the dishes. We ordered a variety of items, including the Korean BBQ tacos and the edamame, which were both delicious. The service was also friendly and attentive, although it was a bit slow due to the busy atmosphere. Overall, we would still highly recommend this hidden gem, but perhaps suggest that they consider keeping the music at a more reasonable volume to allow for easier conversation. With a few minor adjustments, this place has the potential to become a regular spot for us, and we're already looking forward to our next visit.

In conclusion, my experience at LYFE was a mixed bag. While I appreciate the effort to cater to diverse dietary needs, the execution fell short for me as a carnivore. The atmosphere was modern and sleek, which I liked, but the food didn't quite live up to my expectations. I think LYFE has a great concept, but it needs to work on refining its flavors and textures to appeal to a broader range of customers.

That being said, I do think LYFE has a lot to offer for vegetarians and vegans. The menu is creative and varied, with plenty of options to choose from. If I were to return, I would be interested in trying some of the vegetarian dishes to see if they fare better than the meat-based options. Perhaps a dish like the Lentil Soup or the Vegan Burger would be more impressive.

One thing that did stand out was the service, which was friendly and attentive. Our server was knowledgeable about the menu and made some good recommendations, even if the food didn't quite deliver. Overall, I think LYFE has potential, but it needs to work on perfecting its recipes and presentation to justify the prices. Until then, I'll stick to recommending it to my vegetarian friends and colleagues, but I won't be rushing back for a return visit anytime soon. With a bit of tweaking, however, LYFE could become a top destination for foodies of all dietary persuasions.

Overall, I'm thoroughly impressed with the quality and taste. The prices are reasonable, making it a great spot to satisfy my donut cravings. I'm already planning my next visit to try more flavors and share with colleagues, hoping they accept card payments for convenience. Highly recommend giving them a try for a delicious treat.

but perfect for a quick solo meal or with a friend. Prices are very reasonable, making it an excellent value for the amount of food you receive. Overall, I'd definitely return for another flavorful and filling bowl of pho, and I'd recommend it to anyone seeking a no-frills, authentic Vietnamese dining experience.

The staff is knowledgeable and explains everything clearly. They genuinely care about your well-being, making the experience even more enjoyable. I've seen significant improvements in my overall health since starting the wellness plan. The convenience, affordability, and excellent service make this place a gem, and I highly recommend it to anyone seeking quality chiropractic care without the hassle.

We sat "outside" which was - in all honesty - kind of fun! It's not everyday you don't have to worry about bugs or sunburns when dining on a patio.

Our server was definitely frazzled. He only came around once in a while. When he took our orders and someone asked about the cheese, he told them that it would be American cheese instead of Provolone on the Chicken Parmesan sandwich. What? No provolone?

Well, that changed almost every person's order at our table. It would have been helpful for him to have told us this when we first sat so we could at least take it into consideration. So, all but one of our party ordered a pizza.

The pizza was decent, definitely large enough for 2 people (possibly 3) to share. I was happy with it.

Better places to go in Vegas, though, especially for Italian. Overall, the experience was just average, and the lack of attention from our server made it feel a bit disappointing. With so many dining options available in Las Vegas, this place didn't stand out as a must-visit destination. Perhaps with better service and more attention to detail, it could have been a more enjoyable experience.

However, I must commend Red Robin for their effort in catering to plant-based diners. The veggie burger, although potentially frozen, was cooked well and the toppings were fresh. The freckled lemonade, as always, was a highlight of my visit. It's a unique and refreshing drink that I haven't found elsewhere. The service was also friendly and attentive, even if our waiter couldn't provide the information I was looking for about the veggie burger patty. Overall, while Red Robin may not be my first choice for a veggie burger, it's a decent option when I'm in the area and craving something familiar. I just hope they consider taking their veggie burger to the next level by offering a house-made patty. Until then, I'll stick to my indie favorites, but I won't rule out stopping by Red Robin for a drink and a decent meal.

Ich hoffe, dass bei unserem nächsten Besuch alles besser laufen wird und wir das griechische Essen genießen können, das wir erwartet haben. Die freundliche Bedienung und die gute Bewertung lassen darauf hoffen, dass es sich nur um einen schlechten Tag handelte. Es wäre schön, wenn das Restaurant einige der von mir genannten Punkte verbessern könnte, wie zum Beispiel die Einrichtung und die Konsistenz der Speisen. Ein paar kleine Änderungen könnten einen großen Unterschied machen und das Restaurant zu einem gemütlichen und leckeren Ziel für Familien und Freunde machen. Ich bin gespannt, ob wir bei unserem nächsten Besuch eine bessere Erfahrung machen werden und ob das Restaurant seine guten Bewertungen auch in Zukunft verdienen wird. Wir werden auf jeden Fall noch einmal geben und hoffen, dass das Essen und die Atmosphäre dann unseren Erwartungen entsprechen. Bis dahin bleiben wir optimistisch und hoffen auf eine positive Überraschung. Mit etwas mehr Liebe und Aufmerksamkeit zu Detail könnten sie leicht zu einem unserer Lieblingsrestaurants werden.

Overall, I've had a pleasant experience during my lunch visits. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, perfect for a girls' day out or a casual gathering. The staff is friendly and attentive, adding to the warm ambiance. Although the parking can be a challenge, it's worth the inconvenience for the delicious food and nice setting. I'm looking forward to trying their dinner specials and exploring more of their menu options. Perhaps I'll even convince myself to try their wine pairings, which seem like a great value. Definitely recommend for a laid-back lunch spot.

As I reflected on our experience, I couldn't help but think that this place had potential, but it seemed like they were still working out some kinks. The family pack we ordered was supposed to be a convenient and affordable option, but the forgotten salad and sides were a significant oversight. I understand that mistakes can happen, but it's how they're handled that matters. In this case, we didn't have the opportunity to address the issue with the staff since we had already left the premises.

The chicken, while flavorful, was a bit of a letdown due to its dryness and oily skin. I appreciate the effort to season it, but it would be great if they could find a way to keep it moist and infuse the flavor into the meat itself. Perhaps they could consider revising their cooking process or using a different technique to achieve a more tender and juicy result.

The sides, unfortunately, were a major disappointment. The coleslaw, while not bad, was unremarkable, and the red rice was a strange, cardboard-like flavor that didn't appeal to me. The mac and cheese was a catastrophe – it's a staple in the South, and to get it so wrong is a shame. I'm not sure what kind of cheese they used, but it was definitely not a traditional or appetizing variety.

Despite these issues, I do appreciate the variety on the menu, and I'm willing to give them another chance to showcase their skills. Maybe their other dishes, like the burgers or sandwiches, are more impressive. If I do return, I'll be sure to order something different and pay closer attention to the preparation and presentation.

It's also worth noting that the covered patio area is a lovely spot to enjoy a meal during warmer weather. The atmosphere is quiet and inviting, and it would be a great place to relax with family or friends. However, the food needs to be on par with the ambiance, and unfortunately, it fell short during our visit.

In conclusion, while our experience was disappointing, I'm not ready to write off this establishment just yet. With a bit more attention to detail, improved food quality, and better execution, they could potentially become a favorite among locals and visitors alike. Until then, I'll stick to my grocery store chicken and explore other options for satisfying my cravings. Cheers to hoping they'll take constructive feedback to heart and make the necessary adjustments to elevate their culinary game!

I was thoroughly impressed by the warm and inviting atmosphere of Chompies, and the service was top-notch. Our server was knowledgeable and attentive, making sure everyone in our large group had everything they needed. The portions were generous, to say the least, and I loved the variety of traditional dishes with a modern twist. The fried matzo balls and potato pancakes were definitely highlights, and I appreciated the creative topping options. I also enjoyed trying the Rugulach, which was similar to Baklava but with its own unique flavor profile. The fact that it comes in multiple flavors is a definite bonus. 

What really stood out to me, though, was the sense of community at Chompies. Meeting fellow Yelpers and hearing about their experiences was a great way to break the ice, and the staff seemed to genuinely care about ensuring everyone had a great time. Whether you're a longtime fan of Jewish deli cuisine or just looking to try something new, Chompies is definitely worth a visit. Just be sure to use the correct address, as the Google Maps listing can be a bit misleading. Thankfully, the deli is conveniently located behind the Chandler Mall, making it easy to find and access. Overall, I'm so glad I got to experience Chompies for the first time, and I'm already looking forward to my next visit!

As I sat at the bar, I couldn't help but notice the lack of enthusiasm from the staff. It seemed like they were just going through the motions, rather than genuinely trying to create a welcoming atmosphere for their customers. The barmaid who served me was friendly enough, but it took her a while to warm up, and even then, she seemed a bit detached. I understand that Mondays can be slow, but that's exactly when you'd think the staff would be more attentive and eager to make a good impression.

Despite the subpar service, I did appreciate the overall ambiance of the place. The dark color scheme and comfortable seating areas created a cozy and intimate atmosphere, perfect for a night out with friends or a date. The menu, as I mentioned earlier, looked promising, with a good variety of options to suit different tastes. The fact that they offer two kids' meals is also a plus, making it a potentially family-friendly destination.

The selection of scotches and whiskeys is indeed impressive, and I was happy to see some lesser-known brands on the list. This, combined with the Irish-inspired menu items, suggests that the owners have made an effort to create an authentic Irish pub experience. However, it's the little things, like a warm greeting and attentive service, that can make or break a customer's experience.

In conclusion, while I was pleased with the quality of the calamari and the overall atmosphere of the place, the lackluster service holds me back from giving it a glowing review. With a bit more attention to customer service and staff training, this could easily become a top destination for those looking for a great Irish pub experience. As it stands, I can only recommend it as an okay place to grab a drink and a bite to eat, but not necessarily a must-visit destination. Perhaps with time and a bit of tweaking, they'll be able to elevate their service to match the quality of their food and drinks.

The combination of disorganization and lack of expertise has left a sour taste in my mouth. I expect a dental office to be able to manage their appointments and procedures more efficiently. The fact that they were overbooked and unable to complete a relatively routine extraction is concerning. While the friendly staff is a plus, it's not enough to outweigh the incompetence and wasted resources. I hope that in the future, they will take steps to improve their scheduling and procedures to avoid putting other patients through the same frustrating experience that I had. Overall, I would advise others to explore alternative options.

The chef's creativity and attention to detail were evident in each course, from the delicate sushi to the rich, savory sauces. Every bite was a masterful balance of flavors and textures. The atmosphere was also noteworthy, with a cozy and intimate setting that added to the overall dining experience. The chef's tasting menu was definitely worth the price, and I appreciated the unique and personalized touches throughout the meal. Overall, I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for an exceptional Japanese dining experience – I'm already counting down the days until my next visit!

Overall, it was a fun experience with a lively atmosphere. The staff were friendly and attentive, despite the crowd. I'd return to watch another game, but might consider arriving earlier to secure a more comfortable seat. The unique souvenir cup was a nice touch, making the visit even more enjoyable.

The modern decor and dim lighting created a sophisticated ambiance, but the noise level was somewhat elevated due to the open layout. Our server was attentive and knowledgeable about the menu, making recommendations when asked. Despite the slow pace, the staff ensured our glasses were always full. While the food was tasty, the portions and prices didn't quite align, leaving us somewhat underwhelmed. Overall, it was a decent dining experience, but not impressive enough to warrant a return visit amidst other available options in the area. Perhaps a revisit could change my opinion.
The aquarium was clean and well-maintained with a variety of marine life on display for all to enjoy.

The lack of foot traffic and limited parking also detract from the experience. Despite its promising concept, the Chinese Culture Center feels like a missed opportunity. With more thoughtful planning and investment, it could have become a vibrant hub for the community. As it stands, the center's isolated location and underwhelming atmosphere make it a disappointment. I hope that in the future, efforts will be made to revitalize this space and create a truly thriving cultural destination that Phoenix can be proud of, but for now, it falls short of expectations and remains a letdown.

Maybe their other dishes are more impressive. The service was friendly, which made up for some of the shortcomings. Overall, it was an average experience, but the convenience and ambiance might bring us back to try again and hopefully be more impressed with their offerings.

Overall, my experiences have been inconsistent, but the exceptional bacon keeps me coming back. The service is generally friendly, although our server seemed a bit overwhelmed this morning. Despite the drawbacks, the atmosphere remains inviting, and I appreciate the ample natural light. However, to win me over, they need to refine their breakfast dishes, particularly the hash browns and pancakes. With some tweaks to their recipes and attention to detail, this establishment could become a top choice for breakfast in the area, especially with their outstanding bacon on the menu. I'll likely give them another try.

Overall, our experience at Mandalay Bay was underwhelming, to say the least. The hotel's attempts to create a luxurious atmosphere fell short, and the numerous missteps we encountered during our stay left a sour taste in our mouths. The room, as I mentioned earlier, was the highlight of our stay, but even that was not enough to make up for the other shortcomings. The lack of a proper closet was a significant inconvenience, and the small, temporary wardrobe they provided was woefully inadequate for our needs.

The closure of the Spa was a major disappointment, as it was one of the amenities we were looking forward to using during our stay. The pool area, which we had heard so much about, was overcrowded and noisy, with helicopters and planes constantly flying overhead. The chairs were uncomfortable and dirty, and the $12 Mohito was overpriced and took far too long to arrive. The poor service and lack of attention to detail were evident throughout our stay, from the poorly signed walkways to the pool to the inadequate seating and amenities.

Our experience at the Fleur De Lys restaurant was particularly disappointing. The false advertising of their happy hour specials was misleading and frustrating, and the limited selection of drinks and appetizers was not what we had expected. The fact that they only offered popcorn as a complimentary appetizer was almost laughable, and the two-for-one drinks special was not as enticing as it sounded, given the limited options. The $16 glass of wine was overpriced and did not even taste good, which was the final straw for us.

In comparison to other hotels on the Strip, Mandalay Bay fell short in many areas. We have stayed at the Encore before and had a much better experience, with a nicer room and better amenities. The room rate was even more competitive at the Encore, which made our decision to stay there instead of Mandalay Bay an easy one. Overall, while Mandalay Bay has its strengths, it needs to work on its weaknesses and improve its services and amenities to compete with other top-tier hotels in Las Vegas. Until then, we will be taking our business (and our wallets) elsewhere.
their unique flavors and freshly baked bread keep me coming back for more, it's a must-visit every time I'm in town, truly the gold standard of sandwich shops.
Disappointing experience overall, prices were reasonable but flavor and quality lacked, not worth a repeat visit for us, especially with other authentic options available in the area.

The quality of food was consistent, but the price point was steep for a morning meal. Considering the Wynn's upscale atmosphere, the buffet's cost was somewhat justified, yet it still felt excessive. Overall, it was a satisfying, albeit pricey, experience that met our expectations without exceeding them. Service was attentive and friendly.

As I reflected on my experience, I couldn't help but think that Applebee's has lost sight of what's truly important: serving quality food that leaves customers satisfied. The 2 for $20 special, which sounded like a great deal on paper, ended up being a letdown. The lack of attention to detail in the kitchen was apparent, from the hard and tasteless mozzarella sticks to the overcooked and dry chicken. It's disappointing to see a restaurant that was once a staple in many communities struggle to deliver on its promises.

I've had better experiences at other casual dining chains, where the food is consistently prepared with care and attention to detail. The contrast between Applebee's and its competitors is striking, and it's clear that they need to go back to the drawing board and re-evaluate their menu and cooking techniques. Perhaps it's time for them to focus on using fresh, high-quality ingredients and simplifying their menu to allow for more attention to detail in the kitchen.

Until then, I'll be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere. To anyone considering trying Applebee's, I would caution against it, at least until they revamp their menu and cooking techniques. And to myself, I say: remember the lesson learned from this experience, and don't be tempted to give Applebee's another chance anytime soon. Two strikes are enough, and it's time to move on to greener pastures.

As we savored our meal, the impeccable service and attention to detail only added to the enchanting atmosphere. Our server was knowledgeable and attentive, happily answering our questions about the menu and making excellent recommendations. The lamb chops were cooked to perfection, and the wine pairing was spot on. The portions were generous, and we left feeling satisfied but not overly stuffed. The real magic happened as the sun set, and the golf course transformed into a picturesque landscape with twinkling lights and the soothing sound of the waterfall. It was truly a night to remember, and I couldn't wait to return with someone special. The high price point was well worth it for the unforgettable experience, and I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking to impress or celebrate a special occasion in style.

I'm disappointed to see the decline in their tofu soup, as it was once a staple for me. However, their bimbimbap remains a highlight, with the combination of tender beef, fresh vegetables, and a perfectly cooked egg creating a flavorful and satisfying dish. The sizzling pot presentation adds to the experience, making it a must-try for anyone visiting Chodang. Despite the drop in quality of their other dishes, I'll continue to return for their exceptional bimbimbap, which remains unparalleled in the east valley. It's a shame the rest of their menu doesn't live up to this standard.

Overall, I was disappointed with the outdated decor and lack of maintenance. The staff was friendly, but it wasn't enough to make up for the hotel's shortcomings. For the price, I expected more amenities and a cleaner environment. The location on the strip was convenient, but I wouldn't recommend Luxor to others unless they renovate and update their facilities. With so many other options available in Las Vegas, I would explore alternative hotels for my next stay. Luxor has potential, but it needs significant improvements.
Always leave full and satisfied, the staff is friendly, and the atmosphere is casual and inviting, making it a great spot for families and casual dining.

The atmosphere was lively and modern, with an open layout that added to its charm. Our server was attentive and knowledgeable, happily answering questions about the menu and drinks. The prices were reasonable, especially considering the generous portion sizes. Overall, I'm excited to come back and try more of their offerings, especially the mango cream ale, which has already become a new favorite of mine.

I'm extremely disappointed in the way this hospital prioritizes profits over pet care. The lack of transparency and cooperation in providing my pup's prescription was appalling. It's unacceptable that they would intentionally delay and make it difficult for me to obtain a copy of the prescription, simply because I found a more affordable option elsewhere. The fact that the director openly admitted to being in the business of selling medications, in addition to providing veterinary services, speaks volumes about their true motives. As a pet owner, it's heartbreaking to see a hospital that is supposed to prioritize the well-being of animals instead focusing on making a quick buck. I would not recommend this hospital to anyone and will be taking my business (and my pup) elsewhere. The memory of their relentless up-selling and medication costs will stay with me, and I hope that others will learn from my experience and avoid this hospital at all costs.

Overall, it's a solid choice for a casual Italian meal. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, adding to the authentic experience. While the food didn't exceed expectations, it was satisfying and reasonably priced. I'm looking forward to exploring more of their menu on my next visit, hopefully with improved service speed.

I am extremely disappointed and frustrated with the level of service I've received from the dealership. As a customer who has invested a significant amount of money in a luxury vehicle, I expect a certain level of quality and support. Instead, I've been met with incompetence and a lack of accountability. The fact that I had to educate the service department about the known issues with the cameras is appalling. It's clear that they are not taking my concerns seriously and are more interested in making a sale than providing adequate after-sales support. The blocking of my posts on their Facebook page is also a disturbing attempt to silence a dissatisfied customer. I would not recommend this dealership to anyone and would advise others to think twice before purchasing a Range Rover, especially a used one with known issues. The hassle and stress I've experienced are not worth the luxury badge. I expect a resolution to this issue soon, but my confidence in the brand and the dealership has been severely shaken.
"Definitely a unique vibe, fun atmosphere, and outdoor seating area makes it a great spot to unwind and enjoy live music with friends on a warm evening."

I'll make this simple...

Pros: BEAUTIFUL hotel. We stayed in the wrap around balcony suite in the east towers over looking the Bellagio water show. It was gorgeous. Extremely deep bathtub, great showers, COMFY bed situation, and the technology in the room (especially all that you can access just from the TV) was off the chain.
Their pool area on the 4th floor was equally gorgeous. Cabanas were very relaxing.
Room service breakfast was really good although, FYI, they injecting something in them pancakes because they were Jurassic!
Valet service was VERY quick. We never had to wait to long for our car.

CONS: Customer service fail! They've got a lot of work to do. We were told because of our VIP Gold card status, our drinks would be comped at the bars in the hotel. NONE of the bartenders new what the hell we were talking about. Every time we tried to do it a manager (who wasn't around) has to be called. It ended up being too much of a hassle each time so we just said forget it. We even went to the designated VIP lounge and they had not been informed.

We ordered a roll away bed and some more towels at 1am, went to Drais after hour spot, came back to the room at 7am (we went hard) and no one had even been there. Called two more times and still no one brought anything. Wasn't until we called angry about it that we finally got a "oh the order wasn't entered correctly (all three times???) excuse.

Another issue: As I said, we spent a lot of money at this hotel, one of their most expensive suites, poker tourney, VIP status. The problem is VIP means not a damn thing at this hotel. There are no perks! We decided to go to Marque, the club inside the hotel, because they had a hip hop room and we weren't about the house music. We had 3 girls and 4 guys. Everyone dressed lovely. We get there, flash the VIP cards and the bouncer tells us the guy to girl ratio is too low. We need one more girl....I'm not even going to discuss this further. All I'm going to say is, I'm VIP in your hotel and I can't get in your club because I'm short one damn female???

They've only been open about a month. They have a lot of work to do. They need to take better care of their VIP guests. If you're trying to do Vegas VIP...this ain't the place.

We've stayed at other hotels VIP and I have to say Encore has been the best as far as perks/customer service goes.

That is all.

In conclusion, our stay at this hotel was a mixed bag. On one hand, the hotel's physical attributes, such as the room and pool area, were top-notch. However, the customer service and VIP experience were severely lacking. As a VIP guest, I expect a certain level of treatment and perks, which this hotel failed to deliver. The lack of communication and organization among the staff was evident, and it's clear that they have a lot of work to do to improve their services.

I would recommend this hotel to those who are looking for a beautiful and comfortable place to stay, but not to those who are expecting a true VIP experience. If you're looking to splurge and be treated like a high-roller, I would suggest looking elsewhere. Perhaps with time and experience, this hotel will be able to iron out its issues and provide the level of service that its VIP guests deserve.

For now, I would give this hotel 3 out of 5 stars. The hotel's physical attributes and amenities are definitely worthy of 5 stars, but the poor customer service and VIP experience bring the rating down. I hope that the hotel will take our feedback to heart and make the necessary improvements to provide a better experience for their guests in the future. 

It's worth noting that the hotel's location is also a major plus, with many popular attractions and amenities within walking distance. However, this is not enough to make up for the hotel's shortcomings in terms of customer service and VIP experience. Overall, I would say that this hotel has a lot of potential, but it needs to work on its weaknesses in order to provide a truly exceptional experience for its guests. 

Ultimately, whether or not to stay at this hotel depends on your individual priorities and expectations. If you're looking for a beautiful and comfortable place to stay, and don't mind dealing with some potential issues with customer service, then this hotel may be a good choice. However, if you're expecting a true VIP experience with top-notch service and perks, you may want to consider looking elsewhere.
with much better selection and more competitive pricing, making these locations not worth the visit or investment for serious buyers or collectors.

The combination of flavors and textures was absolute perfection. The pistachio gelato was creamy and rich, while the mini cheesecake was a delightful balance of tangy and sweet. The service was also top-notch, with friendly staff and a beautiful display of pastries. If you're a dessert lover like me, Jean Philippe Patisserie is an absolute must-visit when in Las Vegas. I'm already planning my next visit to try more of their heavenly treats!

I can see why Serendipity 3 is a popular spot, especially among tourists and those with a sweet tooth. The atmosphere is definitely unique and Instagram-worthy, with its whimsical decor and colorful accents. The staff was friendly and attentive, which added to the overall experience. However, as I mentioned earlier, the food was nothing special, and I wouldn't go out of my way to try it again. The frozen hot chocolate, on the other hand, was a highlight, and I can see why it's their signature item. If you're in the area and looking for a cool treat to beat the heat, Serendipity 3 is worth stopping by. Just don't expect to be blown away by the food, and be prepared for a potentially long wait, especially during peak hours.
