Overall, it's a fun and quirky spot that's worth visiting at least once, if only for the frozen hot chocolate and the 'gram.

I'm still dreaming about the endless options and the quality of the food. The atmosphere was lively and bustling, with a wide range of patrons from families to couples and solo travelers. The remodel has definitely paid off, as the modern decor and ample seating made for a comfortable dining experience. Our server was friendly and efficient, ensuring that our drinks were always full and clearing our plates promptly.

One of the standout features of this buffet was the variety of options. From the seafood station to the carving station, and from the salad bar to the dessert table, there was something for everyone. I was impressed by the attention to detail and the obvious care that the chefs took in preparing each dish. The fact that they could maintain such high quality with such a vast array of options is a testament to their skill and dedication.

If I were to offer any criticism, it would be that the buffet can get quite crowded, especially on weekends or during peak travel seasons. However, the staff does an excellent job of managing the flow of traffic and ensuring that everyone has a chance to try all of the delicious options. Overall, I would highly recommend this buffet to anyone visiting Vegas, whether you're a foodie or just looking for a unique dining experience. Be prepared to come hungry and leave satisfied – and don't be surprised if you find yourself planning your next visit before you've even left the building!

Unfortunately, my experiences at Buck & Badger have fallen short of my expectations. The atmosphere, although cozy and inviting, is not enough to make up for the subpar food and slow service. I was really looking forward to having a go-to spot near my workplace, but the prices and portion sizes are just not justified by the quality of the dishes. The fact that I have to pay extra for a side of fries with my already overpriced grilled cheese is just disappointing. I've tried to give them the benefit of the doubt, visiting twice and trying different menu items, but sadly, I won't be returning. With so many other great options in the area, I just can't see myself choosing Buck & Badger again. It's a shame, really, because I think they have potential, but until they revamp their menu and pricing, I'll have to take my business (and my book-reading, fire-enjoying self) elsewhere.

Overall, our experience was disappointing. The lack of beef and peppers in the Kung Pao dishes was noticeable. Although the service was satisfactory, finding a hair in my soup was unsettling. We left unimpressed, still searching for a Chinese restaurant in Vegas that matches the quality of Yu's in Schaumburg, IL, our gold standard for Chinese cuisine.
The staff is friendly, and the atmosphere is cozy and clean, making it a great spot to grab a quick bite or meet with friends, with plenty of seating and free Wi-Fi available.

The overall ambiance was completely uninviting and lacked any semblance of cleanliness. It's clear that the establishment is not prioritizing the customer's experience or health. The fact that they can serve such a subpar product and still manage to keep their doors open is astonishing. As I looked around, I noticed that the decor was outdated and worn out, which added to the overall sense of neglect. The dirty mirrors, unclean tables, and overflowing trash cans created an unpleasant atmosphere that made me question the hygiene standards of the kitchen. Needless to say, my disappointing experience with the pizza was only exacerbated by the unappealing surroundings. I would not recommend this place to anyone and will definitely be taking my business (and my pizza cravings) elsewhere. The memory of that soggy, cheese-less slice will stay with me as a cautionary tale.

Completely unimpressed and disappointed, the lack of attention and care was staggering, especially for a supposed luxury dining experience that utterly failed to deliver on its promises and hefty price tag.

As I reflected on our visit, I realized that maybe we just caught them on an off day. The staff was attentive and apologetic when I mentioned that our pizzas were a bit lacking in toppings, so I'm willing to give them the benefit of the doubt. Perhaps it was just a miscommunication in the kitchen or a new chef still getting familiar with the menu. I do appreciate the effort they put into sourcing high-quality, organic ingredients, and I'm more than happy to support that mission.

I'm also excited to try some of their other menu items, such as their salads and sandwiches, which looked fresh and appealing. The vegan options, in particular, seemed intriguing, and I'd love to explore those further. It's great to see a restaurant catering to various dietary needs and preferences, and I appreciate the attention to detail in that regard.

Before visiting again, I might check their social media or website to see if they've made any changes to their menu or cooking techniques. It's possible that they've taken customer feedback on board and made some adjustments to improve the overall dining experience. I'm looking forward to giving them another chance to impress me with their flavors and execution.

In the meantime, I'd recommend this place to fellow health-conscious foodies who prioritize organic ingredients and sustainable practices. While the pizza may not have blown me away, the restaurant's commitment to using locally sourced produce and natural ingredients is admirable, and I appreciate the transparency about their sourcing. With a bit of tweaking in the kitchen, I have no doubt that this place could become a staple in our household. For now, I'll remain optimistic and hope that my next visit will be a more memorable one.
Overall, it was a decent experience, with convenient options, although the high prices and limited choices were notable drawbacks during my extended stay.

As I sat back to reflect on the meal, I couldn't help but feel grateful for the recommendation from my date. The combination of flavors and textures in each dish was truly impressive, and I appreciated the attention to detail that the chef brought to every aspect of the meal. The summer rolls, with their delicate wrapping and fresh vegetables, were a perfect start to the evening, and the house curry with tofu was a masterclass in balancing spices and flavors.

I also appreciated the flexibility of the menu, which allowed me to customize the level of spiciness to my liking. The option to choose from a range of spice levels, from mild to extremely hot, was a nice touch, and I liked that the server was knowledgeable about the different options and could make recommendations.

As we finished our meal and prepared to leave, I took a moment to look around the restaurant and appreciate its cozy atmosphere. The decor, while not fancy, was warm and inviting, and the small size of the restaurant made it feel intimate and welcoming. I could see why my date had enjoyed it so much on their previous visit, and I was already looking forward to returning.

One thing that might be helpful to note for future visitors is that the restaurant can be a bit tricky to find, especially if you're relying on Google Maps. As I mentioned earlier, the restaurant's name is similar to that of a city in Thailand, which can cause some confusion. But don't let that deter you - the restaurant is well worth seeking out, and the food and service are sure to make it a memorable experience.

Overall, I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for delicious and authentic Thai cuisine. The combination of flavorful dishes, attentive service, and cozy atmosphere make it a must-visit destination for foodies and anyone looking for a great dining experience. I'm already planning my next visit, and I'm excited to try more of the menu items and see what other surprises the chef has in store.

Overall, the experience was pleasant, but not particularly memorable. The atmosphere was lively and festive, with a vibrant decor that added to the ambiance. However, the noise level was a bit high, making it difficult to carry on conversations at times. Despite the minor issues with service and my personal preference for milder flavors, our group enjoyed their meals and left feeling satisfied. The prices were reasonable, especially considering the generous portions and strong drinks. While I wouldn't go out of my way to recommend this place, I also wouldn't discourage anyone from trying it. If you're a fan of spicy Mexican food and a lively atmosphere, you might really enjoy it. For me, though, it's just an okay option – not my favorite, but not bad either.

The staff is always friendly and welcoming to both us and our dogs. They have a great selection of beers and the food is delicious. The outdoor seating area is perfect for warm days, and the kiddie pools are a wonderful touch for hot summer afternoons. Our dogs always have a blast running around and socializing with the other dogs. We've met some great people here too, all with a shared love of dogs. Overall, it's a fantastic spot that we highly recommend to anyone who loves dogs and a fun, relaxed atmosphere.

The atmosphere was casual and inviting, with a cozy patio area perfect for warmer days. Our server was friendly and attentive, making sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal. The prices were very reasonable, especially considering the high quality of the ingredients and the generous portion sizes. Overall, I was thoroughly impressed with my experience and would definitely return for another delicious burger and side of fries. The fact that they source local beers, like the Big Sky I.P.A., is also a big plus in my book. I'm already looking forward to my next visit and trying more of their menu items.

The overall experience was top-notch, exceeding my expectations. Nic's professionalism and kindness made a significant difference, making me feel valued as a customer. I highly recommend this business for its outstanding service and amenities, a truly exceptional experience from start to finish, definitely a repeat customer.

Despite the high prices, the convenience and extended hours make it a viable option. The store's cleanliness and friendly staff are also positives. However, I wish they would reconsider their pricing strategy to make their products more competitive with other local stores and gas stations that offer similar items at lower costs.

Overall, our experience was average, and we left feeling somewhat disappointed. The location on the strip was convenient, but the high prices didn't match the quality of food we received. The shrimp and hamburger were cooked well, but lacked any distinctive flavors or presentation. For a bill of $57, we expected more than just okay food. The suggested tip on the check was also a turn-off, making us feel like the waiter was being too pushy. Despite the nice décor and quick seating, the overall experience was not worth the price, and we likely won't be returning anytime soon.

As we walked out, I couldn't help but feel a sense of disappointment and frustration. The owner's attempt to justify the delay by comparing the number of tables they had the previous Friday to the current day was not only unprofessional but also irrelevant. It's not about the number of tables, it's about being prepared and having a system in place to manage the demand. The fact that they couldn't even get our order of omelets right, which is a relatively simple dish, is a clear indication of the kitchen's incompetence.

The patio area where we were seated was nice, but it was clear that the ambiance was not enough to make up for the subpar service. The waitress, although apologetic, seemed overwhelmed and unsure of how to handle the situation. The owner's decision to comp our meal was too little, too late, and it didn't make up for the hour of our time that we wasted waiting.

What's even more concerning is that this experience is not an isolated incident. As we were leaving, we noticed a few other tables that had been waiting for a long time, and the looks on their faces were equally disappointed. It's clear that this restaurant has a systemic problem that needs to be addressed.

As someone who has worked in the restaurant industry for many years, I understand that mistakes can happen, and it's how you recover from them that matters. However, in this case, the owner's lack of customer service skills and inability to manage the kitchen effectively is a recipe for disaster. It's not just about the food; it's about the experience, and this restaurant failed miserably.

I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone, and I would advise the owner to take a long, hard look at their operations and make some serious changes. Hiring more staff, improving kitchen efficiency, and providing customer service training are just a few things that could help turn this restaurant around. Until then, I would suggest that potential customers steer clear of this establishment and take their business elsewhere.

In conclusion, our experience at this restaurant was a disaster from start to finish. The long wait times, incompetent kitchen, and lack of customer service made for a frustrating and disappointing experience. The owner's inability to manage the restaurant effectively and provide a good experience for customers is a major concern, and it's clear that this restaurant needs a lot of work before it can be considered a viable option for diners.

The lackluster experience was further amplified by the underwhelming flavors and textures of the cheesesteak itself. The steak slices were overcooked and dry, the provolone cheese was barely melted, and the onions and green peppers were sparse and lacked any real crunch or freshness. For a place that specializes in cheesesteaks, I expected a much more satisfying and filling meal. Unfortunately, PSC failed to deliver on its promise of a authentic Philly-style cheesesteak experience. While I can appreciate the convenience of its location and the potential appeal to late-night revelers, it's not enough to warrant a return visit from me. Perhaps I just caught them on a bad day, but based on my initial impression, I wouldn't recommend PSC to anyone seeking a truly great cheesesteak.

I was shocked and disappointed by Dr. Chuang's sudden decision, especially since we had been loyal patients and always fulfilled our financial obligations. The fact that she prioritized her own interests over our healthcare needs is alarming. Her refusal to accommodate our insurance, despite our willingness to pay upfront, raises concerns about her commitment to patient care. As a result, I would caution others against establishing a relationship with Dr. Chuang, only to risk being dismissed arbitrarily. Trust and reliability are essential in a doctor-patient relationship, and Dr. Chuang has demonstrated that she is not a dependable healthcare provider. I will be taking my business elsewhere and advising friends and family to do the same.

The overall experience was underwhelming and overpriced. I left feeling disappointed and ripped off. For a local establishment, I expected more authenticity and care in their dishes. Unfortunately, this place failed to deliver on even the simplest of Chinese takeout expectations, leaving a bad taste in my mouth, literally and figuratively.

As I reflect on our visit, I can see why this place has garnered such a loyal following. The atmosphere is lively and inviting, with a nostalgic charm that's hard to resist. The old-school decor and vintage sodas add to the retro vibe, making it a great spot to grab a bite with friends or a casual date.

One thing that impressed me was the attention to detail in the presentation of the dishes. The sandwiches were carefully crafted, with each ingredient visible and adding to the overall visual appeal. The PBB&J, in particular, was a feast for the eyes, with the vibrant red pepper jelly and fresh rosemary sprigs adding pops of color to the plate.

While I appreciated the creativity and richness of the Foie& sandwich, I couldn't help but feel that it was a bit overwhelming. The sheer amount of foie gras and pate was almost too much to handle, and I found myself craving something to cut through the richness. Perhaps a side of pickles or a simple green salad would have provided a welcome contrast to the indulgent sandwich.

Despite the minor quibbles, I was impressed by the quality of the ingredients and the care that went into preparing each dish. The bread, in particular, was exceptional – soft and fluffy on the inside, with a crispy crust that added texture to each bite.

As we finished our meal and prepared to leave, I couldn't help but feel that this place has a lot of potential. With a few tweaks to the menu and some additional options to balance out the richness of the sandwiches, I could see myself becoming a regular here. For now, I'm looking forward to returning and trying some of the other menu items that caught my eye – the Span-ish and falafel, in particular, seem like great options for a lighter, more balanced meal. Overall, I'd recommend this place to anyone looking for a unique dining experience and a taste of something new and exciting. Just be sure to come hungry, as the portions are generous and the flavors are bold!

The quality of their food is also subpar, with dry meat and stale tortillas. It's clear they're prioritizing profits over customer satisfaction. The watered-down sour cream and sparse sauce servings are just the tip of the iceberg. With so many other affordable and delicious options available, it's not worth settling for this lackluster Taco Bell experience. Save your money and appetite for a better meal elsewhere.

The overall atmosphere has significantly deteriorated. It's disappointing to see a once-thriving spot succumb to greed and neglect. The influx of low-quality products and questionable business practices has driven away loyal vendors and customers alike. The lack of maintenance is evident, with dirty carpets and a general sense of disarray. It's a shame to see this place fall so far from its former charm, now prioritizing quick profits over community and quality.

I was thoroughly impressed with the level of service provided by Lanza AV, and Scott's expertise was evident from the moment he arrived. His ability to quickly diagnose the issue with my tuner and provide a clear explanation of the problem and the available solutions was incredibly helpful. I appreciated that he didn't try to push me into buying a new tuner, but rather presented me with all the options and allowed me to make an informed decision. The installation process was seamless, and Scott's attention to detail was impressive. He made sure that everything was working properly and that I was comfortable using the system before he left. The follow-up call from the office a few days later was a nice touch, and it's clear that Lanza AV is committed to providing excellent customer service. I've already recommended them to friends and family, and I would definitely use their services again in the future. Overall, I'm extremely satisfied with the experience and would highly recommend Lanza AV to anyone in need of home theater system installation or repair. Scott's professionalism, expertise, and friendly demeanor made the entire process a pleasure, and I'm grateful to have found such a reliable and trustworthy company.

I'm missing the personalized care and attention to detail that Dr. Tran and her team provided. The new dentist I've switched to just can't compare to the exceptional service I received at Dr. Tran's office. From the initial warm welcome to the thorough explanations of each procedure, every aspect of my experience was top-notch. The eco-friendly and modern facilities were just the icing on the cake. I appreciated the little touches, such as being able to watch my favorite TV show on the flat screen while getting my teeth cleaned. Dr. Tran's expertise and gentle touch made even the most dreaded procedures, like getting shots, a breeze. If I'm being completely honest, I'm already considering making the commute back to Dr. Tran's office just to get the quality care I've grown accustomed to. My only regret is not appreciating it enough while I was still a patient there.

The atmosphere is always cozy and welcoming, making it a great spot to catch up with friends or get some work done. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, happy to recommend drinks or games to play. I've tried a variety of their coffee drinks and they're all delicious, made with care and attention to detail. The community events they host are also a great way to meet new people and feel connected to the neighborhood. Overall, I'm so grateful to have this coffee shop in my community and I'm excited to see the new location thrive.

The lack of attention and disorganization was appalling. We watched as other tables received their meals and finished their dining experience while we still waited. The fact that our order was misplaced and hadn't even been started after 25 minutes is unacceptable. The waitress seemed frazzled and unapologetic, which added to our frustration. We left hungry and extremely disappointed, vowing never to return. With so many other excellent sushi options available, it's clear that this establishment needs to revamp its service and management to retain customers. Until then, I strongly advise others to dine elsewhere.

As I reflect on my disastrous experience at this establishment, I am still fuming about the utter disregard for customer satisfaction. It's astonishing how a restaurant can get so many things wrong, from the subpar food to the abysmal service. The fact that they managed to botch even the simplest of orders, like the bottomless chips and salsa, is a testament to their incompetence.

The atmosphere of the restaurant was also lacking, with a attempts to create a festive Mexican vibe falling flat. The decor was clichéd and unoriginal, with sombreros and piñatas scattered about in a half-hearted attempt to create a lively ambiance. But with the surly staff and mediocre food, it was impossible to shake off the feeling of disappointment and frustration.

What's even more disturbing is the blatant disregard for customer feedback. When I politely brought my concerns to the waitress's attention, I was met with eye-rolling, sighs, and a general attitude of indifference. It's clear that the staff is not trained to handle even the most basic of customer complaints, and instead resort to being rude and dismissive.

The food, as I mentioned earlier, was nothing special. The quesadilla, which I had hoped would be a redeeming factor, was oversized but lacked flavor and texture. The "mexican" food was a lazy attempt at recreating authentic dishes, with too much reliance on pre-packaged mixes and sauces. The margarita, which I had ordered with a double shot, was an insult to the very concept of a margarita. It was weak, bland, and tasted more like margarita mix than a carefully crafted cocktail.

As I left the restaurant, I couldn't help but feel like I had been robbed of my time and money. The experience was a perfect storm of bad food, bad service, and a bad attitude. I would not recommend this place to my worst enemy, and I would caution anyone considering visiting to think twice. The two stars I gave this restaurant are generous, and I would not hesitate to give it a well-deserved one-star review if I could.

In conclusion, my experience at this restaurant was a disaster from start to finish. The food was subpar, the service was abysmal, and the atmosphere was lacking. The staff's attitude and behavior were unacceptable, and it's clear that they are not interested in providing even the most basic level of customer satisfaction. If you value your time and money, stay far, far away from this dump. There are plenty of other restaurants out there that actually care about their customers and serve decent food. This place is a waste of time and money, and I would not recommend it to anyone.

The mole sauce was rich and flavorful, a highlight of my visit. Despite the occasional lack of attentiveness, I appreciate their chicken tamales and traditional Mexican sides. With some improvement in service, this place could become a favorite for those seeking authentic, homestyle dishes like their tamales and rice and beans.

The splash pad is well-maintained and provides a great spot for kids to cool off during the warmer months. It's also conveniently located near a few shops, making it easy for parents to keep an eye on their little ones while still being able to browse nearby stores. The surrounding area is also pretty well-shaded, which is a bonus for hot summer days. My stepdaughter has always had a blast playing there, and I appreciate that it's a free activity, which is hard to come by these days. Overall, while the shopping experience at this location leaves much to be desired, the splash pad is a definite highlight and a great resource for families in the area. Despite my overall dissatisfaction with the mall, I will likely continue to visit the splash pad with my kids, and for that, I'm willing to overlook some of the other drawbacks.

It's disheartening to see a favorite spot decline. The lack of attention to detail, such as melted cheese, is inexcusable. Hopefully, they'll address these issues and return to their former quality, but until then, I'll be taking my business elsewhere, seeking a better Mexican food experience.

Unfortunately, the uniqueness of the fajitas didn't translate to a positive dining experience for us. The combination of the dry, baked chicken and the overcooked, bitter pepper and onion mixture was a letdown. We were expecting the typical sizzling, flavorful dish that we've come to associate with fajitas, but what we got was a lackluster, unappetizing meal. The excellent sides, such as the guacamole, pico, cheese, and lettuce, couldn't make up for the disappointing main course. As a result, I've decided that Paco's is no longer a restaurant I'll be visiting. It's a shame, because I had high hopes for this place, but after multiple attempts, I just can't seem to find a reason to return. Perhaps they'll revamp their menu or cooking techniques, but for now, I'll be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere.
by the stunning vistas and unique attractions, making the trip well worth the time and effort to witness nature's breathtaking beauty up close.

As I weigh the pros and cons of living at Uptown Gardens, I have to consider my overall experience and whether the benefits outweigh the drawbacks. On one hand, the management team has been exceptional, always responsive and helpful with any issues that have arisen. The proximity to Uptown Charlotte is a major plus, with plenty of restaurants, bars, and entertainment options within walking distance. My apartment itself is spacious and quiet, which has been a welcome respite from the hustle and bustle of city living.

However, the lack of amenities is a significant drawback. The small gym and pool are often crowded, and it would be nice to have more options for recreation and relaxation. The safety concerns are also a worry, particularly with the abandoned lot nearby and the always-open gates. While I haven't had any personal issues, it's unsettling to see unfamiliar people wandering around the area at night.

The train noise is another major issue. While I've grown accustomed to it over time, it's still a disruption, especially when the horns blast for extended periods. I wish I had been informed about this before signing my lease, as it might have been a deal-breaker for me. The constant construction has also been a frustration, with equipment and noise disrupting my daily life.

Despite these issues, I have to acknowledge that Uptown Gardens has been a decent place to call home. The management team's attentiveness and the apartment's spaciousness have made up for some of the shortcomings. If you're considering moving to Uptown Gardens, I would recommend weighing the pros and cons carefully and doing your research. It's not the perfect complex, but it might be a good fit for you if you prioritize location and a quiet, spacious living space. Just be aware of the potential drawbacks, and don't hesitate to ask questions before signing a lease.

Overall, it's an average dining experience, nothing spectacular but fills the hunger. The ambiance is nice, but it can't compensate for the limited options and potentially stale food. If you're in the area and craving Chinese food on a tight budget, this place might suffice. However, if you're willing to spend a bit more, I'd recommend exploring other options like Buffet Asia for a more satisfying meal with a wider variety of fresh dishes.

The lack of professionalism and fairness was appalling. My mother's win was clearly legitimate, yet the employees failed to acknowledge it. The bingo supervisor's rude attitude only added to our frustration. Overall, our Mother's Day celebration was ruined by the poor management and dishonest practices at this establishment. We will not be returning and will be taking our business to Lone Butte or Fort McDowell, where bingo is run with integrity.

Despite my mixed experiences, I decided to give them another try at their new location. Unfortunately, the inconsistencies persisted. The atmosphere of the new place is nicer, but the service remains hit-or-miss. On my latest visit, our server seemed overwhelmed, taking a long time to take our orders and forgetting one of our appetizers. However, the food was still decent, and I enjoyed my chili relleno. My husband, on the other hand, was not impressed with his dish again. The prices have not changed, and I still feel that they are slightly overpriced for the quality and portion size. The fact that they charge extra for chips and salsa is also a bit of a turn-off. Overall, I appreciate the effort they put into their cooking, but the unreliable service and pricing issues prevent me from fully enjoying my experiences here. Perhaps with more consistent service and a revision of their pricing strategy, I would consider bumping up my rating. Until then, I will remain a somewhat satisfied but mostly disappointed customer.

I'm definitely looking forward to checking that out. The overall atmosphere was electric, and I loved the variety of music they played. Our group had an amazing time dancing and singing along to the songs. The staff were attentive and ensured our glasses were always full. Although the bottle service was a bit steep for my taste, it didn't deter from the overall experience. I've already recommended Blue Martini to my friends, and we're planning to go back soon. The fact that they have themed nights, like the Halloween party we attended, makes it a great spot to try something new and exciting.

Overall, our experience was pleasant, but I was slightly underwhelmed by the buffet options. The quality and flavor of my husband's dishes, on the other hand, were impressive. Perhaps the buffet is not the best representation of the restaurant's capabilities. I would be willing to give them another try, ordering off the menu next time to fully appreciate their culinary skills. For now, I remain somewhat neutral, knowing that similar establishments, like Amarind's, have set a high standard for Thai cuisine in the city. Service was friendly and attentive, adding to the positive atmosphere.
Foi uma grande decepção, pois esperávamos muito mais confort e qualidade pelo preço pago, mesmo sendo baixo, a experiência não valeu a pena.
Disappointing visit overall, expected more from a popular restaurant, especially with their salad options, and better customer service to resolve issues promptly.

The lack of variety in their menu is quite disappointing, and the prices they charge are not justified by the quality or speed of service. For a pizza place to thrive, especially in a competitive market, they need to offer more options or excel in their specialty. Unfortunately, this establishment falls short on both counts. The long wait times, combined with the limited menu and high prices, make it unlikely that we will return for a third visit. Overall, our experiences have been underwhelming, and we would not recommend this place to others.

was a bit slow and seemed disorganized, which was surprising given the small number of customers at the time. However, the friendly atmosphere and exceptional quality of the food made up for it. The exotic crepe was a highlight, with the combination of fresh fruit and coconut sorbet being absolutely divine. The fresh fruit tart I took to go was also a winner, with a perfect balance of sweet and tangy. Overall, I'm glad I got to experience this charming creperie with my cousins, and we're all already planning our next visit. Despite the minor service hiccup, I would highly recommend this place to anyone with a sweet tooth.

The quality of the food is impressive, especially considering it's a food court establishment. The Greek Salad with Chicken was refreshing and flavorful, with a generous portion of grilled chicken. The ingredients were fresh and the dressing was tangy, making for a satisfying meal. I appreciate that they offer half orders, which is perfect for a lighter bite or for those who want to try a smaller portion. The prices are also reasonable, making it a great value for the quality and quantity of food received. Overall, I would highly recommend this location for a quick and delicious meal while shopping at the mall.

The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, with a warm decor that makes you feel like you're in a family member's kitchen. The service is top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who ensure that your cup is always full and your plate is never empty. The prices are indeed reasonable, with generous portions that will keep you fueled for the rest of the day. Overall, I'm so glad I stumbled upon The Original Sunrise Cafe, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a delicious, homemade-style breakfast in Vegas. It's a hidden gem that's definitely worth seeking out.

As we sat around the traditional Ethiopian table, sharing food and conversation, I felt a sense of community and warmth that is often lacking in modern dining experiences. The staff at Abay seemed to genuinely care about our enjoyment, taking the time to explain the different dishes and making sure we had everything we needed. The combination platter was a great way to sample a variety of flavors and textures, and the portion size was generous to say the least. I was impressed by the complexity of the spices and seasonings used in each dish, and the fact that each bite was a surprise - sometimes spicy, sometimes savory, but always delicious.

The atmosphere of the restaurant was cozy and intimate, with soft music playing in the background and the aroma of exotic spices wafting through the air. The fact that it's BYOB is a definite plus, as it allows diners to bring their own wine and enjoy it with their meal without breaking the bank. The corkage fee was incredibly reasonable, and our bottle of wine paired perfectly with the rich and flavorful food. Overall, I would highly recommend Abay to anyone looking to try something new and exciting. The unique dining experience, combined with the delicious food and friendly staff, make it a must-visit destination for foodies and adventurous eaters alike. Whether you're a seasoned fan of Ethiopian cuisine or just looking to try something new, Abay is sure to impress.

The lack of attention to detail and subpar cleaning was astonishing, especially considering the hefty price tag. For $150, I expected a pristine vehicle, but what I got was a half-hearted attempt at cleaning. The fact that I had to re-clean my car myself is a clear indication of their incompetence. Needless to say, I will be taking my business elsewhere and advising others to do the same.

The venue itself was well-designed, with multiple levels and areas to explore, including a large pool and several bars. The crowd was lively and energetic, and the music was pumping all night long. However, the main draw for us was Ellie Goulding, and it was disappointing that she didn't perform as advertised. Instead, she made a guest appearance as a DJ, which wasn't what we were expecting. Despite this, we still managed to have a great time, dancing and enjoying the atmosphere. The staff were friendly and attentive, but the prices of the drinks were outrageous. Overall, it was a fun night out in Vegas, but not quite what we were promised. If you're looking for a lively outdoor party scene, this might be the place for you, but be aware of the potential for misleading advertising and expensive drinks.

As we left Roland's, my mother and I couldn't help but feel a bit underwhelmed by the whole experience. The sign had promised so much, touting their famous Lobster Rolls and Bloody Mary's, but in reality, it felt like they fell short. The lobster itself was certainly fresh and flavorful, but the presentation and portion size left something to be desired. And the Bloody Mary, which I had been looking forward to, was overpowered by the horseradish, making it undrinkable for me. 

The atmosphere of the place also didn't help, as it was freezing inside and we had to keep our winter coats on throughout our meal. It was a shame, really, because we had been excited to try Roland's and had heard good things about it. But based on our experience, I'm not sure we'll be back anytime soon. Maybe they were just having an off day, but for the price, I expect a lot more. We ended up leaving and continuing our shopping trip, still a bit peckish and disappointed by the lackluster snack. Needless to say, our high hopes for Roland's were dashed, and we'll have to look elsewhere for a satisfying bite to eat on our next trip to the strip.

The food itself was delicious, with unique flavor combinations that showcased the chef's skill. However, the exceptional cuisine was overshadowed by the hostile atmosphere created by the staff. A little kindness and courtesy would go a long way in making this establishment a standout in Edinburgh's dining scene, rather than a memorable disappointment due to poor service. With some refinement in customer service, this place could truly thrive.

Despite the unfriendly demeanor of the staff, I must admit that the store has a unique charm to it. The selection of Native American crafts and supplies is unparalleled, and I've found some truly one-of-a-kind items here. However, the lack of representation from other tribes is still a major drawback for me. As a Native American myself, I'd love to see more diversity in the products and artwork on display. The fact that everything seems to be Navajo-dominated can be overwhelming and exclusionary. Nevertheless, if you're looking for an authentic Native American shopping experience, this store is still worth a visit. Just be prepared for some attitude from the staff and customers, and don't expect to be catered to. It's a bit of a rough-around-the-edges kind of place, but the goods are genuine and the atmosphere is undeniably Native. With some improvements to customer service and representation, this store could truly thrive and become a staple of the Native American community. Until then, I'll continue to shop here, but with tempered expectations.

The bed was comfortable and amenities were satisfactory. Overall, despite initial issues, the stay was pleasant and staff were apologetic. With some improvements to their key card system and new staff training, this place has great potential. I would recommend it for budget-friendly travelers, just be patient and prepared for any minor hiccups.

The atmosphere of the shop is also worth mentioning, as it provides a cozy and inviting space for customers to relax and enjoy their beverages. The seating area is comfortable and well-designed, with ample seating options for both small and large groups. The staff is friendly and attentive, always willing to offer recommendations or answer questions about their menu items. I appreciate the fact that they take the time to prepare each drink to order, rather than relying on pre-made mixes or automated machines. This attention to detail and commitment to quality is what sets Coffee Bean and Tea Leaf apart from other coffee shops in the area. Overall, I'm glad they decided to open another location in the district, and I look forward to becoming a regular customer. With its unique tea options and high-quality coffee, this shop is sure to become a favorite among coffee and tea lovers alike.

Overall, it was an average experience. The staff were friendly and helpful, but the hotel itself felt a bit dated. We didn't have any major complaints, but it didn't exceed our expectations either. For the price, it was a good value, and the location was convenient. We might consider staying here again in the future, but we'd also be open to exploring other options.

Overall, our experience at the Palace Tower was a mixed bag. While we appreciated the upgrade to a nicer room, the initial issues with our accommodation were a major turnoff. The lack of free Wi-Fi and outdated tech amenities made it feel like we were staying in a budget hotel, not a luxury resort. The tense atmosphere created by the manager yelling at the bartender was also unsettling. However, we did enjoy the buffet, Payard crepe and sweets, and the pool and gym facilities were top-notch. It's clear that this casino prioritizes profits over guest satisfaction, which is a shame. If you're looking for a more welcoming and accommodating experience, we would recommend considering alternative options like the Bellagio or Planet Hollywood. Despite the few highlights, our stay was largely disappointing and we wouldn't rush to return. The deceptive practices, like the paid buffet line skip, only added to our frustration.

As a long-time fan of the Short Leash food truck, I was disappointed to find that the restaurant didn't quite live up to my expectations. The lack of attention from our waitress was a major issue, and it seemed like we were forgotten about after our food was delivered. The fact that we had to eat without silverware was not only inconvenient, but it also made the experience feel rushed and unrefined. The food itself was also a letdown, with my hot dog lacking the toppings that I've come to love from the truck. The salad was bland and uninspiring, and the fact that it wasn't dressed properly was a missed opportunity to add some much-needed flavor.

Despite these issues, I do want to give Short Leash the benefit of the doubt. As I mentioned, it was First Friday, and the place was likely bustling with customers. Maybe they were just having an off night, and I'm willing to give them another chance to prove themselves. The prices, especially for drinks, were very reasonable, and I appreciate that they're offering affordable options for customers. However, if I'm being honest, I was expecting a lot more from a restaurant that has built such a loyal following from its food truck. I hope that Short Leash will take my feedback to heart and work on improving their service and food quality, because I truly want to see them succeed. For now, I'll stick with the food truck, but I'll be keeping an eye on the restaurant to see if they can turn things around.

Overall, our experience at Meat & Potato was a mixed bag. While the unique, old-style ambiance was intriguing, the crowded seating and noise level detracted from our dining experience. The food, although above average, did not live up to our expectations, especially considering the prices. The mussel appetizer was fresh and flavorful, but the 36 oz ribeye, while cooked to perfection, lacked a wow factor. The steak fries were crispy and well-seasoned, but not particularly memorable. Our waiter, despite the challenges posed by the crowded conditions, was friendly and made an effort to provide good service. However, the delays between courses and the difficulty in getting his attention were notable. Perhaps a weekday visit or a seat at the bar would be a better way to experience Meat & Potato, as the lively atmosphere and extensive drink selection seem well-suited to a more casual, social outing. As a romantic dinner destination, however, it falls short due to the noise and cramped seating. With some adjustments to the seating configuration and service, Meat & Potato could reach its full potential and become a top-notch dining establishment.

The service was friendly and efficient, despite the morning rush. The staff seemed well-organized and managed to keep up with the demanding pace. I appreciated the fact that they had a separate counter for to-go orders, which helped to speed up the process. However, the atmosphere of the restaurant itself was not particularly inviting for a sit-down meal, which might be why I opted for take-out in the first place. The decor was modern and sleek, but it lacked a warm and cozy ambiance that I typically look for in a breakfast spot. Overall, I would recommend this place for their steel cut oatmeal, but perhaps not for a leisurely breakfast experience. The prices are a bit steep, but if you're looking for a healthy and filling start to your day in Vegas, it might be worth the splurge. I'd consider returning to try some of their other menu items, but for now, the oatmeal remains the highlight of my visit.

I was thoroughly impressed with the efficiency and customer service I received. The price was also very reasonable, especially considering the quick turnaround time. I would highly recommend Nextech to anyone in need of phone repairs. The shop was clean and organized, and Cody's expertise was evident in the way he handled my device. Overall, my experience was top-notch, and I appreciate the exceptional service I received. I will definitely be returning to Nextech for any future repair needs, and I will be recommending them to friends and family. Five stars isn't enough!

Overall, my experience at this location has been disappointing. The lack of professionalism and respect for customers is appalling. Despite the few friendly workers, the majority seem to be more interested in having their own party than providing good service. The loud music and horseplay create an uncomfortable atmosphere, making it difficult to focus or relax. I'll stick to the location near Walmart, where the staff is courteous and the environment is more welcoming. Unfortunately, this location's behavior has left a bad taste, and I wouldn't recommend it to others. One star is even generous.

Overall, I would recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a trendy spot to grab dinner before a night out. The service was also top-notch, with friendly and attentive waitstaff who made sure our glasses were always full. Although the prices may be a bit steep for some, the unique atmosphere and flavorful dishes make it worth the extra cost. I'm already looking forward to my next visit, and I'm excited to try more of their spicy options. The bar overlooking the kitchen seems like it would be a great spot to sit and watch the chefs at work, and I think it would add an extra layer of entertainment to the dining experience.

As I continued to browse the shop, I was impressed by the vast array of items on display. From vintage baseball cards to game-worn jerseys, and even rare sports equipment, the selection was truly impressive. The two guys working at the shop were more than happy to share stories and anecdotes about the various items, which added to the overall experience. My husband, being the avid Cubs fan that he is, was particularly thrilled to chat with them about the team's history and some of the notable players.

One of the things that struck me about the shop was the attention to detail and the care with which the items were displayed. Each piece was carefully framed, mounted, or showcased, and the overall presentation was very professional. I was also pleased to see that the shop had a wide range of items to suit different budgets and interests. While some of the more rare and unique pieces were certainly pricey, there were also more affordable options available, such as the unsigned photo I purchased.

Despite the crowds and the busy atmosphere, the shop felt welcoming and inviting. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable, and they seemed genuinely passionate about sports and memorabilia. I appreciated the fact that they were willing to chat and share their expertise, rather than simply trying to make a sale. Overall, I would definitely recommend this shop to anyone who is interested in sports memorabilia or simply looking for a unique and interesting place to browse.

In terms of suggestions for improvement, I think the shop could benefit from a bit more space and a more streamlined layout. As I mentioned earlier, it can get quite crowded and busy, especially during signings and other events. Additionally, it might be helpful to have a bit more signage or clear pricing information, as some of the items were not clearly labeled. However, these are minor quibbles, and overall I was very pleased with my experience at the shop. If you're a sports fan or just looking for something fun to do, I would definitely recommend checking it out.

I may be the only person to think this place isn't so great. I'm here if friends make me go, it's right in the heart of Noda on the corner of 36th St. and every time I go, I feel like I want to knock at least one person out. Every time I'm here, it's so crowded, and then you have to deal with a big, bad security guy that takes his position way over the line. On one occasion, I came here with my deaf friends on their evening out, and I'll never forget the looks from the "crowd" of people there - extremely rude. The atmosphere is just too generic for my taste, and the crowd doesn't help. If you enjoy a crowded space with an absentminded crowd, then this might be the place for you, but it's definitely not my cup of tea.

The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, making it a great experience for both kids and adults. The interactive displays are engaging and fun, with something new to discover each visit, making the yearly pass a great value.
Prices are reasonable, portions are generous, and the overall experience is wonderful, making it a must-visit for delicious Thai food.

As I continued to explore the suite, I was impressed by the attention to detail and the luxurious amenities that were provided. The custom-made pool table was a great touch, and the wet bar area, although not yet completed, showed promise of being a fantastic spot to entertain guests. The living room was equipped with everything I needed to relax and unwind, from the large flat-screen TV to the Wii game console and Bose sound system.

The bedroom was truly the pièce de résistance, with its dark and sexy decor, crystal lamps, and massive leather headboard. The king-size bed was incredibly comfortable, and I appreciated the fact that there was another large flat-screen TV opposite the bed, perfect for watching movies or sports. The master bath was truly opulent, with its marble floors, massive walk-in shower, and 4-person jacuzzi tub. I even appreciated the small touch of having a phone in the bathroom, just in case I needed to make a call while, ahem, taking care of business.

One of the things that really stood out to me about the Celebrity Suites was the service. From the moment I arrived, the staff at the Hard Rock were friendly, attentive, and eager to ensure that my stay was nothing short of exceptional. Whether I needed extra towels, a drink from the bar, or recommendations for restaurants and shows, the staff were always happy to help.

Overall, I would highly recommend the Celebrity Suites at the Hard Rock to anyone looking to splurge and experience the ultimate in luxury and decadence in Las Vegas. With its stunning decor, luxurious amenities, and exceptional service, the Hard Rock has truly outdone itself with these new suites. Whether you're celebrating a special occasion or just want to treat yourself to a night of pampering, the Celebrity Suites are the perfect choice. So why settle for an ordinary hotel room when you can live like a rock star? Book your stay at the Hard Rock and experience the ultimate in Vegas luxury.

Overall, it's an average dining experience, but the generous portions and friendly owner make up for some of the shortcomings, making it a decent option for a quick and filling meal, especially if you're a fan of their signature orange chicken dish served fresh.

The atmosphere was cozy and intimate, perfect for a night out with friends. The prices were reasonable considering the high quality of the food and service. Overall, we had a fantastic experience and would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a delicious meal and exceptional service. With its great food, lovely atmosphere, and outstanding staff, it's sure to become a favorite destination for special occasions and casual nights out alike, making it a must-visit.

The staff at both the Rum Runner Lounge and the Badger Cafe are incredibly friendly and welcoming. They always seem to remember us, even when we haven't been in for a while, and they're quick to recommend new menu items or drinks. The food at the Badger Cafe is top-notch, with a great selection of burgers, sandwiches, and salads. I'm particularly fond of their breakfast menu, which is served all day. The portion sizes are generous, and the prices are very reasonable. Overall, I highly recommend the Rum Runner Lounge and the Badger Cafe to anyone looking for a relaxed, low-key spot to grab a bite or hang out with friends.

As the show dragged on, I found myself checking my watch multiple times, willing the minutes to pass faster. The performances, although technically impressive, lacked a certain je ne sais quoi that would have kept me engaged. The crowd around me seemed just as unenthusiastic, with many people fidgeting in their seats or whispering to each other. I was expecting a spectacle that would leave me in awe, but instead, I felt like I was watching a series of disconnected acts that failed to coalesce into a cohesive whole.

The pool, which I had assumed would be a unique and exciting element, ended up being more of a gimmick than a integral part of the show. The water-based performances were few and far between, and when they did occur, they felt like a rehashing of things I'd seen before. My wife, who had been looking forward to the show all day, was equally underwhelmed, and we both left feeling disappointed and ripped off. For the exorbitant price we paid, I expected a truly unforgettable experience, but what we got was a lackluster display of circus acts that failed to deliver on its promise of wonder and enchantment. Needless to say, I would not recommend CIRQUE to anyone, and would instead steer them towards more entertaining and value-for-money options like ABSINTHE.

Flavors and atmosphere transported me back home. Authentic Taiwanese cuisine, a rare gem, made my morning unforgettable, with each bite a delightful reminder of the island's rich culinary heritage, a must-visit for anyone seeking genuine Taiwanese breakfast experience.

Overall, the experience was subpar and not worth the money. The food was hit or miss, with some items being enjoyable while others were overpowered by strong flavors. The service was lacking, with our server seemingly disappearing after taking our order. This lack of attention and care made the entire experience feel unwelcoming. With numerous other options available in Las Vegas, it's unlikely we'll return to this establishment. The free entrée voucher was a nice gesture, but it wasn't enough to make up for the disappointing service and inconsistent food quality. A more attentive server and balanced flavors could have made a big difference.
Overall, the atmosphere and food quality are hit or miss, making it an average dining experience despite the friendly management and some standout dishes like the enchiladas and nachos.

Despite the exceptional Mater Paneer, the overall experience was disappointing. The lack of service and poor ambiance really brought down the rating. Our server seemed completely uninterested in attending to our needs, and the dirty surroundings made it uncomfortable to dine. The buffet selection, although abundant, lacked variety and freshness. Many dishes were lukewarm, and the quality was subpar. As a vegetarian, I was disappointed to find limited options, and most of them were unappetizing. However, that one outstanding dish has left a lasting impression on me. I would consider returning to this restaurant solely for the Mater Paneer, but they would need to significantly improve their service and cleanliness. For now, I can only give them an average rating of 3 stars, with the hope that they will take customer feedback seriously and make the necessary changes. Perhaps with some renovations and staff training, this place could reach its full potential.

I'm thoroughly impressed with the attention to detail and care taken in cleaning my home. The trouble spots I mentioned were spotless, and the entire house felt refreshed. I've already recommended them to friends and family, and I look forward to scheduling my next appointment. Their reliability and professionalism are a breath of fresh air in the industry, and I'm grateful to have found them.

Overall, I'm impressed with the consistency of their dishes and the generous portion sizes. The atmosphere may be casual, but the flavors are rich and authentic. Our server was friendly and ensured our glasses were always full. For the price, it's an excellent option for those craving Mexican cuisine. I'd definitely recommend this hidden gem to friends and family, and I'm already looking forward to my next visit to try more of their menu items. The combination of delicious food, great service, and affordable prices makes it a must-visit spot in the Sunnyslope area.
The quality of service remains exceptional, and I appreciate the warm welcome I receive each time I visit, making it my go-to salon for all my nail care needs always.

The amenities provided in the cabana were top-notch, with comfortable seating, flat-screen TVs, and a fully stocked fridge. Our server was attentive and ensured that our drinks were always full and our needs were met. The food options were also impressive, with a variety of delicious snacks and meals available to order. We took advantage of the cabana's private entrance to the lazy river and pool, which made it easy to come and go as we pleased. The wading pool surrounding the cabana was a highlight, especially on the hot summer days we were there. It was the perfect spot to cool off and relax while still being able to socialize with our group. Overall, renting the executive cabana at Monte Carlo was an excellent decision and made our birthday celebration truly unforgettable. The combination of luxury, exclusivity, and exceptional service made for an amazing experience that we can't wait to repeat.

I was extremely disappointed and frustrated with the experience I had with this auto detailing company. Not only did they surprise me with an extra charge for a black vehicle, which was not mentioned in the fine print, but they also failed to show up for the scheduled appointment. The lack of communication and courtesy from their team was appalling. When I tried to reach out to them, I was met with rudeness and ignored phone calls. It's unacceptable for a business to treat customers in such a manner.

The fact that they didn't even bother to call me back after multiple attempts is a clear indication of their unreliability. I'm grateful that the company who sold me the discount packages took responsibility and refunded my money. It's reassuring to know that they took my complaint seriously and decided to terminate their partnership with this auto detailing company. I would strongly advise others to avoid this company at all costs. Their unprofessional behavior and lack of accountability make them unworthy of trust. Save yourself the hassle and look for a more reliable and customer-centric auto detailing service. With so many other options available, there's no reason to settle for a company that doesn't value its customers.

The creativity and presentation of each dish are truly impressive, and the flavors are always bold and well-balanced. I've had the pleasure of trying their seafood options, including the pan-seared scallops and grilled salmon, both of which were cooked to perfection. The portion sizes are generous, and the prices are reasonable considering the high quality of the ingredients and the expertise that goes into preparing each meal. The staff is knowledgeable and friendly, happy to answer questions about the menu and make recommendations. One of the standout features of L'Orignal is their extensive wine list, which complements their menu nicely. Whether you're a foodie, a wine enthusiast, or just looking for a unique dining experience, L'Orignal is definitely worth a visit. With its cozy atmosphere, exceptional service, and creative cuisine, it's a great spot for a night out with friends or a romantic evening.

As we walked out, I couldn't help but feel disappointed and frustrated with the whole experience. A sports bar that can't even be bothered to play the sound for a major championship game is a joke. It's not like we were asking for much, just a basic level of service and attention to detail that would allow us to enjoy the game. But instead, we were met with hostility and indifference from the staff.

I've been to plenty of sports bars in my time, and I've never encountered a place that was so blatantly uninterested in providing a good experience for their customers. It's clear that Pitcher's Pub is more concerned with being a trendy hangout spot than actually catering to the needs of sports fans. The fact that they advertised themselves as a sports bar and then failed to deliver on that promise is just false advertising.

The worst part is that the staff seemed completely unapologetic about the whole situation. They didn't even bother to try to make things right or offer any kind of explanation for their behavior. It was like they just didn't care that they were driving away customers. I've never been treated so poorly at a bar or restaurant, and I would not recommend Pitcher's Pub to my worst enemy.

If you're a sports fan looking for a place to catch a game, keep looking. There are plenty of other bars and restaurants in the area that actually care about providing a good experience for their customers. Pitcher's Pub may have a nice space and decent food, but their horrible service and complete lack of attention to detail make it a place to avoid at all costs. One star is even too generous for this dump.

I'm extremely disappointed in the overall experience at the Quad, and it's clear that the management team is not prioritizing guest satisfaction. The constant issues and frustrations have made our stay feel like a nightmare. From the initial room assignment to the daily struggles with navigation, amenities, and services, it's been a never-ending battle. The fact that we had to request a room change due to the unbearable odor is unacceptable, and the subsequent room assignment hasn't been much better.

The lack of basic amenities, such as shampoo and complimentary soap, is surprising for a hotel of this caliber. The restrictions on requesting a coffee maker unless you're a Diamond card holder is also ridiculous. It's clear that the hotel is more focused on catering to their loyal customers rather than providing a decent experience for all guests. The parking garage is a hazard, and the wait times to exit during conventions are absurd. The recent incident with the elevator breaking down and the fire alarm being pulled has added to the chaos and stress of our stay.

As I reflect on our experience, I'm reminded of the numerous other hotels in the area that offer better services, amenities, and overall value. Budget Suites, as I mentioned earlier, is a far superior option. If you're considering staying at the Quad, I would strongly advise against it. The hassle and frustration simply aren't worth it. Unless Caesar's management group takes drastic measures to address these issues and improve their standards, I fear that this hotel will continue to disappoint and drive away potential customers. Our stay has been a disaster, and I'm counting down the days until we can leave.

As I reflected on our two visits, I couldn't help but feel that Bistro La Bon failed to live up to its promising name and concept. The atmosphere, although quaint and charming, couldn't compensate for the subpar food and service we experienced. The delay in receiving our food was unacceptable, and the lack of attention from our server was noticeable. It seemed that the staff was either understaffed or undertrained, as we had to ask for bread and water refills multiple times.

The tempura fried avocado and asparagus was a highlight, but it wasn't enough to redeem the overall experience. The scallops with deconstructed seafood chowder, while tasty, left us wanting more in terms of portion size. The fish, although flavorful, was overcooked, which was a disappointment. Given the high prices and trendy location, I expected more attention to detail and a more refined dining experience.

Despite our underwhelming experiences, I'm willing to give Bistro La Bon another chance, but only for their Sunday brunch. Perhaps the brunch menu will showcase the kitchen's skills better, and the service will be more attentive. However, for lunch and dinner, I would recommend exploring other options in the area. With a bit more focus on food quality, portion sizes, and service, Bistro La Bon could live up to its name and reputation, but until then, it remains an overhyped and overpriced establishment.

Overall, we're big fans of this hidden spot. The staff is friendly and attentive, making for a great atmosphere. Despite the inconsistent crowds, the quality of food and drinks remains high. We appreciate the extra touches, like making the wings to our liking. It's definitely worth seeking out, even if it's not immediately visible from the street.

Despite some missteps, the restaurant's charm and attentive service shone through. The free appetizer was a thoughtful touch, making our anniversary celebration special. While improvements are needed, particularly with wine pours and table settings, the high-quality food and generous salad options were redeeming factors. With a few tweaks, this establishment could truly excel and justify its premium pricing, making it a top choice for special occasions and romantic evenings out.

The ambiance of the restaurant was elegant and sophisticated, matching the high-end vibe of the Cosmopolitan hotel. Our server was attentive and knowledgeable, helping us navigate the menu and making excellent recommendations. Despite the limited availability of some items, the dishes we did order were expertly prepared and presented. The Aji was a standout, with its delicate flavor and crispy texture. The sake pairing was also a highlight, complementing the subtle flavors of the sashimi perfectly. Overall, while the prices may be steep, the quality and service make it a worthwhile experience for special occasions or indulgent nights out in Las Vegas. Just be prepared for a hefty bill at the end of the night.
Maybe the service was just an off day, but for now, it's a tentative return to try more of their menu offerings, hoping for a better experience to match the great coffee.

I have been here a few times, and overall I found it inconsistent for a pricy establishment.

The first time I went here I tried the house cured salumi. It was outstanding, but I think it was $16/ person, so ended up being a bit pricy for a large group starter. I also really enjoyed the beef cheek ravioli which was nice and saucy. The pork belly was great, but a little too fatty for my taste.

The second time I really enjoyed the whole sea bass- it was market price, so I don't remember how much it was.

The third time was a complete miss. I got the short rib and it was tougher than short rib should be. The waitress also recommended the gnocchi as a side dish which just made the whole thing too heavy of a meal. The brussels sprouts were really awesome though.

Overall, I had a good experience the first couple of times, but the last visit was very average. Given the high prices, I expect a certain level of quality and consistency, which unfortunately was not met on my last visit. The atmosphere and service were always good, but the food quality varied significantly. I would still recommend this place, but with caution and a warning to carefully consider the menu choices to avoid disappointment. Perhaps with a more discerning selection, one can have a better experience, but for now, I remain undecided about returning.

The staff is friendly and efficient, making the pickup process seamless. I've never been disappointed with my orders, and the quality of the food is consistently high. Although the prices may be a bit steep for some, I believe the freshness and taste of the dishes make it worthwhile. Overall, I highly recommend this establishment for its delicious food, convenient location, and excellent service, making it a great spot to grab a bite to eat, whether dining in or taking out.

I'm extremely disappointed and concerned about the food safety. We won't be ordering from here again. The fact that he got sick so quickly after consuming the pizza is alarming. I hope the restaurant takes necessary steps to ensure their food is prepared and handled properly to avoid similar incidents in the future.

Despite the breathtaking visuals, I left feeling unfulfilled, craving a narrative to complement the spectacular display, making the experience fall slightly short of perfection for me, a reminder that substance is just as important as style in a truly unforgettable show.

The conflicting sounds made it difficult to fully enjoy either performance. Despite this, the overall atmosphere remained lively and entertaining. The staff's friendly demeanor and efficient service helped to make up for the audio overlap. With a few tweaks to their entertainment schedule, this dive bar could truly excel as a top destination for both food and live music enthusiasts.

The whole experience was a major letdown, especially considering the hype from the TV show. The burgers were cooked to our liking, but the quality and portion size didn't justify the hefty price tag. The fries, although plentiful, were nothing special and didn't live up to the expectations set by the show. What really disappointed us, however, was the subpar service. Our server seemed overwhelmed and disorganized, forgetting our appetizer order and failing to check in on us throughout the meal. The fact that we weren't even offered dessert or asked if we wanted refills on our drinks was a glaring oversight. For a casual dining experience, the prices were exorbitant, and the poor service only added to our frustration. Unless they revamp their service and pricing, we wouldn't recommend this place to anyone, despite its TV fame. Overall, a disappointing and overpriced experience.

We left feeling incredibly full and satisfied. The prices were reasonable considering the generous portions. Overall, our experience was outstanding, and we can't wait to return. The unique menu offerings and exceptional service make this a must-visit destination for anyone looking for a delicious and memorable meal. Highly recommended!

The chicken flatbread was cooked to perfection, with a nice balance of flavors and a crispy crust. The minestrone soup was also delicious, with a rich and savory broth. I appreciate that the restaurant offers a variety of options that can accommodate my dietary needs, and the staff is always friendly and accommodating. The Ziosk system is a great addition, making it easy to order and pay without having to wait for a server. Overall, I'm impressed with the consistency and quality of the food, and I look forward to my next visit. Despite the minor issue with the salad on my first visit, I'm willing to give them another chance and recommend this chain to others.

Disappointing experience overall, especially considering the high prices. Expected more from a restaurant that was once enjoyable, but now seems to be struggling with service and ambiance, making it unlikely for me to recommend or return in the future.

The lack of functioning outlets is a major inconvenience, especially for a establishment offering free wifi. It's disappointing that the staff seemed apathetic to my issue. As a result, I would not recommend this place to anyone needing to work or stay productive. The combination of unhelpful staff and inadequate amenities makes it a waste of time. Needless to say, I will be taking my business elsewhere.

The overall experience was a letdown, and I would not recommend this place to anyone looking for a genuine dining experience. The atmosphere was trying too hard to be trendy, but it felt forced and superficial. The service was subpar, with our server seeming more interested in flirting with the wealthy patrons than attending to our needs. The food, aside from the blue cheese bread, was unimpressive and overpriced. For a business dinner, I expected a more professional and sophisticated atmosphere, but this place fell short. Unless you're looking to impress someone with a flashy, expensive meal, there are far better options in Vegas. Needless to say, I won't be returning, and I'm just glad I can write it off as a business expense.

The service was top-notch, with our server being attentive and knowledgeable about the menu. The atmosphere was cozy and intimate, making it perfect for our special occasion. I was impressed by the generous portion sizes and the evident care taken in preparing each dish. The combination of flavors and textures in my Mahi Mahi dish was exceptional, and the garlic mashed potatoes were creamy and rich. Overall, our dining experience was outstanding, and I highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for fresh seafood and exceptional service. It's clear why my husband chose this place to celebrate our anniversary - it's a true gem.
Prices are very reasonable, and the atmosphere is cozy and authentic, making it a must-visit for any Mexican food lover nearby.

We enjoyed the lively atmosphere, great music, and top-notch service. The rooms were clean and comfortable, with amazing views of the city. Overall, it was an unforgettable experience, and I'd highly recommend the Hard Rock for anyone seeking a wild and exciting adventure in a vibrant setting.

As I left the restaurant, I couldn't help but feel disappointed and frustrated with the way I was treated. The owner's refusal to listen to my concerns and his defensive attitude made me realize that customer satisfaction is not a priority at Defalco's. It's unfortunate, because I had previously enjoyed their southwestern Italian cuisine, but the subpar service and food quality I experienced tonight has left a sour taste in my mouth.

I understand that mistakes can happen, and restaurants can have off days, but it's how they handle those mistakes that truly matters. In this case, Defalco's failed to apologize, failed to offer a satisfactory solution, and instead chose to argue with me. As a customer, I expect to be treated with respect and courtesy, especially when I'm bringing a legitimate concern to the owner's attention.

It's clear that Defalco's has a loyal following, but for me, the experience was a deal-breaker. I will not be returning, and I would caution others to think twice before dining here. With so many excellent Italian restaurants in the Tempe and Scottsdale area, there's no need to settle for subpar service and food. Defalco's may have been a favorite of mine in the past, but after tonight's experience, I'm happy to take my business (and my appetite) elsewhere.

As the night wore on, our frustration grew, and it became clear that our server was overwhelmed, but not necessarily due to the number of tables she had. It seemed like a lack of attention to detail and a general disinterest in providing good service. We had to ask multiple times for simple things like ketchup and napkins, and even then, they didn't always arrive. The food, as I mentioned, was just okay, but the prices were not reflective of the quality. The happy hour appetizers were a decent value, but the regular menu items were overpriced for what you got.

The worst part of the experience was when we asked for the check and had to remind the server about the half-price appetizers. You would think that would be something they would keep track of, especially since we had ordered multiple appetizers during happy hour. But no, we had to point it out to her, and even then, she seemed put off. The whole experience was just a disaster from start to finish. As we were leaving, I noticed that the manager was standing at the hostess stand, chatting with the hostess, completely oblivious to the chaos that was unfolding on the patio. It's clear that there is a lack of leadership and attention to customer service at this location.

Overall, I would not recommend Rock Bottom to anyone. The service was abysmal, the food was mediocre, and the prices were too high. There are plenty of other restaurants in the area that would be happy to have our business and would actually provide good service. We won't be back, and I would advise others to avoid this place at all costs. Save yourself the hassle and take your business (and your appetite) elsewhere.

Overall, the dish lacked a wow factor, and the prices didn't quite match the quality. However, the service was excellent, and our server was attentive and knowledgeable about the menu, which somewhat made up for the meal's shortcomings and left a positive impression on our dining experience.

The food was delicious and the portion sizes were generous. I appreciated the flexibility in substituting sides without an extra fee. The atmosphere was lively and modern, with a great selection of beers on tap. Our server, Tai, was knowledgeable and made excellent recommendations. The prices were reasonable, especially considering the quality and quantity of the food. Overall, I was thoroughly impressed with my first visit to the Yard House and I'm already looking forward to my next trip. The attention to detail and excellent service made for a wonderful dining experience, and I would highly recommend it to others.

The energy in the room was infectious, and before long, the entire crowd was clapping and singing along to the music. We even made some new friends, bonding over our shared love of music and good times. The pianists played with such passion and enthusiasm, it was impossible not to get caught up in the excitement. As the night wore on, the music only got better, with the pianists taking requests and playing everything from classic rock to modern pop hits. Despite the late hour, the crowd showed no signs of dwindling, and we found ourselves staying until the very end, reluctant to leave the magic of the piano bar behind. It was truly a night to remember, and we can't wait to go back and experience it all again. The combination of great music, cozy atmosphere, and lively crowd made for an unforgettable evening.
