despite the initial miscommunication. However, Chris's intervention and generosity helped to turn our experience around. The BBQ Baby Back Ribs he provided were a nice touch and a testament to his commitment to customer satisfaction. The salads, on the other hand, were a highlight of our meal, with fresh ingredients and generous portions of meat. The Steak Salad, in particular, was a favorite among our group, with the grilled steak cooked to perfection. The Southwestern Chicken Salad and Buffalo Chicken Salad were also enjoyed, with the flavors and textures combining well. Unfortunately, the tacos were a letdown, and we wouldn't recommend them. Overall, our experience was mixed, but Chris's efforts to make things right and the quality of the salads have us willing to give the restaurant another try. With a bit more attention to service and consistency in the food, this place could really shine. As it stands, we would recommend it for the salads and the owner's dedication to his customers, but perhaps not for the tacos or on a busy night when the service might be stretched thin.

The service was friendly and attentive, making our overall experience even more enjoyable. Prices were reasonable, and portions were generous. I'm already looking forward to my next visit to try more of their dishes and explore the menu further, as everything we had was outstanding and left a great impression.

As someone who is familiar with the inner workings of a successful Italian restaurant, I was shocked by the lack of attention to detail and poor service we received at Sinatra's. The patio seating was indeed lovely, with a beautiful view of the surrounding area, but that's where the positives ended. Our server, although friendly, was clearly overwhelmed with the number of tables she was responsible for, and it showed in the slow and sporadic service we received. 

The food, which we were expecting to be top-notch given the restaurant's reputation, was a letdown. The lasagna, while good, was not exceptional, and the veal milanese was a disaster. The lack of flavor and tough texture made it inedible, and the accompanying tomato puree' was an insult to Italian cuisine. The fact that they were out of the wine we ordered and had to substitute it with a more expensive bottle was just the beginning of a long list of disappointments.

What really took the cake, however, was the management's response to our complaints. While the offer of a complimentary moscato was a nice gesture, it came too late and felt like a half-hearted attempt to placate us. For a restaurant of Sinatra's caliber, I expected much more. Given the numerous other excellent dining options available in Las Vegas, I would not recommend Sinatra's to anyone, especially not for a special occasion like a birthday dinner. The $235 price tag was a steep one, and the subpar experience we had was not worth it. Needless to say, we will not be returning to Sinatra's anytime soon.

Overall, I was impressed with the efficiency and quality of the establishment. The staff were friendly and accommodating, despite being slammed with customers. The atmosphere was lively and modern, with a fun vibe that made me want to come back. I tried the carne asada and chicken tacos, both of which were flavorful and well-seasoned. The tortillas were fresh and soft, and the toppings were plentiful. As I mentioned earlier, the only drawback was the lack of meat in each taco, but the price more than made up for it. I also appreciated the variety of options at the salsa bar, and the fact that they had a few unique offerings like pickled onions and grilled jalapeños. With a few minor tweaks, this place has the potential to become my new go-to spot for tacos. I'm excited to come back and try more of their offerings, especially once the beer taps are up and running.

The whole experience at N9ne was a major letdown, and the overpriced menu only added to our disappointment. For a restaurant located in a trendy hotel like the Palms, we expected a much higher level of quality and service. Instead, we felt like we were just another table to be rushed through, with no attention to detail or care for our dining experience. The long wait times between ordering and receiving our food were frustrating, and the lack of flavor in our dishes was shocking. It's not like we're asking for much - just a decent meal and some decent service.

But what really took the cake was our waiter's attitude when we didn't leave the tip he felt he deserved. His decision to include a 20% gratuity on our bill was already presumptuous, but his reaction when we didn't comply was completely unprofessional. Running out after us to argue about the tip was the final straw, and it left a bad taste in our mouths. Needless to say, we won't be recommending N9ne to anyone, and we'll definitely be taking our business (and our appetites) elsewhere. If you're looking for a good meal in Las Vegas, there are plenty of other options that offer better food, better service, and better value for your money. Avoid N9ne at all costs.

The music is loud and obnoxious, with bouncers who think they own the place. Overpriced drinks and a pretentious vibe make it a complete turnoff for anyone looking for a genuine nightlife experience. Unless you fit their narrow demographic, it's best to avoid this overhyped and unwelcoming establishment altogether.

I've been to The Vig multiple times and have had a generally positive experience each time. The staff is friendly and attentive, even on busy Sundays. The live entertainment is a major draw for me, as I enjoy the variety of DJs and bands that perform throughout the week. The atmosphere is also a highlight, with the outside fire pit and Italian lawn bowling area providing a unique and relaxing space to hang out. While the parking and drink prices can be a drawback, I think the overall experience makes up for it. If you're looking for a fun and lively spot to grab a drink and catch some live music, The Vig is definitely worth checking out. Just be aware of the potential downsides and plan accordingly. Overall, I'm a fan of The Vig and will continue to recommend it to friends and acquaintances.

Overall, it's a solid choice for a quick and satisfying meal. The atmosphere is casual and comfortable, making it a great option for a low-key lunch. Prices are reasonable, and the portions are generous. While it may not be my go-to spot, I appreciate the unique offerings and will continue to visit when I'm in the area and craving something a bit different.

As we finished our meal and prepared to leave, I couldn't help but feel underwhelmed by the overall experience. The lack of attention from the server, combined with the unremarkable food, made me wonder how this establishment stays afloat. Given its prime location near the stadiums and within the Westgate plaza, I expected a more vibrant atmosphere and better service. Instead, the place felt like a hollow shell, capitalizing on its convenient location rather than striving to provide a memorable experience. The fact that they don't even attempt to maintain an Irish theme, despite being named McFadden's, further solidified my impression that this is a lazy, unenthusiastic establishment. Unless you're desperate for a meal or drink and don't have time to venture elsewhere, I would recommend avoiding McFadden's altogether. With so many other options available, it's not worth settling for subpar food and service, no matter how convenient the location may be.

It's disappointing to see a place that was once a favorite of ours decline so drastically. The lack of attention to detail and customer care was alarming. As we finished our meal and prepared to leave, we couldn't help but notice the overall state of disarray. The sticky floor, which seemed to be a major hazard, was still not addressed despite multiple customers complaining about it. The employees seemed completely unbothered, which made us wonder if they were understaffed or just poorly trained. The fact that two orders were deleted during our visit, resulting in significant delays for those customers, suggests a deeper issue with their systems and processes. We hope that the management takes our feedback seriously and takes immediate action to rectify these problems. A good cleaning, some additional staff training, and a renewed focus on customer satisfaction could go a long way in restoring this location to its former glory. Until then, we'll be taking our business elsewhere. It's a shame, really, as we have many fond memories of dining here in the past. Perhaps with some changes, we'll consider giving them another chance in the future.

As I reflected on my experience at Last Chance, I realized that it's not just about the prices, but also about the thrill of the hunt. You have to be willing to dig through racks and shelves, searching for that one hidden gem that makes the entire trip worth it. It's a bit like a treasure hunt, where the treasure is a designer item at a fraction of the cost. Of course, this approach to shopping isn't for everyone, and I can understand why some people might find it overwhelming or frustrating.

But for me, the thrill of the hunt is part of the fun. I enjoy the challenge of finding a great deal, and the sense of satisfaction I get when I discover a fantastic item at a bargain price. And let's be real, the prices at Last Chance are unbeatable. I mean, where else can you find a pair of Diesel sneakers for under $20? It's a steal, and I felt like I was getting away with something.

One thing to note, however, is that the selection can be a bit hit-or-miss. I've heard from friends that some days are better than others, and it really depends on what's been stocked recently. But that's all part of the adventure, right? You never know what you're going to find, and that's what makes it so exciting.

As I was shopping, I noticed that there were a lot of other people who were clearly seasoned Last Chance shoppers. They knew exactly what they were looking for, and they were willing to dig through the racks to find it. I, on the other hand, was a bit more clueless, but I was determined to make the most of my experience. And I have to say, I was pretty proud of myself for finding some great deals, even if it did take a bit of effort.

In the end, I left Last Chance with a big smile on my face and a handful of great new items. It wasn't the most relaxing shopping experience, but it was definitely worth it. And as I mentioned earlier, I'll definitely be back – just as soon as I work up the energy to tackle the chaos again. If you're a fellow bargain hunter, or just someone who loves the thrill of the hunt, I highly recommend checking out Last Chance. Just be prepared to get a little dirty, and don't be afraid to dig through the racks to find that perfect item.

It's also worth noting that Last Chance is a great resource for people who are looking to update their wardrobe on a budget. Let's face it, fashion can be expensive, and it's not always easy to find great pieces at affordable prices. But Last Chance makes it possible to stay stylish without breaking the bank. And even if you're not a hardcore fashionista, it's still a great place to find some basics or statement pieces to add to your wardrobe.

Overall, I'm so glad I gave Last Chance a try. It was a wild ride, but it was also a lot of fun. And who knows, maybe I'll see you there on my next adventure. Just look for the girl with the big smile on her face, digging through the racks with abandon. That'll be me, living my best bargain-hunting life.

I've been to several buffets in Vegas, but Studio B stands out for its variety and quality. The service is also top-notch, with friendly staff constantly refilling drinks and clearing plates. The atmosphere is lively and modern, with large windows offering a great view of the Strip. What really impresses me, though, is the consistent improvement in their offerings. Each time I visit, I discover new dishes to love. The value for the price is unbeatable, especially considering the generous beverage options. While The Mirage remains my go-to for certain specialties, Studio B has won me over with its well-rounded selection and exceptional desserts. I'll definitely be back to try more of their creations and enjoy the welcoming ambiance. Overall, Studio B is a must-visit for anyone looking for a great buffet experience off the Strip.

As I continued to explore the Luxor, I found myself torn between appreciating its nostalgic charm and being frustrated by its inconsistencies. The casino floor, with its neon lights and 80's vibe, was definitely a hub of activity, especially at night. The variety of games and slots was impressive, and the staff were friendly and attentive. However, the overall atmosphere felt disjointed, as if the Egyptian theme was an afterthought in certain areas.

One of the highlights of my stay was the entertainment options. The Luxor has a range of shows and performances, from comedy acts to magic shows, and I was impressed by the quality of the talent. The theater itself was also well-designed, with comfortable seating and good acoustics. It's clear that the Luxor is trying to offer something for everyone, and in this regard, they succeed.

Despite the inconsistencies in design and theme, I did appreciate the Luxor's commitment to providing a range of amenities and services. The pool, as I mentioned earlier, was a highlight, and the fitness center was well-equipped and clean. The hotel also offers a range of dining options, from fine dining to casual eateries, although I found the prices to be a bit steep.

In conclusion, my stay at the Luxor was a mixed bag. While I appreciated the nostalgia and charm of the 80's-inspired decor, I was frustrated by the inconsistencies in design and theme. The guest rooms, while not the most impressive, were comfortable enough, and the pool and entertainment options were definite highlights. If you're looking for a budget-friendly option in Las Vegas with a range of amenities and services, the Luxor might be worth considering. Just be aware of the potential for smoke odors in the pyramid section, and don't expect a consistently luxurious experience. Overall, I would give the Luxor 3 out of 5 stars - it's not the best hotel in Las Vegas, but it has its charms and can be a good value for the right price.

I've already noticed a difference in my energy levels and overall fitness. The instructors are knowledgeable, supportive, and motivating, which makes a huge difference in my workout experience. They provide modifications for different fitness levels, so everyone can participate and get a great workout. The facilities are clean and well-maintained, with ample parking and convenient scheduling. I appreciate that they offer classes at various times of the day, making it easy to fit into my busy schedule. Overall, I'm really enjoying my time here and I'm excited to continue challenging myself and seeing progress. The community is friendly and welcoming, which is a great bonus. I would definitely recommend giving it a try, especially with the current Groupon offer - it's a great opportunity to experience the classes and see the results for yourself.

I'm willing to give them another chance if they reconsider their sourcing and switch to organic and non-GMO products. It's not just about the health benefits, but also about the taste and quality of the juices and prepared foods. I've had the opportunity to try similar products at other establishments that use high-quality, organic ingredients, and the difference is noticeable. The flavors are more vibrant, and the overall experience is more enjoyable.

I understand that making changes to their sourcing and supply chain may require some adjustments, but I believe it would be worth it in the long run. Not only would it attract customers who are willing to pay a premium for organic and non-GMO products, but it would also align with the values of the health-conscious community that they seem to be targeting.

Xavier's excellent customer service and knowledge of the products are definitely a plus, and I appreciate the effort he puts into making customers feel welcome. However, even his enthusiasm and expertise can't make up for the lack of quality in the products themselves. I hope the management takes customer feedback seriously and considers making some changes to improve the overall experience. Until then, I'll have to take my business (and my juice cravings) elsewhere.

I'm extremely disappointed in the lack of concern for their customer's experience. A simple apology or offer to replace the pizza would have gone a long way. Instead, their response came across as dismissive and unhelpful. The fact that they couldn't even get a basic pizza cooked through is alarming. Needless to say, I will be taking my business elsewhere and advising friends and family to do the same. The subpar food and poor customer service make it clear that this establishment is not worthy of repeat business. I expect more from a local restaurant.

It's clear that cost-cutting measures have taken priority over customer satisfaction. The lack of attention to detail and traditional touches is alarming. As a loyal customer, it's disheartening to see such significant changes. The new format falls short of expectations, leaving me wondering if I'll return. The Flo's I once loved has lost its charm and character, making today's experience a truly disappointing one.

As I sat on the phone, waiting for someone to pick up, I couldn't help but think about the subpar experience we've had so far with Arrowhead Pediatrics. The lack of signage, the rude receptionist, and the unprofessional doctor we met on our previous visit all contributed to my growing frustration. I was hoping that this next appointment would be a turning point, a chance for them to redeem themselves and show me that they truly care about their patients. But as the phone continued to ring, with no answer in sight, my doubts began to resurface.

I started to wonder if this was a systemic problem, a lack of accountability and attention to detail that permeated every aspect of their practice. The fact that they didn't even bother to let us know when to schedule a follow-up appointment, leaving us to fend for ourselves, was a major red flag. And now, as I was trying to schedule another appointment, I was being met with complete radio silence. It was as if they didn't value our time or our business.

Despite my reservations, I'm willing to give them one more chance. I want to believe that they can provide quality care for my daughter, that they can be a trusted and reliable partner in her health and wellbeing. But if this next appointment doesn't go well, if they continue to demonstrate a lack of professionalism and compassion, then I'm afraid we'll be taking our business (and our daughter's health) elsewhere. The ball is in their court, and I'm waiting to see if they'll step up to the plate and show us that they're committed to providing the best possible care for their patients.

Overall, a great dining experience with friendly staff and generous servings. Prices were reasonable, adding to the appeal. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, making it a great spot for a casual breakfast or brunch. We left feeling full and satisfied, already looking forward to our next visit to try more of their delicious offerings.

Despite the challenges, I would still highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for authentic and delicious Thai cuisine. The flavors and presentation of the dishes are exceptional, and the ambiance is truly unique and beautifully decorated. However, it's essential to be patient and clear when communicating with the staff to avoid any misunderstandings. Perhaps it would be helpful to ask for a server who speaks English fluently or to have a list of common allergens and preferences available to ensure a smooth dining experience. Overall, the outstanding quality of the food and the lovely atmosphere make it well worth the extra effort and cost.

I demanded to speak to someone higher up, but Mr. Bryant insisted that he was the highest authority I could speak to. I found this hard to believe, considering the unprofessional manner in which he and Ms. Holt conducted themselves. The lack of transparency and unwillingness to provide a simple written payoff amount is a major red flag. It's clear that Nevada Professional Collections is more interested in strong-arming people into paying than in providing a legitimate and respectful service. I would advise anyone dealing with this company to be cautious and to insist on everything being put in writing. The threats and intimidation tactics used by Mr. Bryant and Ms. Holt are unacceptable and should not be tolerated. I will be taking my business (and my complaint) elsewhere, and I hope that others will do the same. Avoid this company at all costs.

and try their unique burgers, the staff is friendly, prices are reasonable, and the overall atmosphere is welcoming, making it a great spot to grab a meal with friends or family in a lively neighborhood setting.

Overall, I'm impressed with the direction the Arts Fest is heading. The inclusion of local artists and affordable pricing options has made the event more accessible and enjoyable for attendees like myself. The addition of the beer garden was a genius move, and partnering with Penn Brewery was a great choice. The variety of food and drink options available throughout the festival was also a welcome improvement. 

I appreciated the diverse range of performances and activities, from the modern rock and indie bands to the traditional arts and crafts exhibits. The epic moment when the fountain turned on for the first time in years was truly a highlight of the event, and it's clear that the organizers are committed to creating memorable experiences for attendees. 

While there's still room for improvement, I'm excited to see how the Arts Fest will continue to evolve in the coming years. With its unique blend of art, music, and community, it has the potential to become an even more beloved and iconic event in the city. I'm looking forward to seeing what's in store for future festivals and hoping that they'll be able to expand to a full three weeks again. For now, I'm happy to have experienced the improvements firsthand and can't wait to attend again next year. With its current trajectory, I have no doubt that the Arts Fest will continue to thrive and become an essential part of the city's cultural landscape.

As I sat through the performance, I couldn't help but feel a sense of nostalgia wash over me. The show's dedication to its classic roots is admirable, and it's clear that the cast and crew are passionate about preserving the traditional Vegas spectacle. The feathers, glitter, and over-the-top costumes are all still there, and the energy of the performers is infectious. However, it's hard to shake the feeling that Jubilee! is stuck in a bygone era, and that its refusal to evolve is both its greatest strength and weakness.

Despite the show's dated elements, there are still moments of genuine brilliance. The dancing is top-notch, and the singers have impressive vocal ranges. The production values may not be as sleek and modern as some of the other shows on the strip, but there's a certain charm to the retro aesthetic. If you're looking for a taste of old-school Vegas, Jubilee! is definitely worth a visit. Just be prepared for a few cringe-worthy moments, and don't expect to be blown away by cutting-edge technology or innovative storytelling.

Ultimately, Jubilee! is a show that will appeal to a specific type of audience: those who are looking for a nostalgic trip back to the Vegas of yesteryear, or those who are simply curious about the city's rich entertainment history. While it may not be the most polished or sophisticated show on the strip, it's a true original, and its place in the pantheon of Las Vegas entertainment is secure. If you're willing to look past its flaws and embrace its retro charm, Jubilee! can still be a wildly entertaining and memorable experience.

The atmosphere of the restaurant didn't help to justify the exorbitant prices either. The decor was modern and sleek, but it felt sterile and lacked any real character. The service was friendly, but our server seemed overwhelmed and it took a while to get our orders taken. The food itself, as I mentioned earlier, was subpar compared to other sushi places I've been to. The rainbow roll was bland and lacked any real flavor, and the nigiri was nothing special. For the prices they're charging, I expect to be blown away by the quality and taste of the food, but that wasn't the case here.

Overall, I think Uni is making a big mistake by pricing themselves out of the market. Surprise is a family-friendly community with a lot of affordable dining options, and Uni's prices are just not competitive. Unless they revamp their menu and pricing strategy, I don't see them lasting long in this location. As it stands, I would not recommend Uni to anyone looking for good sushi at a reasonable price. There are far better options available in the West Valley, and I will definitely be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere.

The level of incompetence and disrespect shown by the staff is appalling. The owner's attitude is completely unacceptable and reflects poorly on the entire establishment. It's clear that they don't value their customers or care about providing a decent experience. I've never been so disgusted with a business in my life. The fact that they're now located near my family's homes is a nuisance and a constant reminder of their horrible service. I will continue to take my business elsewhere and encourage others to do the same.

Overall, I'd recommend this spot for families with young children, as the treehouse playground is a unique feature. However, for adults, it's an average experience. The live music and shaded areas are a plus, but the heat and noise from the metal containers can be overwhelming. With a few tweaks to address these issues, this place could become a top destination for all ages. As it stands, it's a solid choice for a casual, kid-friendly outing in the downtown area, but not necessarily a must-visit for adults looking for something more exciting.

The overall experience is quick, efficient, and leaves your car sparkling. The staff are friendly and courteous, making sure you're satisfied with the service. I've tried both the hand-wash and machine options, and while the hand-wash is thorough, the machine is definitely the more exciting choice. The multicoloured foam is a nice touch, adding a bit of fun to the car wash experience. For the price, you can't complain - it's a great value for the quality of service you receive. Whether you're a car enthusiast or just need a quick clean, Imo is definitely the way to go.
Prices are reasonable, and the staff is friendly, making it an excellent spot to cure a hangover and satisfy late-night cravings with their delicious and filling meals always.

The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, with friendly staff who seem to genuinely care about the customer experience. Prices are very reasonable, especially considering the high-quality ingredients used. I've tried the Apple Pancake and the German Pancake, both of which were cooked to perfection and bursting with flavor. The fresh squeezed juice is a nice touch, and the coffee is some of the best I've had at a breakfast spot. Overall, I'm so impressed with this hidden gem and can't wait to come back and try more of the menu items. It's a must-visit for breakfast lovers in the area.
Total waste of money and time, extremely disappointed with the whole experience, would not recommend to anyone, and will never be back, the lack of professionalism is appalling.

I'm so impressed with the quality and flavor of the meats we purchased. The fact that it's locally sourced and supporting the Arizona community is a huge plus. Paul's expertise and recommendations were invaluable, and I appreciate the time he took to answer our questions. The prices were very reasonable, especially considering the high quality of the products. I'm already planning our next visit to stock up on more of their delicious meats. The slow-cooked shoulder is next on the menu, and I have no doubt it will be just as tender and flavorful as the chops we had tonight. Overall, I highly recommend this butcher shop to anyone looking for fresh, wholesome, and locally grown meats.

I was thoroughly impressed with the flexibility of their menu and the willingness of the staff to accommodate different dietary preferences. The atmosphere of the cafe is cozy and inviting, making it the perfect spot to catch up with friends or enjoy a quiet evening out. The fact that they allow customers to linger after hours and continue chatting is a testament to their commitment to providing a warm and welcoming experience.

The quality of the food is exceptional, with each dish carefully prepared to ensure maximum flavor without relying on excessive salt or processed ingredients. I appreciated the variety of options available, including vegan and vegetarian choices, and the fact that they can modify dishes to suit individual tastes. The use of alternative ingredients, such as PB2 or powdered soy milk, is a great example of their dedication to providing healthy and delicious options.

Overall, I highly recommend this cafe to anyone looking for a great dining experience. The combination of excellent food, outstanding service, and cozy atmosphere makes it a standout establishment. Don't be put off by negative reviews from those who may be used to more processed or salty foods – this cafe is a gem that is well worth visiting. With its relaxed vibe and flexible menu, it's the perfect spot to unwind and enjoy a delicious meal with friends or family.

but don't expect much else. Basic amenities, no frills. Suitable for a short, budget-friendly stay, but not ideal for those seeking a more comfortable experience with reliable services and friendly staff. Prices are the main draw, making it an acceptable choice for travelers on a tight budget.
Needless to say, I won't be returning anytime soon, and I'd advise others to think twice before dining here, as the subpar quality isn't worth the hefty price tag, leaving a sour taste.

The presentation was impressive, and the quality of the food exceeded our expectations. Every entree was packed with flavor, and the portion sizes were generous. The walnut shrimp was a nice touch, and it was clear that the chef took pride in their work. The house lo mein and fried rice were also cooked to perfection, with just the right amount of seasoning. The service was top-notch, and the drivers who delivered our order were friendly and efficient. Overall, we were thoroughly impressed with this place, and we can't wait to order from them again. The value for the price was unbeatable, and we're already planning our next Chinese food party with them.

I've had multiple disappointing experiences with the service team, and it's clear that their priorities lie elsewhere. The lack of accountability and transparency is staggering, with constant excuses and unfulfilled promises. As a luxury car owner, I expect a certain level of service, but University Volvo consistently falls short. Their inability to deliver on warranty work and basic customer service is a reflection of the dealership's overall incompetence. It's disappointing to see a reputable brand like Volvo tarnished by such a subpar dealership. I would not recommend University Volvo to anyone. One star is even too generous.

The combination of flavors and textures in the dish was absolute perfection, with the tender steak, creamy spinach, and sweet pork belly all working together in harmony. The portion size was generous, and I left feeling satisfied but not overly full. Our waitress was attentive and knowledgeable, happily answering our questions about the menu and making excellent recommendations. The atmosphere of the restaurant was also noteworthy, with a cozy and intimate setting that made for a lovely evening out. Overall, I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a exceptional dining experience in Las Vegas, and I look forward to returning on my next visit.

The atmosphere of Meat & Potatoes is equally impressive, with a modern and sleek decor that exudes a sense of sophistication. The bar area is particularly inviting, with a extensive selection of craft cocktails and brown spirits that are expertly crafted by the knowledgeable bartenders. The service is also top-notch, with friendly and attentive staff who are always happy to offer recommendations or answer questions about the menu. One of the things that really sets Meat & Potatoes apart from other restaurants is its consistency - every time I visit, I know that I can expect a high-quality dining experience with creative and delicious dishes. Whether I'm in the mood for something classic and comforting or adventurous and new, Meat & Potatoes always delivers. With its outstanding food, drink, and service, it's no wonder that this restaurant has become my go-to spot in downtown Pittsburgh.

As we walked out, I couldn't help but think about the multitude of amazing Cuban restaurants I've had the pleasure of dining at, and how this place fell woefully short. The lack of authenticity and care in the preparation of the dishes was staggering. It's not just about throwing some ingredients together and calling it a day; Cuban cuisine is about passion, about love, about the bold flavors and aromas that transport you to the vibrant streets of Havana.

The Havana Cafe's attempt at recreating this magic was nothing short of laughable. The service, while friendly, seemed apathetic, as if they knew the food was subpar and were just going through the motions. The atmosphere, with its plastic chairs and bland decor, did little to enhance the overall experience. It felt like a half-hearted attempt at creating a Cuban-inspired eatery, without any real understanding of the culture or the cuisine.

Needless to say, we won't be returning to the Havana Cafe anytime soon. If you're looking for a genuine Cuban dining experience, keep looking. This place is a disappointment, and even with a Groupon, it's not worth the hassle. Save your taste buds the trouble and opt for a different restaurant that actually cares about serving up delicious, authentic cuisine. One star from me, and that's being generous.

Overpriced menu items detracted from the overall experience. While the server was attentive, the high cost outweighed the decent food quality, making it unlikely for us to return and recommend to others seeking better value for their money.

I'm shocked that the management team hasn't taken any concrete steps to address the plethora of issues plaguing this apartment complex. It's astonishing to think that they're aware of the problems, yet seem to be turning a blind eye. The lack of security, the rampant noise disturbances, and the blatant disregard for community rules all contribute to a toxic living environment. As a resident, I expect a certain level of respect and consideration from my neighbors, but that's just not the case here.

The amenities that were once a major draw for us, such as the gym and pool, are now rarely usable due to the rowdy behavior of some residents. I've witnessed people blasting music and having impromptu parties by the pool, completely disrupting the peaceful atmosphere that one would expect. The gym equipment is often broken or in disrepair, and the entire area is frequently littered with trash and debris. It's clear that the management team is not prioritizing the upkeep and maintenance of these amenities, which is a major disappointment.

What's even more disconcerting is the complete lack of accountability among residents. When incidents occur, such as vandalism or noise complaints, there seems to be no consequences for the perpetrators. It's as if the management team is more concerned with collecting rent checks than with ensuring the well-being and safety of their residents. This lack of accountability has created a culture of entitlement and disrespect, where residents feel they can do as they please without facing any repercussions.

As I look around at the other residents, I notice that many of them seem to be just as fed up as I am. There's a sense of resignation in the air, as if people have given up on the idea of this being a pleasant place to live. I've tried to talk to some of my neighbors about the issues, but many of them just shrug it off and say that it's always been this way. It's heartbreaking to think that people have become so desensitized to the chaos and disorder that they've lost hope for a better living situation.

In contrast, my experience at Camden was vastly different. While it was by no means perfect, the management team was responsive to concerns, and the community felt more like a community. There were events and activities that brought residents together, and a sense of camaraderie that is sorely lacking here. I never thought I'd say this, but Camden now seems like a paradise compared to this place.

As I count down the days until we can move out, I'm left wondering how this apartment complex went so wrong. Was it a lack of oversight, a failure to screen residents, or simply a matter of poor management? Whatever the reason, it's clear that something needs to change. Until then, I'll be stuck in this chaotic and uncomfortable living situation, waiting for the day when we can escape and start fresh in a new, more peaceful community. To anyone considering moving here, I would strongly advise against it. Trust me, you don't want to end up like me, feeling trapped and miserable in a place that's supposed to be your home.

stick to the drinks and enjoy the view. The service was friendly, but the mistakes with the menu and food preparation were disappointing. For a place with such a great atmosphere, it's a shame the food doesn't live up to the standards. Perhaps they've changed chefs or recipes since my last visit, but it's clear they need to revamp their vegetarian options and quality control. Until then, I'd advise others to dine elsewhere and just pop in for a drink to appreciate the lovely terrace and views. Disappointing experience overall, sadly.

I'm just really disappointed because I was expecting so much more from this place, especially with all the rave reviews. The specialty rolls didn't impress me either, they lacked flavor and creativity. I mean, I've had better sushi at smaller, lesser-known places. The prices were also a bit steep for the quality of food they were serving. I'm not asking for much, just fresh ingredients, good presentation, and most importantly, delicious taste. Unfortunately, this place fell short on most of those aspects. Maybe I just caught them on a bad day, but I've been to plenty of other sushi places that have consistently delivered. I do appreciate the friendly service, though - our server was attentive and polite. Overall, I think this place relies too heavily on its reputation and not enough on actually serving high-quality food. I hope they take feedback like mine to heart and make some improvements, but for now, I wouldn't recommend it to fellow sushi lovers.

In fact, the atmosphere of the restaurant is quite inviting, making it a great spot to grab a casual meal. The prices are also reasonable, which is a bonus. Although the fried rice was not outstanding, it was still enjoyable, and the portion size was generous. The staff's friendly demeanor and welcoming attitude made up for any lack of culinary expertise in non-sushi dishes. Overall, Sushi 101 seems like a great place to try, even for a sushi novice like myself. I'm looking forward to going back and trying some of their signature sushi rolls to see if they live up to the restaurant's name.

Overall, the subpar food quality and lack of amenities, combined with the high prices, make it an unappealing option. There are better choices nearby that offer more value for the money. The tough and burnt meat was a major turnoff, and the dryness of the food didn't help. For a place that relies on its food, this establishment falls short, making it unlikely to attract repeat customers like myself.

Overall, my experience at Gecko was underwhelming, considering all the rave reviews I had heard. The atmosphere was lively and the service was attentive, but the food just didn't live up to my expectations. I was looking forward to trying their fajitas, but the small shrimp and lackluster salsa made it a disappointing dish. The "sweet salsa" was an interesting touch, but it didn't quite work for me. I was surprised that they didn't have any hot sauces available, as I like to add a bit of heat to my meals. My wife's burrito, on the other hand, seemed to be a hit, so I'm willing to give Gecko another try in the future and see if their other dishes fare any better. Perhaps I just ordered the wrong thing, and I'm hoping that next time will be a more positive experience.

As I sat in my car, inspecting my order and feeling utterly underwhelmed, I couldn't help but think about the overall experience I had just endured. The lengthy wait to place my order, the confusing pickup process, and the subpar food quality all combined to leave a sour taste in my mouth. I had been looking forward to a quick and satisfying dinner, but what I got was a frustrating and overpriced meal.

The BLT itself was, as I mentioned, good. The flavors were there, and the lettuce and tomato were fresh. But the bacon, or rather, the lack thereof, was a major letdown. Two small pieces of bacon, roughly the size of a postage stamp, were not what I expected from a restaurant that prides itself on its gourmet burgers and sandwiches. And the French fries, or rather, the handful of fry nubs I received, were an insult. It's not like I'm asking for a bucket of fries, but a decent serving size would be nice.

What's even more disappointing is that this experience has left a bad taste in my mouth, literally and figuratively. I've been to this Red Robin location before, and while it's always been busy, the service has never been this bad. It seems like they're struggling to keep up with demand, and it's affecting the quality of their food and service. I'm not sure if it's a staffing issue or a management problem, but something needs to change.

As I finished writing this review, I was tempted to give them 2 stars, but I'm settling on 3. The food, when it's good, is really good. But the experience, from start to finish, was a nightmare. If you're going to offer a to-go service, you need to staff your phone lines and have a clear pickup process. And if you're going to charge premium prices, you need to deliver premium quality. Until they get these issues sorted out, I'll be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere.

In conclusion, my experience at Red Robin was a disappointment, to say the least. While the food has the potential to be great, the service and overall experience fell short. I hope that the management takes my feedback to heart and makes some changes to improve their to-go service and food quality. Until then, I would caution others to think twice before ordering from this location. With a little bit of effort, Red Robin could be a great place to grab a bite, but for now, it's just not worth the hassle.

Overall, the combination was perfect. The crust was crispy and held up well to the toppings. I'm already looking forward to trying more of their menu items. The service was also friendly and efficient, making for a great overall experience. I highly recommend this place for a delicious and satisfying pizza.

I was really looking forward to savoring the Sea Bass, but the undercooked fish was a major letdown. Despite the server's prompt response in remaking the dish, the damage was already done. The fact that the manager only comped us for the Bass, without offering any additional compensation or gesture of goodwill, left a sour taste in my mouth. It seemed like a half-hearted attempt to rectify the situation. For a restaurant that prides itself on serving high-quality dishes, this experience fell short of my expectations. The shrimp cocktail and salad were indeed delicious, but they weren't enough to make up for the disappointment of the Sea Bass. As I reflected on the evening, I couldn't help but feel that the restaurant missed an opportunity to turn a negative experience into a positive one. A complimentary dessert or a discount on our next visit would have gone a long way in showing that they valued our business and were committed to making things right. Instead, I left feeling like I'd overpaid for a subpar experience, and I'm not sure if I'll be back to give them another chance.

We ended up trying a few different options, including a custom-made juice with turmeric and ginger, which was absolutely amazing. The atmosphere of the place was also very cozy and inviting, making it a great pit stop on our road trip. Kim's excellent customer service and the delicious juices made our experience truly stand out. We left feeling refreshed and rejuvenated, ready to tackle the rest of our journey. I highly recommend Grass Roots to anyone looking for a healthy and tasty pick-me-up on the go!

The staff was friendly, prices reasonable, and atmosphere cozy. Perfect for a quick bite or meeting spot, I'd definitely consider returning, perhaps with my friend this time, to try more of their menu options and enjoy the casual vibe.

The sheer lack of quality and variety was staggering, and it's clear that the establishment is prioritizing quantity over quality. The atmosphere was also lacking, with a crowded and noisy dining area that made it difficult to enjoy what little decent food they had. Our server seemed overwhelmed and inattentive, which didn't help to improve the overall experience. As I looked around, I noticed that many of the other patrons seemed just as unimpressed as I was, with many plates left unfinished and a general air of disappointment. The fact that this buffet has received good reviews is baffling, and I can only assume that those reviewers had extremely low expectations or were somehow able to find a hidden gem that I missed. Overall, my experience was a resounding disappointment, and I would strongly advise against wasting your time and money on this subpar buffet.

The combination of flavors and generous toppings makes each bite a delight. Friendly service and cozy atmosphere add to the experience, making this pizzeria a must-visit for pizza lovers. Overall, a fantastic dining experience that I highly recommend, with plans to return soon.

Overall, I'd recommend this place for a casual, satisfying meal, but be prepared for a wait and a higher price point. The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it a great spot to catch up with friends or enjoy a relaxing dinner. While it may not be the best option for those on a tight budget or in a hurry, the quality of the burgers and toppings makes it a worthwhile choice for those seeking a homemade taste. Just be aware of the trade-offs and plan accordingly, as the nearby fast food options may be a more convenient alternative for some.
Great atmosphere and friendly staff, making it a wonderful spot to enjoy delicious food and entertainment with family and friends always.

As I sat down to enjoy my less-than-satisfactory pizza, I couldn't help but feel a sense of disappointment and frustration. The atmosphere of the restaurant, which was once welcoming and inviting, now felt cold and unwelcoming. The fact that the clerk had gone out of her way to impress the 30-something man, while treating me with disdain, was not only unprofessional but also made me feel like I was somehow inferior.

I took a bite of my pizza, and the flavors were lackluster. The crust was soggy, and the toppings were sparse, as I mentioned earlier. It was clear that the restaurant was prioritizing profit over quality and customer satisfaction. I thought back to my previous visits, when the food was delicious and the service was friendly. What had changed? Had the management changed, or had the staff simply become complacent?

As I finished my meal and prepared to leave, I noticed the young female manager, who was still training the new staff member, glance over at me with a hint of disdain. It was as if she was thinking, "Oh, you're that person who didn't get the special treatment." I felt a surge of anger and frustration, but I decided not to confront her. Instead, I quietly got up and left, making sure to leave no tip and no positive review.

It's disappointing to see a restaurant that was once a favorite of mine decline in quality and service. The fact that the staff seems to be more interested in impressing certain customers, rather than providing good service to all, is a major turn-off. I hope that the management will take my review to heart and make some changes, but until then, I will be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere.

In conclusion, my recent experience at this restaurant was a disappointment from start to finish. The food was subpar, the service was condescending and judgmental, and the atmosphere was unwelcoming. Unless significant changes are made, I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone. There are plenty of other options in the area that offer better food, better service, and a more welcoming atmosphere. It's time for this restaurant to step up its game and prioritize customer satisfaction, or risk losing loyal customers like me.

As I sat there, surrounded by the lively atmosphere and the sounds of traditional German music, I couldn't help but feel like I was in a authentic Bavarian beer hall. The decor, complete with wooden tables and chairs, dim lighting, and German flags, added to the ambiance. Our waitress, dressed in her traditional Dirndl, was friendly and attentive, even if she was a bit busy doling out spankings to the brave (or foolhardy) souls who dared to order the infamous shot.

Despite the kitschy spanking ritual, the overall vibe of the place was lively and fun, with a mix of locals and tourists alike letting loose and enjoying themselves. The beer selection was impressive, with a wide range of German brews to choose from, and the pretzels and cheese dip were a delicious accompaniment to our drinks. If you're a fan of German beer and atmosphere, this is definitely a place worth checking out. Just don't go in with high expectations for the food, and you'll be golden. Prost! 

I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a unique and entertaining night out, but maybe not for a romantic dinner or a quiet evening. The noise level can get pretty high, especially when the band is playing, and the spanking ritual can be a bit much for some people. But if you're looking for a fun and lively spot to grab a drink and enjoy some German culture, this is the place to be. So grab a stein, order a pretzel, and get ready to party like you're in Munich!

The combination of flavors was delightful, with the sage dressing adding a savory note and the sweet chili sauce providing a touch of heat. The ginger beer complemented the meal nicely, cutting through the richness of the pork. Overall, I was impressed with Oink's offerings and would definitely return to try more of their creative dishes, all while enjoying the quirky pig-themed decor.

The food is also subpar, often cold and lacking the freshness you'd expect from a fast food chain. It's clear that the staff is overwhelmed and understaffed, leading to a frustrating experience for customers. I've tried giving them the benefit of the doubt multiple times, but the consistent poor service has led me to take my business elsewhere. Unless they revamp their staff and customer service, I wouldn't recommend this location to anyone, and would advise others to seek out a more welcoming Jack in the Box.

As I've gotten to know the staff, I've noticed that the late-night crew, particularly the cook, takes pride in their work, and it shows in the quality of the food. The shrimp burrito is always packed with succulent shrimp, and the fish tacos are crispy and flavorful. The carne asada burrito is a staple, and the al pastor nachos are a game-changer. I've tried other items on the menu, but these are my go-to orders. The aguas frescas are also a highlight, with a wide variety of flavors to choose from. However, as much as I love the food and the late-night staff, I have to deduct stars for the location, which can be a bit sketchy at night, and the lack of cleanliness, which is noticeable, especially during the day. The inconsistency in service and food quality between the morning and evening staff is also a concern. Despite these drawbacks, I still find myself coming back for the delicious food and friendly late-night service. If they could improve on these areas, I'd gladly give them a full 5 stars. For now, I'll continue to enjoy my late-night Mexican food fix and hope that they'll take my feedback to heart. Overall, it's a great option for a quick, tasty bite, but be aware of the potential drawbacks.

As we left the store, I couldn't help but feel frustrated and disappointed with the entire experience. The lack of quality control, combined with the poor customer service, made for a disastrous visit. It's clear that the staff, particularly Saul, are not trained to handle customer complaints or issues in a professional manner. The fact that he became defensive and accusatory when I brought up my concerns was appalling.

The atmosphere of the store didn't help either. The loud music and lack of adult supervision made it feel more like a chaotic hangout spot for teenagers rather than a welcoming place for customers of all ages. The fact that the staff were playing their own music in the back room and drowning out the store's sounds was not only annoying but also unprofessional.

What's even more disturbing is that Saul seemed to be more interested in asserting his authority and proving a point rather than listening to customer feedback and trying to resolve the issue. His attitude and behavior were a perfect example of how not to provide good customer service. As a paying customer, I expect to be treated with respect and courtesy, especially when I'm trying to bring a problem to the attention of the staff.

Overall, my experience at U-Swirl was a disaster from start to finish. The poor quality of the ice cream, combined with the terrible customer service, makes it unlikely that I will ever return to this store again. Unless the management takes serious steps to address these issues and provide better training to their staff, I would not recommend U-Swirl to anyone. With so many other ice cream shops and frozen yogurt places to choose from, there's no reason to settle for subpar quality and service.

The inefficiency of this location is astounding. The staff seems overwhelmed and understaffed, leading to unnecessarily long wait times. I've experienced this at other DMV locations as well, but Mesa's location takes the cake. The fact that I was able to show proof of insurance without being given a number and waiting even longer was pure luck. I've learned my lesson and will make the extra effort to visit a different location, even if it's farther away. The stress and frustration of dealing with this location are not worth the convenience of proximity. I would not recommend the Mesa DMV location to anyone, and I will be taking my business (and my patience) elsewhere. Overall, my experience was disappointing and frustrating, and I hope that the ADOT will take steps to improve the efficiency and customer service at this location.
Great atmosphere and friendly staff, making it a perfect spot to relax and enjoy a meal at any hour, with the soothing sound of the waterfall adding to the ambiance.

The ingredients were fresh, and the flavors complemented each other well. Overall, a great dining experience with excellent food and ambiance, making it an ideal spot for a relaxing Sunday morning breakfast with family or friends.

The lack of attention to our reservation and the subsequent wait was frustrating enough, but the subpar food and poor service only added to our disappointment. It's unacceptable for a restaurant to not honor a reservation, especially for a large group celebrating a special occasion. The fact that the staff seemed unapologetic and unaccommodating made the experience even more infuriating. The suggestion to stand and eat off to the side was not only impractical but also insulting, especially considering we had made a reservation in advance.

The new pizza menu was a letdown, and the removal of the BBQ pizza was a mistake. The few pizzas we ordered were hit or miss, with only the Margherita pizza being worth the price. The over-salting of the other pizzas and the underwhelming presentation of the bacon and eggs pizza were major disappointments. The fact that the egg yolk was hard and not runny, as expected, was a minor but telling detail that spoke to the kitchen's lack of attention to detail.

Overall, our experience was a disaster from start to finish. The combination of poor service, subpar food, and lack of accountability has left a sour taste in our mouths. Unless they revamp their reservation system, menu, and service, we will not be returning to this restaurant for weekday late nights. A simple gesture of goodwill, such as a complimentary drink or dessert, would have gone a long way in mitigating the damage, but alas, that was not to be. Needless to say, our birthday celebration was not the memorable experience we had hoped for.

Overall, it was an enjoyable evening, but not worth the full price. The show's energy was high, and the performers were talented, but it didn't exceed my expectations. My parents, however, were thoroughly entertained and thought it was worth every penny. If you can get discounted tickets, it's definitely worth considering, but be cautious of the full-priced tickets, as they may not provide the same value.

The atmosphere is casual and lively, making it a great spot to catch a game or meet up with friends. The drink selection is decent, with a variety of beers and cocktails available. Overall, Gin Mill is a reliable choice for a low-key night out in Southend, just don't expect anything fancy and be prepared for a lively crowd.

The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, making it perfect for a night out with friends. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, helping to guide you through the menu. With its unique sharing concept and delicious dishes, I highly recommend this place to anyone looking to mix things up and try something new. Overall, I'm hooked and will definitely be back for more.

As we continued to enjoy our time at Stripper Bar, we noticed the unique dynamic between the staff and the patrons. Everyone seemed to be having a great time, and the atmosphere was lively and welcoming. The strip lessons that started after the game were definitely a highlight, and it was impressive to see the staff's energy and enthusiasm. We even participated in a few lessons, which added to the overall entertainment value of our visit.

The prices at Stripper Bar were also a major plus, with affordable drinks and food options that didn't break the bank. The bucket of beers for $15 was an exceptional deal, and the chips and salsa and chicken strips we ordered were tasty and satisfying. The service was top-notch, with Tara and the other staff member always attentive and friendly.

Overall, our experience at Stripper Bar was a pleasant surprise, especially after being rejected by Blondie's across the way. We appreciated the warm welcome and the effort the staff put into making sure we had a good time. With its convenient location in the mall, affordable prices, and entertaining atmosphere, Stripper Bar is definitely a spot we'll be returning to in the future. Whether you're looking for a fun place to watch a game or just want to grab a drink and enjoy some lively entertainment, Stripper Bar is worth checking out.
The selection is also limited, making it an overall disappointing experience, not worth the expensive prices or rude staff, go elsewhere for better quality and service.

As we sat in our hotel room, savoring the last bites of our lunch, I couldn't help but think that Olive et Gourmando had truly outdone themselves. The combination of flavors, textures, and presentation was spot on, and the chaotic atmosphere only added to the charm. It's clear that this place is a labor of love, and the attention to detail is evident in every aspect of the dining experience.

One of the things that really stood out to me was the quality of the ingredients. The brie was creamy and rich, the caramelized onions were sweet and depthful, and the braised pork in the Cuban sandwich was tender and full of flavor. You can tell that the chefs at Olive et Gourmando are passionate about using only the best ingredients, and it makes all the difference in the world.

I also appreciated the creativity of the menu. The combination of flavors and ingredients in each sandwich was unique and exciting, and the presentation was beautiful. The fact that they were willing to think outside the box and try new things is refreshing, and it's clear that they're not afraid to take risks.

Of course, no review of Olive et Gourmando would be complete without mentioning the famous triple chocolate cookie. Oh. My. God. This cookie is a game-changer. The generous amounts of real chocolate chips are perfectly balanced by the richness of the cookie itself, and the texture is perfect. It's chewy, but not too chewy, and it's clear that the chefs have put a lot of thought into getting the recipe just right.

As we finished up our lunch and prepared to head out for the rest of the day, I couldn't help but feel grateful for the experience. Olive et Gourmando is truly a special place, and it's clear that they're dedicated to providing their customers with an exceptional dining experience. If you're in the Old Port area, do yourself a favor and stop by. Trust me, you won't be disappointed.

In fact, I would go so far as to say that Olive et Gourmando has set the bar high for all future dining experiences. The combination of delicious food, charming atmosphere, and exceptional service is a tough act to follow, and I have a feeling that we'll be comparing all future meals to this one. But hey, that's not a bad problem to have.

All in all, I would highly recommend Olive et Gourmando to anyone looking for a unique and delicious dining experience. It's a must-try if you're in the area, and it's clear that the chefs and staff are dedicated to providing their customers with an exceptional experience. So go ahead, brave the chaos, and get ready for a truly unforgettable meal. Your taste buds will thank you.

As I continued to browse through the store, I couldn't help but feel a sense of disappointment and frustration with the encounter I had just experienced. The rest of the store seemed to be running smoothly, with friendly and helpful staff in other departments. However, the men's suits area was a different story altogether. The salesman's attitude and behavior were completely unacceptable, and it's not what I expect from a retailer like Macy's. I understand that mistakes can happen, but it's how they're handled that matters. In this case, the situation was handled poorly, and it left a bad taste in my mouth.

I ended up finding a new pair of pants to replace the ones with the broken zipper, but the experience was tainted by the interaction with the salesman. I hope that in the future, Macy's will take steps to ensure that their staff provides excellent customer service, regardless of the situation. A simple bottle of water may seem like a small thing, but it's the principle of the matter that counts. As a customer, I expect to be treated with respect and kindness, even if my request is denied. Unfortunately, my experience at the Macy's men's suits area fell short of those expectations, and I will be taking my business elsewhere.
Prices are reasonable, but the overall experience lacks a memorable touch, leaving me underwhelmed and unlikely to return anytime soon for another lackluster dinner.
Overhyped and underwhelming experience, lacking authenticity and value, making it a disappointing choice for bagel enthusiasts, ultimately doomed by poor business decisions.

Overall, our experience at this restaurant was a letdown, especially considering their claim of being a BBQ joint. The atmosphere, although unique and entertaining for kids, couldn't make up for the subpar food. I appreciate the effort to create a fun environment, but it's essential to deliver on the culinary front, especially when advertising a specific type of cuisine. The friendly waitress was a notable exception, providing attentive service despite the kitchen's shortcomings. If they revamped their menu to focus on a few key items and improved the quality of their BBQ, I might consider giving them another chance. As it stands, I would not recommend this spot to anyone seeking authentic BBQ. Perhaps they could cater more to their apparent strength in comfort food, like the mac and cheese, and abandon the BBQ pretenses. Until then, I'll take my BBQ cravings (and my family) elsewhere.

The variety of activities kept everyone entertained, and the staff were friendly and helpful. We spent hours here and still didn't get to try everything. The prices were reasonable, especially considering the range of options available. Overall, it was a great way to spend a sunny day with family and friends, and we would definitely return for another fun-filled visit.

I was extremely disappointed in the way the situation was handled, as it seemed like an attempted scam. The lack of transparency and communication from the manager was unprofessional. I had been enjoying my meal and was willing to leave a generous tip, but the shady behavior at the end left a bad taste in my mouth. The waiter seemed unaware of the issue and was friendly, but the manager's actions overshadowed the positive aspects of my visit. Unfortunately, this experience has made me hesitant to return to this establishment. The food may be good, but trust is essential.

I was thoroughly unimpressed with the way Travis handled my concerns, and it's clear that the hotel's priorities lie in maintaining a false image rather than actually addressing the problems. The fact that he tried to justify their four-star rating by listing amenities like suites, restaurants, and a spa, while acknowledging that their standard rooms are subpar, speaks volumes about their values. It's laughable that they think having a spa and restaurant automatically warrants a four-star rating, regardless of the quality of their rooms.

The attempt to deflect my criticism by suggesting that I must be mistaken about the mold and mildew was also telling. If they're so confident in their cleaning schedule, why did Travis eventually admit that it was indeed mildew? It's clear that they're more interested in saving face than in taking genuine steps to improve their guests' experiences. The suggestion that I should call Travis directly to book a room, despite the fact that I'd just expressed my disgust with the conditions, was the final nail in the coffin. Needless to say, I will be taking my business (and my star rating) elsewhere. The Hyatt and La Quinta are looking like much more appealing options, with their comparable room quality, better amenities, and lack of resort fees. One star is even too generous for this hotel – if I could, I'd give them a big fat zero.
Rude staff can really ruin the dining experience, making the good food irrelevant and leaving a bad impression that's hard to shake.

Maybe it was just an off day, but the lack of attention was noticeable. I've been to many restaurants with excellent service, so this experience stood out. Despite the delicious food, the subpar service left a sour taste. I hope they'll work on providing more equal and attentive service to all customers, regardless of background.

Overall, our experience at this steak house was a mixed bag. While the steaks were indeed tasty, the inconsistency in cooking them to our desired level of doneness was a letdown. The great sides and decent bread basket were notable highlights, but the subpar service really detracted from our overall enjoyment. For a high-end establishment, we expected more attentive and patient wait staff. Our waitress's rushed demeanor and apparent disinterest in addressing our questions made us feel like we were an inconvenience. Given the hefty price tag, we anticipated a more refined and accommodating experience. Unfortunately, this steak house fell short of our expectations, leaving us uncertain about whether we'd return in the future.

The beds were uncomfortable and the noise from the highway was noticeable. Overall, the cons outweigh the pros, making it an overpriced option for the quality provided. Unless significant changes are made, I would not recommend staying here, especially with other nearby hotels offering better amenities and services.

I'm still fuming as I write this review, recalling the disastrous experience my party and I had at this establishment. The lack of greeting, the confusion over seating, and the disappearance of our waiter set the tone for a meal that was subpar in every aspect. The fact that our order was incorrect and our side dishes arrived at the end of the meal was just the beginning. The food itself was a major letdown - the beans tasted like they came straight from a can, and the tacos were no better than what you'd find at a fast-food chain like Del Taco.

What's even more astonishing is that a place that claims to serve authentic, flavorful cuisine can't even get the basics right. The lack of flavor in every dish was staggering, and the presentation was lackluster at best. It's clear that the kitchen is not taking any pride in their work, and the food is suffering as a result.

But the service - or rather, the lack thereof - was the final nail in the coffin. Our waiter's disappearance was baffling, and the fact that we had to flag down the busboy to get any attention at all was embarrassing. When I finally got up to pay the bill at the front of the restaurant, I was met with a dismissive owner who seemed completely unbothered by our horrible experience. The fact that our waiter magically reappeared as we were leaving, only to present us with a revised bill, was just a slap in the face.

The cherry on top of this disastrous experience was the food poisoning I contracted, which I'm still recovering from as I write this review. It's inexcusable that a restaurant can't even ensure the safety of their food, let alone provide decent service and cuisine. My advice to anyone considering dining at this establishment is to steer clear - there are far better places to spend your money, where the food is delicious, the service is attentive, and the overall experience is enjoyable. Don't make the same mistake I did - avoid this place at all costs. The owner's lack of concern and the waiter's ineptitude are a clear indication that this restaurant is not worth your time or money. Save yourself the hassle and the risk of food poisoning - DONT GO HERE!

As I reflected on my dining experience, I realized that the simplicity of the venue actually added to the overall charm of the place. The lack of distractions allowed me to focus on the food, which was undoubtedly the star of the show. The pulled pork, in particular, was a revelation - the smoky flavor and tender texture were a perfect combination. I appreciated that the chef didn't rely on sauces to mask the flavor of the meat, instead letting the quality of the ingredients shine through.

The waffle fries, too, were a highlight of the meal. The seasoning was spot on, and the crispy exterior gave way to a fluffy interior that was simply addictive. I could easily see myself ordering a double portion of these on my next visit, as I mentioned earlier. The mac'n cheese, while not as show-stopping as the pulled pork or waffle fries, was still a solid side dish that complemented the rest of the meal nicely.

One of the things that impressed me most about Pork on a Fork was the clear attention to detail in the kitchen. From the perfectly cooked pulled pork to the crispy waffle fries, it was clear that the chef was dedicated to serving up high-quality dishes. This attention to detail extended to the mac'n cheese, which, as I mentioned earlier, was clearly made in-house rather than relying on a pre-made supplier.

In terms of value, I was more than happy to pay the $11 for my meal. The portion sizes were generous, and the quality of the food was well worth the price. As I mentioned earlier, you can certainly find cheaper options elsewhere, but you get what you pay for. In this case, the extra few dollars were well worth it for the delicious, satisfying meal I enjoyed.

Overall, I'm so glad I stumbled upon Pork on a Fork. It's clear that the restaurant is dedicated to serving up delicious, high-quality barbecue, and I'm excited to go back and try more of the menu items. Whether you're a barbecue aficionado or just looking for a tasty, satisfying meal, Pork on a Fork is definitely worth a visit. I'll be back soon to try more of the menu and see if the restaurant can continue to impress!

I am absolutely appalled and disappointed by the experience I had with this groomer. Not only did they seem to have inconsistent pricing and poor record-keeping, but they also apparently caused harm to my dog. The fact that my 6-pound dog came out of there with a severe skin infection that required two trips to the vet and medication is unacceptable. As a pet owner, it's my responsibility to ensure my dogs receive the best care possible, and this groomer failed to meet those expectations.

What's even more disturbing is that my vet informed me that this is not an isolated incident, and they've had another complaint about this groomer before. This raises serious concerns about the groomer's hygiene and sanitation practices, as well as their ability to handle dogs with care and compassion. The fact that they seemed more concerned with defending their business practices than taking responsibility for their actions and apologizing for the harm caused to my dog is appalling.

I want to warn other pet owners about the potential risks of taking their dogs to this groomer. The initial low prices may seem appealing, but the consequences can be severe and long-lasting. I will never take my dogs back to this groomer, and I would advise others to think twice before doing so. The health and well-being of our pets are too important to be taken lightly, and we deserve better than a groomer who seems to prioritize their own interests over the care and safety of the animals in their charge. I hope that by sharing my experience, I can prevent others from going through the same ordeal and help them make informed decisions about their pet's care.

Overall, we were satisfied with our dining experience. The prices were reasonable and the portion sizes were generous. Our server was attentive and friendly, ensuring that our glasses were always full. The restaurant's atmosphere was casual and comfortable, making it a great spot to grab a bite before a show. We would definitely consider returning to this restaurant in the future.

The dim lighting and intimate setting added to the unique charm of the place. Our group enjoyed the eclectic decor and lively tunes playing in the background. Although it was crowded, the staff managed to keep up with our large group's orders and were attentive to our needs. Overall, Frankie's Tiki Room is a hidden gem that's perfect for a night out with friends or a quirky date spot. I'd definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a fun and laid-back experience with great drinks and a cool vibe.

The overall experience was a letdown, and I would not recommend Bayside Buffet to anyone looking for a quality buffet in Vegas. The price point of $30 for dinner is not justified by the subpar food options. I've had better luck at other buffets in the area that offer fresher, more flavorful dishes at a similar price. The lack of seasoning on the prime rib was particularly disappointing, and the dry, overcooked fried chicken was a major turnoff. Even the desserts, which are usually a highlight of any buffet, were a disappointment. The fact that the ice cream machine wasn't even functioning properly was just the cherry on top of a lackluster experience. Unless they revamp their menu and improve their food quality, I would advise others to steer clear of Bayside Buffet and opt for one of the many other, better buffet options in Vegas.

The lack of attention to detail and declining food quality makes it a disappointing experience. With so many other excellent options available, I won't be returning anytime soon. Sadly, this once-convenient spot has become a letdown, and I hope they can turn things around to regain their former reputation and customer satisfaction.

My first experience here wasn't bad.... I just thought the food was OK on average. Nothing to special about it. It's pretty much your typical American Mexican joint. From the name, I guess I was just expecting a lot.

Location - located on a strip mall right next to a gas station and other food joints. Corner of Decatur and Sunset.

Atmosphere - the place is small but it's pretty clean and cozy. It was pretty busy when I went during lunch hour.

Food - I'm a nocturnal type of person so I always wake up late. I was craving some type of Mexican breakfast and I came across this place. I had the Chorizo breakfast burrito with a side of Barbacoa taco. Like I mentioned earlier, I thought the food was average. Prices are decent and it's something you'd expect from a place like this. I've had better ones at a local Roberto's.

Service - no complaints on service. It's the typical order from the counter, pay and they'll being the food to you type of shindig. It was pretty prompt and the lady was quite nice.

Overall, I'd probably give this place another go. Maybe for something quick or maybe to try their famous chocolate drizzled churro. If you're looking for Mexican food or some type of Mex fusion, I'd go somewhere else. Perhaps I just caught them on an off day, but I didn't feel like the dishes I ordered were particularly impressive or memorable. The Chorizo breakfast burrito was filling, but it lacked a certain depth of flavor that I've come to expect from a good Mexican breakfast dish. The Barbacoa taco was tender, but it was somewhat overpowered by the salsa and other toppings. 

I do appreciate the convenience of the location and the friendly service, so I might be willing to give them another chance to see if they can impress me with something else on the menu. The chocolate drizzled churro sounds like a nice treat, and I've heard good things about it from other reviewers. However, for now, I would say that this place is just average, and there are likely better options available for those seeking authentic or innovative Mexican cuisine.

Overall, my experience at this venue was underwhelming. The combination of inexperienced staff, a novice DJ, and a rowdy crowd made for a chaotic and unpleasant atmosphere. The rooftop bar, which I had been looking forward to, was a major letdown with its unimpressive views.
