It's a shame, really, because the location at Caesar's Palace suggests a level of sophistication and luxury that this place just doesn't deliver. Unless you're part of the younger crowd that seems to thrive in this environment, I would recommend exploring other options on the Strip. With a little more attention to service and ambiance, this place could reach its full potential, but for now, it's just a disappointing and overhyped spot.

As I stood there, savoring the last bite of that incredible mac & cheese, I knew I had found my new go-to spot for soul food. The atmosphere was warm and inviting, with the aroma of slow-cooked meats and spices filling the air. The staff's enthusiasm was contagious, making me feel like I was part of a big, happy family. I ended up ordering a few more items, including the fried chicken and collard greens, both of which were equally impressive. The prices were very reasonable, especially considering the generous portion sizes. Overall, I'm so glad I stumbled upon this hidden gem at SouthPark Mall. If you're a fan of authentic, delicious soul food, do yourself a favor and stop by – your taste buds will thank you! I'm already planning my next visit. Five stars, hands down!
Delicious, freshly made, and reasonably priced, these sandwiches are a must-try, perfect for a quick bite or late-night craving after a night out.

I left feeling underwhelmed and overhyped about the whole experience. The atmosphere was quaint, but the food fell short of my expectations. Perhaps I visited on an off day, but the dry meat was a major letdown. For a place that's supposed to be famous for its sandwiches, I expected a lot more. The combination of the cherry coke, fries, and pickle was a nice touch, but it couldn't make up for the subpar sandwich. If you're looking for a truly exceptional deli experience, I would still recommend trying Katz in NYC. The price difference may seem significant, but trust me, it's worth every penny.

The utter disappointment and disgust I felt after dining at Hikari still lingers, and I feel compelled to warn others, especially fellow vegetarians, about the subpar experience that awaits them. It's not just the lack of options that's the problem, but the sheer incompetence in preparing the few vegetarian dishes they do offer. The vegetable tempura was an affront to the culinary world, and the mochi ice cream was an insult to the concept of frozen desserts. 

I've had my fair share of mediocre meals at Japanese restaurants, but Hikari takes the cake for its breathtaking ability to mess up even the simplest of dishes. The fact that they managed to serve freezer-burned mochi ice cream is a testament to their lack of attention to detail and commitment to quality. As someone who's willing to give restaurants the benefit of the doubt, I'm shocked that I'm still fuming about my experience months later. 

To the owners of Hikari, I implore you: take a long, hard look at your kitchen and your staff, and ask yourselves if you're truly doing justice to the culinary traditions you're supposed to be representing. Until then, I'll make sure to steer clear of your establishment and advise others to do the same. One star is even too generous for a place that has so blatantly disregarded the basics of cooking and customer satisfaction.
Food was decent, prices reasonable, and atmosphere cozy, but service inconsistencies left a mixed impression overall.

Prices were reasonable, and portion sizes were generous. Overall, I'm excited to try more menu items and experience their great service again, hopefully with fresher avocado next time, to make it a perfect dining experience.

The technicians are skilled and gentle, making the experience comfortable and relaxing. They have a wide range of gel polish colors to choose from, and I've never had an issue with them getting the color right. The salon itself is clean and well-maintained, which is important to me. Overall, I'm happy with the service and quality I receive, and I plan to continue going back for my gel manicure needs. The moderate pricing and long-lasting results make it a great value for me, and I would recommend this salon to others looking for a reliable and skilled gel manicure experience.

I've had the pleasure of trying various items on their menu, and I must say that their consistency in quality is impressive. The soups, sandwiches, and flatbreads are all delicious and made with fresh ingredients. I also appreciate their commitment to sustainability and reducing food waste. The fact that they donate unsold bread and pastries to those in need is truly admirable. As someone who has been a customer and an employee, I can confidently say that Panera Bread is a company that genuinely cares about its community. Whether I'm grabbing a quick breakfast on-the-go or meeting friends for lunch, Panera Bread is always my top choice. The combination of tasty food, welcoming atmosphere, and friendly staff makes it the perfect spot to unwind and enjoy some well-deserved relaxation. Overall, I highly recommend Panera Bread to anyone looking for a great dining experience that also supports a good cause.

Overall, my experience at this establishment was underwhelming, to say the least. The lack of customers should have been a red flag, but I was willing to give them a chance. Unfortunately, the service was slow and the staff seemed uninterested in attending to my needs. The food, which I was initially excited to try, was a major letdown. The pork chops were the only redeeming quality, but the sides were a disaster. The mac and cheese was a lazy, processed rendition that lacked any real flavor or effort, while the greens were a flavorless, unseasoned mess. For $13.00, I expect a lot more quality and care in the preparation of my meal. Sadly, this place did not deliver, and I would not recommend it to anyone. Unless they seriously revamp their menu and service, I don't see myself returning anytime soon. The lack of attention to detail and commitment to quality is disappointing, and I hope they take customer feedback seriously to make necessary improvements.
Overpriced and underwhelming experience, definitely not worth the hefty bill or the time spent waiting in line either unfortunately always.

I've been to numerous play cafes in the past, but Kids Play Cafe truly stands out from the rest. The attention to detail and commitment to providing a safe and enjoyable environment for both children and adults is evident in every aspect of the facility. From the carefully curated play areas to the healthy and delicious food options, it's clear that the owners have put a lot of thought into creating a space that caters to the needs of families.

The play structure, which is made in the US, is not only fun for kids but also sturdy and well-maintained. The staff is always on hand to ensure that everything is running smoothly and that all the children are having a great time. The free WIFI and comfortable seating areas make it easy for parents to relax and get some work done while their kids play. Overall, I'm so impressed with Kids Play Cafe and feel grateful to have it in our neighborhood. It's become our go-to spot for a fun and stress-free day out with our daughter, and I highly recommend it to all my friends and fellow parents. With its unique blend of play, food, and community, Kids Play Cafe is a must-visit destination for any family looking for a great time.

I've lost count of how many times we've had to ask for refills on drinks or follow up on orders that seem to have been forgotten. The staff seems overwhelmed and disorganized, even when the restaurant isn't busy. For a place that's supposedly convenient for a work lunch, it's astonishing how inefficient they are. Two hours is just unacceptable for a meal that's not even enjoyable. Unless they seriously revamp their service and quality of food, I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone. Needless to say, we'll be taking our team lunches (and our business) elsewhere from now on.

The sense of community at Sicfit is unparalleled, with everyone supporting and encouraging each other to reach their full potential. The trainers are knowledgeable and take a genuine interest in each member's progress, providing personalized guidance and feedback. I've seen significant improvements in my overall health and fitness since joining, and I attribute that to the well-structured programs and expert coaching. The variety of classes and activities keeps workouts engaging and fun, and I appreciate the emphasis on proper technique and safety. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just starting out, Sicfit has something to offer. The owners and staff are passionate about helping members achieve their goals, and it shows in everything they do. If you're looking for a gym that truly cares about your well-being and success, look no further than Sicfit Scottsdale. Give it a try and experience the difference for yourself.

I'm still dreaming about that iron skillet cookie. The combination of warm, gooey cookie and cold ice cream was absolute perfection. Overall, I was thoroughly impressed with the quality of food, drinks, and service. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, making it an excellent spot for a night out with friends or a date. I would highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a unique and delicious dining experience.
"Blissful relaxation and rejuvenation, leaving me feeling refreshed and energized, with a huge smile on my face, can't wait to come back and do it all again, absolutely fantastic!"

Overall, our experience was disappointing, especially considering the high standards we've come to expect from this establishment. The buffet spread, although extensive, lacked attention to detail and freshness. The mislabeled dishes and overcooked roast beef were major turn-offs. The substitution of pumpkin for vanilla soft serve was also a puzzling decision. While the breakfast selection showed promise, the absence of simple scrambled eggs was a notable omission. With a few tweaks to address these issues, this brunch buffet could reach its full potential, but for now, it falls short of expectations.

The overall atmosphere of the restaurant was also lacking, with a decor that seemed outdated and uninviting. The background music was too loud, making it difficult to carry on a conversation. To make matters worse, the restaurant's policy of adding an automatic gratuity for parties of a certain size was not clearly stated, which could have led to an even more unpleasant surprise at the end of the meal. 

It's disappointing that a restaurant with such potential can be brought down by subpar service and overpriced food. The fried oyster sandwich, which was the main reason for my visit, was a letdown, and the small bun it was served on only added to the disappointment. For a restaurant that charges premium prices, you would expect a higher level of quality and attention to detail. Unfortunately, my experience fell far short of expectations.

Despite the poor experience, I am willing to give the restaurant another chance, as I've heard good things about some of their other menu items. However, it will take a significant improvement in service and food quality to win me back as a customer. If the management takes steps to address the issues with their staff and menu, I would be willing to revisit and update my review. Until then, I would caution others to approach with caution and be prepared for a potentially disappointing experience.

As I reflected on our experience, I couldn't help but think about the numerous opportunities that were missed to provide excellent service. From the hostess's lack of initiative to find answers to my questions, to the prolonged wait for a greeting, it was clear that the front-of-house staff was not adequately trained. The issue with my beer glass having lipstick marks was not only unappetizing but also raised concerns about the attention to detail in the kitchen and bar area.

The way our appetizer was dropped off by a food runner, still wearing gloves, without any interaction or confirmation that it was correct, was also disappointing. It seemed like the staff was more focused on expediting the service rather than ensuring that the customers' needs were met. The fact that our server was polite and attentive was a saving grace, but it wasn't enough to redeem the overall experience.

What really took the cake, though, was the skimpy portion of fries in my to-go order. As a restaurant that prides itself on its endless fry baskets, it was surprising to see such a meager serving. It felt like the kitchen was trying to cut costs by skimping on the to-go orders, which is not only disappointing but also dishonest. As someone who has worked in the service industry for 7 years, I know that it's the little things that matter, and it's up to the management to ensure that their staff is trained to provide excellent service. Until then, I would caution others to think twice before dining here.

The food is consistently delicious and prepared to order. I appreciate the attention to detail and the cleanliness of the restaurant. Every visit has been a pleasant experience, and I look forward to returning. The staff's enthusiasm and dedication to customer satisfaction are truly impressive, making this Carl's Jr a standout location that I highly recommend to everyone.
The presentation was stunning, service impeccable, and each bite a masterpiece, leaving me eager to return and sample more of their innovative creations.

The nostalgic atmosphere remains intact, and the smell of sizzling burgers on the grill is still incredibly enticing. I was thrilled to see that the quality of the food has not wavered over the years. The staff is friendly and attentive, adding to the overall charm of the place. Whether you're a local or just visiting, The Chuck Box is a must-try for any burger enthusiast. The simplicity of their menu and the freshness of their ingredients make for a truly satisfying dining experience. I'll continue to recommend The Chuck Box to anyone looking for a classic burger joint in Tempe.

The lack of improvement is disappointing, and the unremarkable dishes make it hard to recommend. With numerous alternatives available, it's clear that this establishment falls short in terms of overall dining experience, making it a less desirable choice for those seeking quality food and attentive service.

The staff were friendly and attentive, adding to the welcoming atmosphere. Overall, 32 Shea has great potential and I'm excited to see how it evolves. With a few tweaks to the menu, it could become a top spot in the area. For now, it's a great addition to our neighborhood, offering a fresh and lively vibe.

Overall, it was an average experience. We might consider returning to try other menu items, but the sushi was not impressive. For the price, we expected more. Perhaps dinner service is better, but for lunch, it didn't stand out from other local options. Still, the friendly waitress and pleasant atmosphere were redeeming qualities.

Overall, I'd recommend this spot for a casual night out with friends or a low-key date. The music is usually on point, and the crowd is lively but not overly rowdy. If you're a tequila fan, you'll appreciate their extensive selection, and the prices won't break the bank. Just don't expect to be blown away by the food, and be prepared for some less-than-pristine bathroom conditions. Despite its rough edges, this place has a certain charm that keeps me coming back for more. It's a great spot to grab a drink and enjoy the Old Town scene.

As we finished our meal and prepared to leave, I couldn't help but feel satisfied with our decision to dine at this restaurant. The combination of excellent food, stunning views, and friendly service made for a truly enjoyable experience. Our server was attentive and knowledgeable, happily answering our questions about the menu and making recommendations when needed. The atmosphere, while a bit bland if you're not seated by the window, was still upscale and refined, making it a great spot for a special occasion or romantic dinner.

Despite the disappointment with the Fromage du Jour, I was impressed by the restaurant's attention to detail and commitment to using high-quality ingredients. The fettuccine Alfredo, as I mentioned earlier, was truly exceptional, and the chicken breast was cooked to perfection. I appreciated the fact that the dish was not overly salted or seasoned, allowing the natural flavors of the ingredients to shine through.

One thing to note is that the restaurant can get quite busy, especially during peak hours, so it's a good idea to make a reservation in advance to ensure seating. We were lucky to get a table by the window, but I can imagine that the experience might be less enjoyable if you're stuck in a less desirable seat.

Overall, I would highly recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a great dining experience in Las Vegas. While it may not be the cheapest option, the quality of the food and service make it well worth the price. And if you're a fan of fettuccine Alfredo, you owe it to yourself to try it here – it's truly a game-changer. With its excellent food, stunning views, and friendly service, this restaurant is a must-visit for anyone looking to elevate their dining experience in Vegas.

The whole experience left a sour taste in my mouth, and I was disappointed that the hotel staff couldn't provide a more welcoming and relaxed atmosphere. It seemed like they were more focused on enforcing unnecessary rules rather than ensuring their guests had a good time. The fact that they claimed to be monitoring our drinks was not only intrusive but also made us feel like we were being treated like children. As someone who has stayed at numerous resorts in the Phoenix area, I can confidently say that this was one of the most unwelcoming experiences I've had. The inconsistent enforcement of their rules and the staff's attitude towards us were major turn-offs. Unfortunately, our negative experience at the hotel outweighed our previously positive experiences at the restaurants, and we will not be returning to this establishment. Overall, I would not recommend this hotel to others.

Despite the initial valet debacle, I was pleasantly surprised by the cleanliness and comfort of my room. The jet tub was a lovely touch, and the mini kitchenette was well-stocked with essentials. However, the housekeeping staff seemed to be in short supply, and I had to request extra towels and toiletries on multiple occasions. The location, as I mentioned earlier, is a major plus, with the Fashion Show mall offering a variety of dining and shopping options. The proximity to the Wynn is also a bonus, as it provides easy access to the strip without the hassle of being directly on it.

One thing to note is that the hotel's amenities are somewhat limited, with no on-site casino or restaurant. However, the front desk staff were happy to provide recommendations for nearby eateries and entertainment options. Overall, my stay was decent, but the understaffing and valet issues were major drawbacks. If the hotel can address these issues, I would consider staying here again, especially given the discounted rate I was able to secure. However, at full price, I would likely opt for a more traditional hotel with a fuller range of amenities and services. With some tweaks to their staffing and operations, this hotel could be a great option for those looking for a more low-key, off-strip experience.

The staff's knowledge of the products is impressive, and they're more than happy to offer suggestions and recommendations. I ended up finding some amazing deals on packing cubes and travel-sized essentials. The overall shopping experience was seamless, and I appreciated the well-organized layout of the store. Although some items may be priced a bit higher than expected, the quality and uniqueness of the products make up for it. I've already planned my next visit to check out their seasonal collections and see what new treasures I can discover. Whether you're a neat freak or just a lover of all things organized, this store is definitely worth a visit.

The combination of delicious cuisine and stunning views made for a memorable experience. Although the service was slow, it allowed for a leisurely pace, savoring each bite and taking in the surroundings. Prices were reasonable for the quality and ambiance, making it an excellent choice for special occasions or romantic evenings in Las Vegas.

The donuts were freshly baked and the staff were friendly. Despite the issue, I was impressed by the quality and taste. I'm looking forward to trying more flavors on my next visit. Hopefully, they'll iron out the minor quality control issues to deserve that 5-star rating. Until then, I'll be back for another delicious apple fritter, hoping it's staple-free this time.

As I reflect on my numerous visits to the garden, I'm reminded of the unique experiences each season brought. The spring bloom was a personal favorite, with vibrant flowers and lush greenery transforming the landscape. Summer evenings were perfect for strolls through the garden, taking in the tranquil atmosphere and admiring the dramatic sunsets. Autumn and winter brought their own charm, with the changing foliage and holiday-themed exhibits adding a touch of magic to the already enchanting surroundings.

The garden's events and programs were also noteworthy, offering something for everyone. From guided tours and workshops to concerts and festivals, there was always something new to explore. I appreciated the attention to detail and commitment to sustainability evident in every aspect of the garden's operations. Whether you're a nature enthusiast, a photographer, or simply looking for a peaceful escape, this garden is an absolute gem. Its proximity to the city makes it an ideal destination for both locals and tourists, and I highly recommend adding it to your itinerary. With its ever-changing exhibits and stunning natural beauty, you'll want to return again and again, just as I did.

I've tried giving them the benefit of the doubt multiple times, but the results are consistently underwhelming. The dash, console, and door panels often still have visible dust and dirt after the wash. It's clear that attention to detail is lacking, and the "extra" services like vacuuming and wiping down surfaces are not thoroughly done. For the price, I expect a more thorough cleaning, especially when opting for the premium package. Sadly, Danny's has become a last resort for me, and I'll be exploring other car wash options that can deliver better results and value for my money.

The lack of attention to detail and poor communication from the staff was disappointing, especially considering it wasn't even busy. The food, although tasty, couldn't make up for the subpar service. It's unfortunate that a simple request like coffee became a frustrating ordeal. The eye-rolling and dismissive attitude from the lady at the counter was the final straw. As a customer, it's reasonable to expect a certain level of service, especially when it comes to basic requests. Unfortunately, this location has consistently fallen short, and it's clear that we won't be returning anytime soon. Maybe it's time for them to reevaluate their service standards.

In retrospect, our experience at The Hard Rock was a mixed bag, with some positives overshadowed by the numerous negatives. The $100 per night deposit, which was not clearly disclosed at the time of booking, was a significant inconvenience. It's understandable that the hotel wants to protect itself from rowdy guests, but it would be reasonable to expect some transparency about this policy.

The construction noise was another major issue, and it's astonishing that the workers thought it was acceptable to start making noise at 5 am. The fact that we had to yell down at them to stop is a testament to the hotel's lack of consideration for its guests. The additional charge for using the gym is also a bit steep, especially considering the already high prices of the rooms.

Our dining experience at Mr. Lucky's was also marred by the unpleasant incident with the vomiting guest. While it's not the hotel's fault that some guests can't handle their liquor, it's still worth the hotel's attention to improve their overall guest experience. On the other hand, the Pink Taco was a pleasant surprise, and we would highly recommend it to anyone looking for good food.

The presence of a CVS pharmacy across the street was also a lifesaver, as it allowed us to purchase beer at a fraction of the cost of the hotel's prices. This is definitely something to keep in mind for future guests who want to enjoy a few drinks without breaking the bank. Overall, while The Hard Rock has some redeeming qualities, its numerous drawbacks make it a less-than-ideal choice for anyone looking for a relaxing and enjoyable stay. Unless you're a party animal who doesn't mind the chaos and noise, it's probably best to look elsewhere.

The quality of the food was not enough to make up for the poor service we experienced. Our entrees were just okay, nothing special, and the long wait had taken away our appetite. The atmosphere of the restaurant was nice, but the slow service and mistakes made by the waiter overshadowed everything. It's disappointing to see a restaurant that was once a favorite of ours decline in quality. The lack of attention to detail and poor communication between the staff is unacceptable. Overall, our recent experiences at Crust have been disappointing, and we will not be returning anytime soon.

The rest of our stay was uneventful, but the initial impression had already been made. The tower rooms were nice, I'll give them that, but it was too little, too late. The hotel's attempt to rectify the situation by moving us to our originally booked rooms was appreciated, but the damage had already been done. The lack of attention to detail and poor customer service left a sour taste in my mouth. The fact that our rooms were not ready at check-in, and the excuses provided by the manager, only added to the frustration. It's disappointing to see a hotel of this caliber drop the ball so severely. The CES conference was a huge success, but my stay at this hotel was a major failure. I will be taking my business (and my attendees) elsewhere for future events. The hotel needs to seriously revamp its customer service and room allocation process to prevent similar disasters from happening in the future. Until then, I will be advising colleagues and friends to avoid this place at all costs. One star from me, and that's being generous.

Overall, I highly recommend Baja Joe's for their delicious dishes, particularly the outstanding ceviche. However, be prepared for a potentially overwhelming atmosphere due to the loud music. To fully enjoy your meal, consider calling ahead to confirm the entertainment schedule. Despite this, the exceptional food makes it a worthwhile visit, and I will continue to return for their fantastic cuisine.

Overall, my experience was a letdown due to the high prices and inconsistent quality. While the bake shop's treats are a highlight, the main restaurant's dishes fell short of my expectations. With better options available in town, I wouldn't recommend dining here unless they reassess their pricing and refine their culinary offerings to match the excellence of their baked goods. Perhaps with some changes, they can live up to their full potential.

The portion size was decent, but the flavors just didn't pop. I've had better pho at other establishments in the area, and for the price, I expected more. The service was friendly, but our server seemed overwhelmed, taking a while to take our order and forgetting one of our appetizers. Overall, while this place might be a convenient alternative to Pho Kim Long, it's not worth going out of your way for. If you're craving authentic, delicious Vietnamese cuisine, you might want to look elsewhere or wait it out for Pho Kim Long. Unfortunately, this spot just didn't live up to my expectations.

The atmosphere was lively and family-friendly, making it an excellent choice for our evening out. The prices were reasonable, and the portion sizes were generous. Our server was attentive and ensured that our glasses were always full. The combination of delicious food, exceptional service, and pleasant ambiance has earned Golden Buddha a spot on our list of favorite restaurants. We can't wait to go back and try more of their dishes, and we highly recommend it to anyone looking for a great dining experience.

Overall, the quality of the dishes made up for the inconsistencies in service. Despite the confusing moments, our server was friendly and tried their best. With some improvements to their service, this place could truly shine, and I'm willing to give it another chance to see if sitting downstairs makes a difference.

The staff were friendly, efficient, and did an excellent job. They kept me updated on the progress and even called when it was ready. Their prices were very reasonable and I'm so grateful for their help. I highly recommend this place for any luggage repair needs, they truly saved my trip.

However, considering the price, I expected more. The flavors were unique and enjoyable, making it a worthwhile try for vegan dessert enthusiasts, but improvements in portion size would enhance the overall value and experience.

We had to flag down another staff member to request the check, which was a bit frustrating. Despite the issues with service, our waiter was friendly when he was present, and the food arrived in a timely manner. The prices were reasonable, with most pasta dishes falling in the $15-$20 range. Overall, La Cucina Flegrea has potential, but it needs to work on its ambiance and service to elevate the dining experience. With a few tweaks, this could be a great spot for a pre-theater dinner or a casual night out. As it stands, I would recommend it to fans of Italian cuisine who are looking for a no-frills meal, but may not be the best choice for those seeking a more polished experience. Perhaps with some updates to the interior and improvements to the service, La Cucina Flegrea could become a top destination in the area. For now, it's an average option that could be worth a try.

The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, making it an ideal spot to catch up with friends or get some work done. The prices were reasonable, and the portion sizes were generous. I appreciated the attention to detail, from the flavors in my drink to the freshness of the muffin. Overall, I'm so glad I stopped by and I'll definitely be back to try more of their menu items. The combination of excellent service, tasty treats, and stunning views makes this coffee shop a must-visit destination for anyone in the area. I'm already looking forward to my next visit.

I've visited this shop a handful of times, and while the inventory can be hit-or-miss, I've managed to find some hidden gems. The prices are generally fair, and the staff is always willing to negotiate. It's clear that they're not trying to be a high-end pawn shop, but rather a community-driven store where people can find decent deals on everyday items. If you're looking for a unique shopping experience and aren't expecting to find rare treasures, this place is worth a visit. Just be prepared to dig through the shelves and showcases to find something that catches your eye. Overall, it's a charming little shop with a lot of character, and I'll likely continue to stop by whenever I'm in the area.

However, despite the language barrier, the staff is always willing to help and ensure that you have a pleasant dining experience. The atmosphere is casual and cozy, with a few tables and chairs scattered around the small dining area. It's not fancy, but it's comfortable and inviting.

One thing to note is that the menu can be a bit overwhelming, especially if you're not familiar with Persian cuisine. But don't worry, the staff will do their best to guide you through the options and help you make a decision. And if you're feeling adventurous, you can always ask for recommendations.

The prices are very reasonable, especially considering the generous portion sizes. We've never spent more than $20 per person, and that includes a kabob, side dishes, and drinks. Overall, I would highly recommend Khaneh Kabob (or Kabob House, as I still like to call it) to anyone looking for delicious, authentic Persian cuisine at a great price. Just be patient with the service, and don't be afraid to ask for help navigating the menu. With its unique flavors and generous portions, this hidden gem is sure to become a favorite among foodies and families alike.

As I sat there, trying to enjoy my overpriced meal, I couldn't help but feel a sense of disappointment and frustration. The atmosphere, which initially seemed intriguing with its unique blend of Chinese and Western decor, quickly fell flat due to the cold and unfriendly service. The fishtanks at the entrance, which I thought would be a nice touch, ended up feeling like a gimmick, a desperate attempt to distract from the subpar experience.

The food, while authentic in taste, was not enough to justify the exorbitant prices. The spicy wonton was good, but not exceptional, and the beef noodles were nothing special. The small portion of fried rice was a joke, especially considering the price we paid. I've had better, more generous servings at a fraction of the cost at other Chinese restaurants in the city.

What really took the cake, though, was the abrupt and rude service. The waiter's curt question of "Finish?" mid-meal was the final straw. It was as if they were eager to get us out of there, rather than providing us with a pleasant dining experience. Needless to say, I will not be returning to Beijing Noodle No. 9 anytime soon. If you're looking for a good meal at a reasonable price, I would highly recommend avoiding this overpriced and underwhelming restaurant. Instead, take my advice and head to the Bachannal Buffet, where you can get a delicious and filling meal without breaking the bank. Trust me, your wallet (and your taste buds) will thank you.

As I reflect on our exceptional dining experience at Greenbush, I am reminded of the importance of ambiance in enhancing the overall culinary journey. The dimly lit interior, complete with rustic wooden accents and vintage decor, seamlessly transports patrons to a cozy, intimate setting that is perfect for a night out with friends or a romantic evening. The staff, too, were attentive and knowledgeable, happy to offer recommendations and share the story behind the restaurant's commitment to using locally sourced ingredients.

What truly sets Greenbush apart, however, is its unwavering dedication to quality and craftsmanship. From the carefully curated wine list to the expertly prepared pizzas, every aspect of the dining experience exudes a sense of thoughtfulness and attention to detail. The fact that the restaurant is able to maintain such high standards while still offering a welcoming, unpretentious atmosphere is a testament to the passion and expertise of the team behind Greenbush.

As a self-proclaimed pizza connoisseur, I can confidently say that Greenbush has earned a spot among my top recommendations. Whether you're a fellow Midwesterner or just visiting the area, this hidden gem is an absolute must-visit for anyone looking to experience the best of Madison's culinary scene. So, do yourself a favor and stop by Greenbush – I promise you won't be disappointed. And who knows, you might just find yourself, like me, concocting excuses to return and indulge in another unforgettable meal. With its unbeatable combination of delicious food, cozy atmosphere, and exceptional service, Greenbush is sure to leave a lasting impression on even the most discerning diners.
for providing reliable and affordable rides, keeping our community safe with trusted drivers like John, and constantly improving your services with innovative technology.

I've had the chance to explore different parts of the city without worrying about parking or traffic, which is a huge plus. The routes may not be the most direct, but they cover a significant amount of ground, and I've discovered some new neighborhoods and attractions that I wouldn't have otherwise visited. While the wait times can be frustrating, I've learned to plan ahead and use the time to catch up on reading or listen to music. The affordability and convenience of the Port Authority buses make them an excellent option for casual, non-time-sensitive travel. Overall, I appreciate the service they provide and the freedom it gives me to leave my car behind, even if it's just for a day of running errands or meeting friends. It's not perfect, but it's a valuable resource for our city.
Terrible experience, extremely disappointing, and utterly frustrating, a complete waste of time and money, will not recommend to anyone.

The Good: I could state a few mediocre points, such as that the office was clean, but they aren't really of any great import.

The Bad: The doctor only addressed part of my concerns, as I was very interested in seeking help on 2 different-but-related medical issues. Most of his focus was on one issue, with the other being set aside for another time. Though the first visit wasn't rushed, the second appointment did not feel the same.

The doctor seemed eager to use scare tactics during our two conversations, focusing on the possible lethality of a condition, ignoring questions of severity or likelihood. He comes across as patronizing behind a slightly jovial veneer and attempting to scare someone as part of pushing a treatment plan is unprofessional in the extreme.

The doctor suggested I obtain a basic blood test, which could be done via a blood draw at his office. I asked how much the testing would cost (I don't have insurance yet) and was told it would be between $100-200. The doctor was horribly wrong, as the bill was slightly under $500. Though his office did pay part of the bill and help reduce the total cost to me (after I complained), I still paid over $150 more than I had been led to expect.

The Ugly: During my first visit to the office I handed the receptionist my driver's license to be photocopied. It wasn't until 3pm the next afternoon that I realized she'd never given it back to me. When I called back to see if I'd left it there her response was, "Oh yes! We have it right here for you in the desk drawer." Glad it wasn't lost, but if you'd had my card sitting around all day and you HAVE MY PHONE NUMBER, I believe a call back to me would be in order.

In summary Dr. Marks is not a bad guy, but is not a doctor I intend on seeing again. I would not recommend him for your use as a general practice DO.

As I reflect on my experience with Dr. Marks, I am reminded of the importance of finding a doctor who is not only knowledgeable but also genuinely cares about their patients' well-being. Unfortunately, my interactions with Dr. Marks left me feeling like just another number, rather than an individual with unique concerns and needs. The fact that he relied on scare tactics to push a treatment plan, rather than taking the time to address my questions and concerns, was particularly troubling.

Furthermore, the discrepancy in the cost of the blood test was not only frustrating but also financially burdensome. As someone without insurance, I had to be mindful of every dollar I spent, and the unexpected expense was a significant blow. While the office did eventually help to reduce the cost, the initial mistake and lack of transparency were inexcusable.

The incident with my driver's license, although seemingly minor, was also telling. The fact that the receptionist didn't bother to call me to return my identification, despite having my phone number, speaks to a lack of attention to detail and respect for patients' time. It's the little things like this that can make a big difference in the overall quality of care and patient experience.

In conclusion, while Dr. Marks may have his strengths, my experience with him was overwhelmingly negative. I would caution others to approach his practice with skepticism and to carefully consider their options before seeking his care. With so many qualified and compassionate doctors out there, I believe that patients deserve better than a practitioner who prioritizes scare tactics and profit over patient-centered care.

As I sat there, nursing my wounds and trying to catch my breath, I couldn't help but think about how easily this accident could have been prevented. A simple caution sign or a non-slip mat would have made all the difference. The fact that the staff seemed to be aware of the issue, yet failed to take any action, is appalling. I was lucky to have escaped with just a bruise and some pain, but what if someone else isn't so fortunate? The Cosmo's negligence could lead to a serious lawsuit, and it's only a matter of time before someone gets seriously hurt.

I've always loved the Cosmo for its trendy vibe and luxurious amenities, but this experience has left a sour taste in my mouth. The lack of attention to safety and guest well-being is unacceptable, especially considering the high prices they charge for their rooms and services. I hope that the management takes my complaint seriously and takes immediate action to address this issue. In the meantime, I would advise other guests to be extremely cautious when walking around the pool area, especially if they're barefoot or have kids with them. It's a shame that such a great hotel can be so careless about the safety of its guests. I'll be thinking twice before booking another stay at the Cosmo, and I hope that they can regain my trust by taking steps to prevent accidents like this from happening in the future.
Overall, a disappointing experience with subpar amenities and unfriendly service, making it not worth the stay.

As I reflect on our experience with the Western Journey Tour, I have to say that I'm still disappointed with the overall value we received. While the helicopter ride was undoubtedly the highlight of the tour, it felt like a tease, leaving us wanting more. The rest of the tour, which made up the bulk of the time, was underwhelming and felt like a series of overpriced, touristy attractions.

The skywalk at Eagle Point, for example, was a unique experience, but the restrictions on taking our own cameras and the exorbitant prices for the official photos were a major turn-off. It felt like they were nickel-and-diming us at every turn, which took away from the enjoyment of the experience. And the Native American village, which I was expecting to be a fascinating cultural experience, was little more than a few token teepees and a gift shop.

Guano Point was probably the most enjoyable part of the tour, aside from the helicopter ride. The views were stunning, and we appreciated the opportunity to hike up to the point and take in the scenery. However, the food was a major letdown. I wasn't expecting a gourmet meal, but the quality of the food was subpar, and it felt like an afterthought.

The fact that we didn't even have time to visit the Hualapai Ranch, which was supposedly part of the tour, was a major disappointment. It felt like we were being rushed through the experience, without any regard for the actual activities and attractions that were supposed to be included.

One of the biggest issues I have with this tour is the false advertising. The tour is advertised as a 7-hour experience, but we were done in under 5 hours. The pickup and drop-off times were also misleading, as we spent a significant amount of time waiting around at the airport. And the flight back, which I was expecting to be a scenic tour of the canyon, was essentially a repeat of the same views we had seen on the way out.

Overall, I would not recommend the Western Journey Tour to anyone. While the helicopter ride was amazing, the rest of the tour was a series of overpriced, underwhelming experiences. If you're looking for a truly memorable experience in the Grand Canyon, I would suggest looking into other tour options that actually deliver on their promises. In this case, the Western Journey Tour felt like a waste of money, and I would caution others against making the same mistake.

In hindsight, I wish we had done more research and read more reviews before booking this tour. It's clear that many others have had similar experiences, and it's disappointing that the tour operator hasn't taken steps to address these issues. If you're considering booking the Western Journey Tour, I would urge you to think twice and explore other options. With so many amazing experiences to be had in the Grand Canyon, it's a shame to settle for a subpar tour that fails to deliver on its promises.

I'm extremely disappointed in the drastic change in the staff's behavior and priorities. It's appalling that they're more focused on making a profit than providing genuine care and attention to the pets. The fact that they refused to let me speak with Dr. Ron, even for a minute, is unacceptable. As a pet owner, it's frustrating to feel like I'm being taken advantage of, especially when I'm already struggling to make ends meet.

The experience with my Labrador's infection abscess was a clear indication of the staff's incompetence. The female doctor's misdiagnosis and attempt to push unnecessary tests and medications was not only unprofessional but also costly. Thankfully, Dr. Ron intervened and prescribed the correct treatment, which worked wonders for my dog.

Now, with my Rottie's new issue, I'm anxious to get her the proper care without being ripped off. All I need is a simple urine test, but the staff's reluctance to communicate with me or relay my messages to Dr. Ron is hindering the process. It's sad to see a once-caring and compassionate team turn into a money-driven machine. I implore the management to re-evaluate their staff's training and priorities, as it's clear that they've lost sight of what truly matters – the well-being of the animals. Until then, I'll continue to advocate for my pets and seek Dr. Ron's expertise, while avoiding the unprofessional and greedy staff.

I'm not even exaggerating when I say that I've had more pleasant experiences at the dentist's office. At least there, I know I'm going to be in pain, but it's a quick and necessary kind of pain. This post office, on the other hand, is a slow and agonizing kind of torture that leaves you wondering why you even bothered getting out of bed that morning. The lines are always ridiculously long, and the employees seem to be competing in some sort of bizarre, sadistic contest to see who can move the slowest.

And don't even get me started on the "organization" of the place. It's like they took every bad idea from every other post office, threw them all into a blender, and hit puree. The layout is confusing, the signs are unclear, and the whole atmosphere is just chaotic. I've seen people wander around in circles, trying to figure out where to go or what to do, while the employees just sit there, watching them with a mixture of disdain and boredom.

I've tried to give this post office the benefit of the doubt, I really have. I've gone in at different times of day, thinking that maybe it's just busy during certain hours. But no, it's always the same. The employees are always slow, the lines are always long, and the whole experience is always a nightmare. I've even tried to be friendly and courteous, thinking that maybe if I'm nice to them, they'll be nice to me. But no, it doesn't seem to matter. They're always surly, always unfriendly, and always seem to be looking for ways to make my experience worse.

If I could give this post office a zero-star review, I would. In fact, I'd give it a negative-star review if that were possible. It's a waste of time, a waste of energy, and a waste of space. If you value your sanity, stay far, far away from this place. Go to one of the other post offices in the area, like the ones on St. Rose or Horizon Ridge. They're not perfect, but they're infinitely better than this dump. Or, you know, just use carrier pigeons. At least they're reliable.

The server was amazing! Through out the meal his was very helpful and friendly..... but that doesn't make up for the awful food! Ambiance doesn't make up for the disgusting food. The food is so bad..... it makes it over priced. 

We started off with veggie dumplings. Let me just say, Trader Joe's makes better dumplings! The we got an tuna wasabi appetizer. The pieces were so big, we could barely fit them in our mouth! We also got another roll that was cut into large pieces.

It comes down to this, I don't mind spend money on a good meal! What a waste of money!

Don't go!!!!! 

Overall, my experience was extremely disappointing. I expected much better quality and presentation from this establishment. Unfortunately, the subpar food and oversized portions overshadowed the excellent service. Unless they revamp their menu and cooking techniques, I would strongly advise against dining here. Save your money and opt for a better culinary experience elsewhere. One star from me, and that's being generous.

The quality of the sushi and happy hour deals are definitely worth returning for. However, the poor service from the bartender was a major letdown. Despite this, we enjoyed our meal and would recommend the poppers and other dishes, hoping that the service improves on future visits.

Wanted check out this new spot. Support local business.

Service was a little slow but nice.

I was debating on a rice dish, but had to do Pho because it's in their name. I got #P1.

For the Large size, there wasn't enough meat or noodles, there was more than enough soup though. The Pho itself was avg, you're not going to hate it, it is what it is.

Granted Im 5'10 170lbs and just got done working out, but I'm leaving the restaurant hungry and going to find another meal.

For $10 just for the special and no drink.... Just not worth my time 

If other reviewers like it, that's great, but I wouldn't recommend this spot to anyone.

Unfortunately, my experience was underwhelming, and I left feeling disappointed. The value for the price was not there, and I expected more from a place with 'Pho' in its name. Perhaps they'll improve with time, but for now, I'll be taking my business elsewhere. Overall, a subpar dining experience that failed to impress.

The friendly staff and efficient checkout process made my shopping experience even more pleasant. I was able to quickly find everything I needed and get back to my temporary accommodation. Overall, I'm impressed with this Target location and appreciate the convenience it provided during my unexpected extended stay in Phoenix. The store's organization and amenities exceeded my expectations.

I'm extremely disappointed in not only the product, but also the response from the owner, Johnathan. As a customer, I expect a certain level of quality and service, and this place fell short on both accounts. The fact that the owner would resort to hostile comments instead of taking constructive feedback is alarming. It's clear that they are more concerned with defending their ego than with providing a good experience for their customers. I will definitely be sharing my negative experience with friends, family, and online communities, and I would advise others to think twice before visiting this establishment. The lack of flavor and unappetizing texture of their Nutella ice cream was bad enough, but the owner's behavior has ensured that I will never be back.

The atmosphere is always lively and welcoming, making it an ideal spot to catch up with friends or meet new people. The staff is friendly and attentive, ensuring that your glasses are always full. The variety of games and activities keeps things entertaining, and the affordable prices make it a great value. Whether you're a local or just visiting, Brewski's is a must-visit destination in Pittsburgh. With its unique motto and relaxed vibe, it's the perfect place to unwind and have a great time. I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a fun night out.

The crowd was a mix of wannabe socialites and people trying too hard to fit in, all gathered around the bar, ordering overpriced drinks and pretending to have the time of their lives. The music was loud, but it was just a generic playlist that could be found at any other club. I didn't see anything unique or special about this place that would justify the hefty cover charge and outrageous drink prices. The pool area was nice, I'll give them that, but it was crowded and felt more like a tourist trap than a luxurious oasis.

As I looked around, I noticed that everyone was more concerned with taking selfies and showing off their fake smiles than actually enjoying themselves. It was like they were all trying to prove something to someone, but I'm not sure who. The vibe was superficial and lacking in any real substance. I've been to plenty of other clubs that had a more genuine and lively atmosphere, where people were actually there to have fun and connect with others, not just to be seen.

Overall, my experience at Surrender was underwhelming and felt like a waste of money. Unless you're into the whole pretentious scene and don't mind throwing your cash around, I'd recommend looking elsewhere for a more authentic and enjoyable nightlife experience. With so many other great options out there, I wouldn't bother coming back to this place again. The whole experience left a bad taste in my mouth, and I'm glad to be done with it.

The unique burger option showcases the Dane's creative twist on classic pub fare. Overall, it's a solid choice for a casual night out with friends or a low-key dinner. While it may not be perfect, the Dane's charm and offerings make it a worthwhile stop when in the area, earning its four-star rating with ease and consistency.

I've been coming back to Echo regularly and have yet to be disappointed. The consistency in their coffee and service is impressive, and I appreciate the attention to detail they bring to every drink. The atmosphere remains cozy and inviting, making it an ideal spot for studying, working, or simply catching up with friends. I've also noticed that they often have local art on display, which adds a nice touch to the overall ambiance. Overall, Echo has become my go-to coffee shop, and I highly recommend it to anyone looking for a welcoming and productive space to hang out.

As I reflected on my experience, I couldn't help but think that the restaurant's potential was hindered by a series of minor mishaps. The food, when it was correctly prepared and presented, was indeed superb. The filet was cooked to perfection, and the flavors of the garlic-onion mashed potatoes and Port syrup complemented it beautifully. The grilled asparagus was a nice touch, and I appreciated the effort to incorporate seasonal ingredients into the dish.

However, the inconsistencies in service and attention to detail were glaring. From the initial lack of acknowledgement at the podium to the confusion over the Groupon and the missing ingredients, it seemed like the restaurant was struggling to get its act together. The charge for a partial refill of iced tea seemed petty, and the fact that they were out of bananas for the dessert was a significant disappointment.

I also couldn't help but wonder about the communication breakdown between the staff. The woman who seated me seemed unsure about the Groupon policy, and the manager's request to copy my ID seemed unnecessary and overly cautious. The fact that the kitchen was missing key ingredients, such as the crispy tater strings and bananas, suggested a lack of planning and preparation.

Despite these issues, I did appreciate the effort that the restaurant put into plating and presentation. The dishes looked appealing, and the use of garnishes and sauces added a touch of elegance to the meal. However, the overall experience was marred by the accumulation of little things that went wrong.

As I finished my meal and prepared to leave, I couldn't help but feel that Addiction had missed an opportunity to impress. With a bit more attention to detail and a more streamlined service, this restaurant could easily earn the 4 or 4.5 stars that it aspires to. As it stands, however, the little things that went wrong added up to a significant subtraction in my enjoyment of the meal. I'm not sure if I'll give Addiction another chance, but I hope that they take my feedback to heart and work to address the issues that detracted from my experience. With a bit of tweaking, this restaurant could truly live up to its potential and provide a memorable dining experience for its customers.

As the night wore on, our frustration and disappointment only grew. The lack of attention to detail and poor service was staggering, especially considering the high prices we were paying. It seemed like the staff was overwhelmed and understaffed, which led to a chaotic and disorganized dining experience. The fact that we had to repeatedly ask for basic items like utensils and water was unacceptable.

The food, aside from the lamb chops, was a letdown. The steak, as I mentioned, was ridiculously undercooked, and the other dishes were just average. The family-style service, which we had agreed to, ended up being a disaster. The portions were unevenly distributed, and it seemed like the staff was more interested in pushing the expensive meats than in ensuring that everyone had a pleasant dining experience.

The noise level was also a major issue. The restaurant was so loud that we had to shout to be heard, which made it difficult to carry on conversations. The tight seating arrangement didn't help, and my husband's repeated collisions with the waiters were a testament to the cramped quarters.

Given the exorbitant prices and the promises of a high-end dining experience, we expected much more from this restaurant. Unfortunately, our experience was a resounding disappointment. The $2100 bill, which included a 20% tip, was a bitter pill to swallow, especially considering the subpar service and food. As we left the restaurant after a lengthy three hours, we couldn't help but feel that we had been ripped off. The memory of that disastrous dinner party will linger, and we will definitely not be returning to this establishment anytime soon.
Our server seemed completely disinterested, and the manager was nowhere to be found to address our concerns, making the experience even more disappointing and overpriced.

Overall, we were thoroughly impressed with the laid-back atmosphere and excellent service at this hidden gem. The fact that they took the bread pudding off our bill without us even asking was a testament to their commitment to customer satisfaction. We appreciated the attention to detail in their menu items, such as the unique twist on the mac'n cheese. The prices were also very reasonable, especially during happy hour. We would definitely recommend this spot to anyone looking for a relaxed and welcoming place to grab a drink and some good food. The casual dress code and abundance of seating made it feel like a great spot to meet up with friends or catch a sports game. We're already planning our next visit to escape the Scottsdale heat and enjoy some more of their tasty treats.

Overall, my experience at Cien Agaves has been a mixed bag, but I can appreciate their strengths. The tequila selection is undoubtedly one of the highlights, with an impressive array of options to choose from. The margaritas, as I mentioned earlier, are also a standout, packing a punch and making for a great accompaniment to their Taco Tuesday offerings. 

However, the food, while not terrible, fails to impress. The shredded beef tacos, although a bargain at a dollar apiece, lack a certain depth of flavor and texture that would elevate them to the next level. It's clear that the kitchen is capable of producing decent, if unremarkable, dishes, but they don't quite live up to the standards set by the bar.

Despite the occasional live music and the undeniable charm of a quiet, upscale atmosphere, Cien Agaves struggles to draw a crowd outside of their weekly Taco Tuesday specials. Perhaps this is due in part to the lack of a patio, which seems to be a major draw for many of their competitors. Whatever the reason, it's a shame, as the bar itself has a certain appeal that's worth exploring. If you're a tequila enthusiast or just looking for a low-key spot to grab a drink, Cien Agaves might be worth a visit – just don't expect to be blown away by the food.

I was disappointed by the misrepresentation, as a traditional rarebit is a beloved British dish. The tortilla dish, while tasty, did not resemble rarebit in any way. I appreciate creativity, but not at the expense of accuracy. It's a shame, as the restaurant has potential, but this experience left a sour taste. I hope they revisit their menu to better reflect the dishes they serve, especially when using names that evoke strong cultural associations.

The atmosphere was lively, yet intimate, making it perfect for a date or a special occasion. The background music was subtle, allowing for easy conversation, and the lighting was dimmed just enough to create a romantic ambiance. Our server, although a bit overzealous with the check-ins, was attentive and knowledgeable about the menu, making excellent recommendations.

The food, as I mentioned earlier, was delicious and plentiful. The lasagna was cooked to perfection, with layers of tender pasta, rich meat sauce, and a blend of creamy cheeses. My date's chicken parmesan was also a hit, with a crispy exterior giving way to juicy, flavorful chicken. We both left feeling satisfied, but not overly stuffed, which was a nice change of pace from the typical heavy, indulgent meals often found at Italian restaurants.

Despite the few quirks with the service, our overall experience at Nick's was exceptional. The combination of great food, elegant atmosphere, and attentive (if slightly humorous) service made for a wonderful afternoon out. I would highly recommend Nick's to anyone looking for a nice spot to take a date, celebrate a special occasion, or simply enjoy a delicious meal in a sophisticated setting. With multiple locations throughout the valley, it's convenient to find one near you. I'm already looking forward to my next visit and exploring more of their extensive menu. Whether you're a foodie, a romantic, or just someone who appreciates a great dining experience, Nick's is definitely worth checking out.

The overall atmosphere felt dated and uninviting, with a clear lack of attention to detail. For a restaurant of this caliber, it's unacceptable to have subpar service and hit-or-miss dishes. The fact that we had to repeatedly ask for refills and wait extended periods for our orders to be fulfilled was frustrating. The valet experience was also a nuisance, and the added fee felt like an unnecessary insult. Given the high prices, I expected a much more refined and enjoyable experience. Unfortunately, this establishment fell far short of my expectations, and I would not recommend it to others. The comparison to Outback is apt, as I've had better meals and service at a fraction of the cost.

Despite the issues with the grilled shrimp salad and the service, I can appreciate the effort that the staff puts into making everything to order. The kitchen may be unorganized, but it's clear that they're trying to provide a homemade touch to their dishes. The no-frills location and Styrofoam boxes may not be the most appealing, but it's a small price to pay for the affordability and flavor of the grilled fish and mac and cheese.

However, the issue at the register is a major concern that needs to be addressed. In today's digital age, it's unacceptable to have a payment system that requires customers to read out their sensitive information loud. This is not only a violation of privacy but also a significant security risk. I hope that the management takes steps to update their payment system and train their staff on how to handle sensitive information securely.

Overall, I would recommend this place to those who are looking for a quick and affordable bite, but with the caveat that they should stick to the grilled fish and mac and cheese. The inconsistent quality and service issues hold me back from giving a full endorsement, but I appreciate the effort and potential that this place has. With some improvements to their payment system and kitchen efficiency, this place could be a hidden gem. For now, it's a solid option for a budget-friendly meal, but be aware of the potential drawbacks.

"However, some menu items fall short. With a few tweaks, this place could truly shine, as the waffle sandwich and cheesecake showcase their potential for excellence, leaving me hopeful for future improvements."
Great for families or a quick bite, the atmosphere is casual and welcoming, making it an excellent choice for any pizza lover seeking a satisfying meal.

The combination of a lively atmosphere and proximity to public transportation makes Maizie's an ideal spot for a low-key gathering. Although the noise level inside can be overwhelming, the outdoor patio provides a pleasant alternative for those seeking a more subdued experience. With its satisfying food options and convenient location, Maizie's has the potential to become a regular haunt for those in the area. To take it to the next level, the establishment could focus on refining its service, perhaps by providing more attentive and friendly staff to enhance the overall dining experience. Despite some minor drawbacks, Maizie's remains a solid choice for a casual, weekday hangout.

As I delved deeper into the variety of donuts, I found myself appreciating the presentation and creativity that went into each piece. The attention to detail and the effort to create unique flavor combinations were evident, but unfortunately, the execution fell short. I think with a bit more refinement and balance in the flavors, this donut shop could truly stand out from the rest. For now, I would recommend it to those looking to impress their friends or colleagues with visually stunning treats, but not necessarily for those seeking a truly exceptional donut experience.

The prices were reasonable, considering the complexity of the designs and the generous serving sizes. However, I do think that the quality of the ingredients could be improved to elevate the overall taste and texture of the donuts. Perhaps with some tweaking of the recipes and a focus on using higher-quality ingredients, this donut shop could reach its full potential. Until then, I would suggest visiting for the novelty and creativity, but not necessarily for a satisfying donut fix. With a bit more work on the flavor profiles, I could see this shop becoming a top destination for donut enthusiasts, but for now, it's more of a fun and quirky spot to grab a unique treat.

As I walked through the sliding glass doors, I was immediately impressed by the modern and sleek interior design. The wide aisles and well-organized shelves made it easy to navigate and find what I was looking for. The fresh food section was a game-changer, with a vast selection of fruits, vegetables, meats, and baked goods that rivaled any traditional grocery store. I was pleased to see that the prices were competitive with other stores in the area, making it a great option for weekly grocery shopping.

The addition of a new Pharmacy, Photo, Starbucks, and Target Cafe with Pizza Hut Express was a nice touch, providing a one-stop shopping experience. I was able to grab a coffee and snack while I shopped, and the Pizza Hut Express was a great option for a quick and easy meal. The staff was friendly and helpful, eager to answer any questions I had about the store or its products. Overall, I was thoroughly impressed with this new Target Store and its expanded food format. It's a great addition to the community, and I'm excited to make it my go-to destination for groceries and other essentials. With its convenient location and ample parking, I'm sure it will become a popular spot for locals and visitors alike.

The food at TaTa Bistro is a highlight, with a wide range of options to suit different cravings. I've tried their sushi and teppanyaki dishes, and both were cooked to perfection. The portion sizes are generous, and the flavors are well-balanced. The "lunch box" specials are a great value, offering a combination of dishes at an affordable price. While the slow service can be a drawback, the friendly staff makes up for it. Overall, TaTa Bistro is a great spot for a casual meal with friends or coworkers. The relaxed atmosphere and varied menu make it an excellent choice for a low-key dining experience. With its affordable prices and tasty food, I would definitely recommend TaTa Bistro for a quick and satisfying meal.

I was shocked and appalled by the door guy's behavior, and the fact that he felt entitled to use physical force against me simply because I made a joke about the situation. As a customer, I expect to be treated with respect and dignity, regardless of any mistakes I may have made. The fact that the establishment employs someone who thinks it's acceptable to push a small, intoxicated woman around is deeply disturbing. The owner of the nearby shop who intervened was kind and apologetic, but it was clear that he was also shocked by the door guy's behavior. I'm extremely disappointed in the way I was treated, and I will not be returning to this establishment again. In fact, I will be making sure to tell all my friends and family about the horrible experience I had, and I hope that the management will take steps to address this issue and ensure that their customers are treated with the respect they deserve. The food may have been good in the past, but it's not worth risking my safety and well-being to eat there again.

Overall, our experience at this Tapas restaurant was exceptional. The combination of delicious food, excellent service, and cozy ambiance made for a fantastic evening out. The staff's attention to detail and willingness to go above and beyond, such as lending us a charger, really made us feel valued as customers. The prices were also very reasonable, especially considering the high quality of the dishes. We would definitely recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a fun and lively spot to grab a bite before a night out. Whether you're with a group of friends or on a date, this Tapas restaurant is sure to impress. We can't wait to come back and try more of their tasty dishes! The atmosphere is lively and fun, making it an ideal spot to start your night out.

The atmosphere is always lively, and the staff remembers my order every time. The TLT is a game-changer, and the bacon adds a smoky flavor. Leaving the skin on the trout is a must-try for any trout lover. Overall, it's a fantastic spot to unwind after a round of golf, with great food and welcoming regulars.

The bartenders were friendly and knowledgeable, crafting classic cocktails with ease. Although it was crowded, the vibe remained lively and welcoming. I was thrilled to see the jukebox still spinning great tunes, adding to the nostalgic charm. Overall, The Squirrel Cage remains a San Francisco staple, and I'm already looking forward to my next visit to relive old memories and create new ones.

The scenery is beautiful, with a mix of wooded areas and open fields. Wildlife is abundant, and it's not uncommon to see deer or turkeys during your visit. The park is well-maintained, with clear signage and amenities like restrooms and water fountains. Overall, I highly recommend this park to outdoor enthusiasts looking for a challenging and scenic escape from the city. Whether you're a seasoned athlete or just starting out, there's something for everyone in this incredible urban oasis.
The unique flavors were intriguing, but overall, the experience was just average, lacking the wow factor to justify the high prices and make me want to return for another visit anytime soon.

and I would not recommend it to anyone. The service was also subpar, with our waitress seeming completely unbothered by our complaints. The fact that she tried to pass off the overcooked appetizer as normal is a clear indication of the lack of training and attention to detail in the kitchen. For a restaurant chain that typically delivers high-quality seafood, this location is a major disappointment. The small, watery crab legs were the final nail in the coffin, leaving a bad taste in my mouth. Needless to say, I will be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere.

Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner, the staff is attentive and prices are reasonable, making it an excellent spot to relax and enjoy a tasty meal in a cozy setting, highly recommended for its overall value and quality.

Overall, I'd say this post office gets the job done, but don't expect a warm welcome. The similarity to our hometown post office was amusing, but the lackluster service was a letdown. Perhaps it was just an off day, but I wouldn't go out of my way to recommend this location for its customer experience. Nonetheless, it's a functional stop for shipping needs, and the quick in-and-out was a plus.

"Always a pleasure to dine here, friendly staff and great value. Highly recommend for a delicious breakfast or brunch option, convenient location and ample parking make it an ideal choice for those visiting the strip."

As the seminar came to an abrupt end, I couldn't help but feel disappointed and frustrated with the lack of attention and expertise provided by the trainer. Despite being the only participant, I felt like I was just an afterthought, and the trainer's primary goal was to make a sale rather than actually help me address my dog's loose leash walking issues. The fact that she spent more time gossiping with her coworkers than observing and providing feedback on my dog's behavior was appalling. I was expecting a comprehensive and interactive seminar, but what I got was a rushed and unproductive session that left me with more questions than answers.

The trainer's attempt to sell me a harness and treats was not only unprofessional but also insensitive, considering my dog was already wearing a similar harness. It seemed like she had a scripted sales pitch that she was determined to follow, regardless of my dog's actual needs. I was also put off by her pushy attempt to enroll me in her intermediate class, which I declined due to the lack of confidence I had in her training abilities. Overall, I would not recommend this training seminar or trainer to anyone, and I'm extremely disappointed in the level of service provided by Petsmart. For a company that claims to care about pets, they certainly didn't show it in this instance.

The lack of hospitality and poor service only added to our disappointing experience. It's clear that the restaurant is more focused on its trendy, organic label than actually providing a quality dining experience. The fact that the waitress didn't even attempt to make us feel welcome or apologize for the subpar food is a clear indication of the establishment's priorities. As we left, I couldn't help but feel that we had wasted our time and money on a meal that was not only unappetizing but also uncomfortable. The combination of bad food, poor acoustics, and inconsiderate patrons made for a truly awful experience. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone and will definitely not be returning. The fact that they can't even get the basics right is a shame, and the "organic" label is just a facade for their lack of culinary skill.

We had a wonderful evening, the ambiance was perfect, and the staff were attentive and knowledgeable, making our dining experience truly unforgettable and leaving us eager to return and recommend to others.

I was impressed by their wide range of sizes and styles. The owner and her granddaughter provided excellent customer service, helping me find the perfect fit. Overall, I'm glad I discovered their new location and look forward to returning for all my intimate apparel needs in a welcoming atmosphere.

As we sat down at our newly chosen table, I couldn't help but feel a sense of relief, but also a bit of frustration that we had to ask to be moved in the first place. The ambiance of the restaurant was lively and modern, with flashy decor and a bustling atmosphere, but it didn't quite make up for the subpar food and service. Our server, while attentive at times, seemed more focused on ensuring we tipped well than providing genuine hospitality. The food, as I mentioned earlier, was mediocre at best, with the Jambalaya being the highlight of our meal, but even that was nothing special. 

The portions were decent, but not large enough to justify the hefty prices. We left feeling somewhat disappointed and a bit ripped off, even with the Groupon deal. For a restaurant with such a flashy reputation, I expected more in terms of quality and service. Perhaps Sugar Factory is better suited for those looking for a trendy spot to take Instagram photos, rather than a genuine dining experience. Overall, I would not recommend Sugar Factory to anyone looking for a good meal at a reasonable price. There are far better options available, and I would not be returning to this establishment anytime soon. The experience was a letdown, and the strip pricing only added to our disappointment.

I was shocked and appalled by her lack of empathy and understanding. It's clear that her priority is making money, not providing quality patient care. The fact that she would try to send me to a detox center without even considering my medical history or current treatment plan is alarming. Her dismissive attitude and unwillingness to work with me to find a solution that fit my needs was the final straw. I would not recommend Dr. Basu to my worst enemy, let alone someone who is genuinely seeking medical help. If you value your health and well-being, stay far away from this doctor and find someone who actually cares.

Despite that unpleasant incident, I've returned to this frozen yogurt place and am glad to see that the staff has improved in handling such situations. The store is always clean and well-maintained, which is a big plus. The variety of flavors and toppings is still impressive, and I appreciate the unique options like Taro and Red Bean. The pay-by-the-ounce system is also convenient, allowing me to try a little of everything without breaking the bank. Overall, this remains my go-to spot for frozen yogurt, and I'm happy to see that they've addressed my previous concerns. With its wide selection and improved customer experience, I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for a sweet treat.

Despite the subpar service, the quality of the food and the overall atmosphere of the FB kept us from leaving completely disappointed. The warm chicken salad was cooked to perfection, with tender chicken and a delicious blend of flavors. The veggie scramble was also a hit, with a generous portion of fresh vegetables and a fluffy texture. The biscuits, as I mentioned earlier, were a unique twist on the traditional Southern biscuit, and paired well with the honey.

It's worth noting that our experience with the service was not typical of our previous visits to the FB. In the past, we've had friendly and attentive waitstaff who were always happy to refill our drinks and clear our plates.
