From the beautifully presented dishes to the elegant table settings, every element is carefully considered to create a sophisticated and refined atmosphere. The outdoor seating area, with its stunning view of the Bellagio fountain, is a must-try, even on a chilly evening. The sound of the water and the music accompanying the fountain show added a touch of magic to our meal, making it a truly unforgettable experience. Overall, I would highly recommend Olives to anyone looking for a top-notch dining experience in Las Vegas. With its exceptional food, impeccable service, and stunning ambiance, it is a restaurant that is sure to impress even the most discerning palates.

The staff were friendly and attentive, regularly refilling drinks and clearing plates. Despite the limited options, the dishes that were available were freshly prepared and flavorful. I particularly enjoyed the naan bread and the chicken tikka masala. However, the dessert selection was lacking, with only a few choices available. Overall, while Spice Cafe shows promise, it needs to expand its buffet offerings to compete with other Indian restaurants in the area. I'm willing to give them another chance to see if they can improve and provide a more diverse dining experience.

The level of customer service we received was appalling, and it's clear that this company prioritizes making a quick profit over taking care of their passengers. The fact that they don't accept cash is already a major inconvenience, but the way they handled the situation with my co-worker's lost wallet was absolutely unacceptable. The dispatcher's lack of effort to assist us and the driver's unconvincing denial of having the wallet only added to our frustration. We were left with no choice but to take matters into our own hands and report the incident to the authorities. I would strongly advise against using this cab company, as they seem to have no regard for their customers' well-being or property. The hassle and stress we experienced were completely avoidable, and I hope that others can learn from our terrible experience.

The service was attentive and friendly, our server checked in on us just the right amount. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, perfect for a low-key evening out. The food portions were generous and the prices were reasonable. I was impressed by the quality of the ingredients and the presentation of the dishes. The Trifecta was a highlight, with each component complementing the others beautifully. Overall, I'm glad we stumbled upon this hidden gem and I'm already looking forward to my next visit to try more of their menu offerings.

As we finally started to receive our dishes, we were impressed by the presentation and the aroma of the food. The dry chili chicken, which I mentioned earlier, was a highlight of the meal - crispy, spicy, and full of flavor. The Kung Pao chicken was also delicious, with a nice balance of savory and spicy notes. However, the long wait had taken a toll on our appetite, and we couldn't fully enjoy the food as we would have liked.

Despite the chaos in the kitchen, the service staff were friendly and attentive, trying their best to keep us updated on the status of our food. The manager's apology and offer to comp our meal were a nice touch, and we appreciated the effort to make things right. As we finished our meal and prepared to leave, we couldn't help but feel that Lao Sze Chuan has potential, but they need to work on their kitchen workflow and communication to provide a better dining experience.

With some tweaks to their service and kitchen management, I would definitely consider returning to Lao Sze Chuan to try more of their dishes. The food is delicious, and the atmosphere is cozy and inviting. Perhaps it's best to visit on a less busy night, or to call ahead to ask about wait times. For now, I would recommend Lao Sze Chuan to fans of spicy Sze Chuan cuisine, but with the caveat to be patient and prepared for potential delays.

As I reflected on my stay, I couldn't help but feel that the Wynn's focus on nickel-and-diming their guests overshadowed the luxurious amenities and accommodations they have to offer. The room, as I mentioned, was stunning, with a comfortable king-sized bed and a beautifully appointed living area. The gym, too, was a highlight, with its top-of-the-line equipment and thoughtful amenities like free headphones and water bottles. However, these positives were consistently offset by the resort's puzzling attempts to squeeze extra revenue out of their guests.

The issues with the Le Reve tickets and the buffet credit were just the beginning. Throughout our stay, we encountered numerous other small but frustrating examples of the Wynn's penny-pinching approach. For example, the in-room Wi-Fi was slow and unreliable, and the resort charged an exorbitant fee for parking. These may seem like minor complaints, but they added up to create a sense of annoyance and disappointment that lingered throughout our stay.

What's more, the Wynn's customer service team seemed woefully unprepared to address these issues. When I spoke with the reservations agent and the managers, I was met with a combination of defensiveness and indifference. It was clear that they were more interested in following the resort's policies and procedures than in providing genuine assistance and resolving our problems.

Ultimately, my experience at the Wynn was a disappointment, and it's unlikely that I'll be returning anytime soon. While the room and gym were certainly highlights, the resort's focus on maximizing revenue and minimizing expenses created a sense of frustration and disillusionment that I wouldn't wish on anyone. If you're looking for a truly luxurious and hassle-free experience, I would strongly encourage you to consider other options. The Wynn may have a reputation for excellence, but in my opinion, it falls far short of the mark.

The experience was extremely disappointing, and the lack of concern from the staff was appalling. It's clear that they're more interested in handing out coupons to lure in customers than actually providing a decent meal. The fact that the place was empty when I picked up my order should have been a red flag, as it suggests that the food may have been sitting out for a while. The boiled chicken was tough and fatty, and the overcooked rice was dry and flavorless. For the same price, you can get a high-quality meal at a reputable restaurant like PF Changs. It's shocking that this place has managed to stay in business, and I would strongly advise others to avoid it at all costs. Save your money and your taste buds, and take your business elsewhere.

The service is always friendly and attentive, making our dining experience even more enjoyable. We've never had a bad meal here, and the prices are very reasonable. The atmosphere is casual and welcoming, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner with family and friends, making it a great spot to satisfy our Mexican food cravings.

The convenience was much appreciated. We ended up visiting twice during our trip, and both times the staff were friendly and accommodating. The variety of donuts was impressive, and the fact that they catered to vegan diets was a huge plus. Overall, I'm so glad we stumbled upon this hidden gem, and I highly recommend it to anyone with a sweet tooth, especially those with dietary restrictions. It's definitely a must-visit when in Vegas.

The wall-mounted sofa bed was uncomfortable and lacked proper bedding. Overall, my stay was disappointing, and I wouldn't recommend this Hyatt location to others. For the price, I expected better service and amenities. Unfortunately, this experience fell short of my expectations, making it a less desirable choice for future travels.

that offer a more relaxed atmosphere and similar quality of food and drinks. I've tried to give this place multiple chances, but the inconvenience always outweighs the positives. Unless they expand or improve their seating and waiting area, I'll have to take my business elsewhere. The hassle just isn't worth it, no matter how great their beer selection is.

We were thoroughly impressed with our experience and would definitely recommend this spot to friends and family. The "holy shitake" pizza was a highlight, with the garlic sauce and herb crust complementing the earthy flavor of the mushrooms perfectly. The portion size was generous, and we left feeling satisfied but not overly stuffed. The casual atmosphere made it an ideal spot for a low-key dinner or gathering with friends. The fact that they cater to alternative diets is a big plus, and the variety of options on the menu ensures that there's something for everyone. We're looking forward to trying more of their menu items, especially the gluten-free pizzas and other unique pizza bases. With its friendly staff, clean facilities, and delicious food, this pizza place has won us over and we'll be back for more. Overall, a great addition to the neighborhood.

Unfortunately, my latest experience at Kanda in Laval was the final straw. The sushi was no longer the delicious, fresh dish I had grown to love. Instead, it was lackluster and uninspiring, with some pieces even tasting stale. The presentation, which was once beautifully done, now seemed sloppy and rushed. For a place that was once a staple for our group outings, it's sad to see the quality decline so significantly. The combination of poor service and subpar food is a recipe for disaster, and I fear that Kanda will continue to lose customers if they don't make some serious changes. As much as I hate to say it, I'll be taking my business (and my love of sushi) elsewhere from now on. It's time to find a new go-to spot that can deliver on both quality and service.

I'm extremely disappointed in the way my situation was handled by both the Downtown Grand and Choice Hotels corporate. The lack of effort to provide a meaningful resolution is staggering. A form letter apology from Choice Hotels corporate is not only insulting, but it also shows a complete disregard for customer satisfaction. I had expected more from a reputable hotel chain like Choice Hotels.

The offer from Sarah, the business manager at the Downtown Grand, to reschedule my stay for another time, although appreciated, is not a viable solution for me. As I mentioned earlier, I won't be able to make it to Vegas by July 2015, which makes the offer essentially worthless. I was really hoping for a full refund or at least a partial refund, which would have been a fair compromise.

The fact that the Downtown Grand is keeping my $400+ and not providing any meaningful compensation is not only unfair but also short-sighted. As I mentioned, my friends and I usually spend a significant amount of money at the hotel's pizza restaurant and were considering staying at the hotel this time. However, due to the way my situation was handled, we have decided to take our business elsewhere. The Downtown Grand's loss of our business will likely exceed a couple of thousand dollars per year, which is a significant amount for any hotel.

In conclusion, my experience with the Downtown Grand has been extremely disappointing, and I would not recommend this hotel to anyone. The hotel's inability to provide a fair resolution to my situation and the lack of effort from Choice Hotels corporate to address my concerns have left a sour taste in my mouth. Unless the hotel changes its policies and starts prioritizing customer satisfaction, I fear that they will continue to lose business from loyal customers like myself.

However, if you're seeking a more vibrant atmosphere or a place to enjoy a quiet evening, you might want to consider other options. The music is loud, and the overall ambiance can be overwhelming, especially on weekends when the bar is packed. I've noticed that the crowd can get quite rowdy, which might not be ideal for everyone. On the other hand, if you're looking for a no-frills, budget-friendly spot to grab a drink with friends, Bar Salsa might fit the bill. Just be prepared for the crowds and noise. It's also worth noting that the bar's small size can make it feel claustrophobic, especially when it's busy. Despite its limitations, Bar Salsa seems to have a loyal following, and I can see why it appeals to some people. Ultimately, whether or not you'll enjoy Bar Salsa depends on your personal preferences and what you're looking for in a nightlife experience. If you're in the area and want to try something new, it might be worth stopping by, but I wouldn't go out of my way to visit. With its cheap drinks and lively atmosphere, Bar Salsa is a decent option for a night out, but it's not a standout destination in my book.

In addition to the excellent food, I also appreciate the cozy and intimate atmosphere of Thai House. The decor is traditional and inviting, with warm colors and Thai-inspired artwork adorning the walls. The small space can get crowded, especially on weekends, but it only adds to the energetic and lively vibe of the restaurant. The owners and staff are always friendly and welcoming, making you feel like you're part of the family.

One thing that sets Thai House apart from other Thai restaurants is their attention to detail and commitment to using high-quality ingredients. You can tell that they're using fresh herbs and spices, and the dishes are carefully prepared to ensure that each bite is bursting with flavor. The portion sizes are also generous, making it a great value for the price.

Overall, I highly recommend Thai House to anyone looking for delicious and authentic Thai cuisine. While the service may not be perfect, the food and atmosphere more than make up for it. And at these prices, it's a steal. Whether you're a seasoned foodie or just looking for a new place to try, Thai House is definitely worth a visit. I've been coming back for years, and I'm sure you will too once you taste their incredible Panang curry and other dishes. With its perfect balance of flavor, price, and atmosphere, Thai House is sure to remain one of my go-to spots for Thai food.

The quality of the meat and sides was impressive, and the service was friendly. Despite the price, I enjoyed my visit and would recommend it to others. Perhaps with a few more options or larger portions, Joes could justify the cost and give Kinfolks a run for its money. Overall, a solid choice for BBQ lovers.

I was thoroughly disappointed with the lunch service, especially considering my fantastic dinner experience. The long wait times and subpar food quality were a stark contrast to the prompt and delicious meal I had during happy hour. It's clear that the restaurant struggles to maintain consistency across different meal services. The fact that there was only one waiter and one chef/cook on duty during lunch hours may have contributed to the delays, but it's no excuse for the poor food quality. The over-salting of the duck confit bun was inexcusable, and the lack of authenticity in their house iced tea was a minor but notable disappointment. 

Despite the horrible lunch experience, I still believe that the restaurant has potential, given my previous dinner experience. However, I would caution against visiting during lunch hours until they address their service and food quality issues. Perhaps they could consider increasing staff during peak hours or reworking their recipes to ensure consistency. Until then, I would recommend sticking to dinner service, where they seem to excel. It's a shame that my cousin's last meal in Madison had to be such a letdown, but I hope that the restaurant will take feedback like mine to heart and make necessary improvements.

The lack of concern and inadequate response from the manager was appalling. A simple dessert offer did not compensate for the potential health risk I faced. I expected a more sincere apology, a complimentary meal, or even an offer to replace the contaminated soup. Instead, I was left feeling disrespected and unvalued as a customer. This experience has led me to question the restaurant's quality control and cleanliness standards. I will not be returning to Zupas and would advise others to exercise caution when dining there, carefully inspecting their food before consumption.

but would consider it if in the area. The high points were the decor and dessert, while the low points were the overcooked steak and underwhelming appetizers. With a larger group, the service was somewhat strained, but our server did their best. Overall, an average experience that didn't exceed expectations, leaving me feeling neutral about recommending it to others. Perhaps a smaller group or different menu choices would yield a better outcome.

The ambiance was elegant and sophisticated, with dim lighting and comfortable seating. Our waiter was attentive and knowledgeable, making excellent recommendations throughout the evening. The portions were generous, to say the least, and the prices were reasonable considering the high quality of the food and service. Overall, our experience at "The D" was exceptional, and we can't wait to return and try more of their delicious dishes. The combination of outstanding cuisine, impeccable service, and cozy atmosphere makes this restaurant a must-visit for anyone looking for a top-notch dining experience. We're already planning our next visit.
The atmosphere is cozy and inviting, with friendly staff making up for the long wait times, making this place a must-visit for foodies and brunch enthusiasts alike, every single time.

I'm extremely disappointed in the overall experience at this establishment. The combination of rude staff, inconsistent service, and blatant disregard for customer satisfaction is appalling. It's clear that the management prioritizes profits over people, as the staff seems to be more interested in turning tables than providing a pleasant dining experience. The fact that I was denied service and forced to leave because of a ridiculous policy is unacceptable. The happy hour and all-you-can-eat deals may be enticing, but the hassle and frustration that come with them are not worth it. I've tried to give this place multiple chances, but the consistent poor service has finally driven me away. I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone, and I will be taking my business (and my appetite) elsewhere. The Vegas roll may be delicious, but it's not enough to redeem the awful service and mistreatment of customers.

The staff was friendly and knowledgeable, making the experience stress-free for both me and my pets. The significant cost savings and convenience of the walk-in clinic make it an excellent option for pet owners. I highly recommend this place for all your pet vaccination needs, and I will definitely be returning for future vaccinations.
nothing special but good portions and prices, making it a solid option for a casual, no-frills meal in the area, with standard Chinese fare and no surprises.

The atmosphere of the restaurant was lively and vibrant, with a fun and eclectic decor that immediately transported us to the Caribbean. The music was upbeat and added to the energetic vibe of the place. Tony and Beth, the bartenders, were not only knowledgeable about the menu and drinks, but also warm and welcoming, making us feel like we were part of the family. We loved hearing about Tony's recent move from Portland and sharing our own experiences of spending summers in Oregon.

As we sipped our drinks and savored our appetizers, we couldn't help but feel like we were in for a real treat. The Scallops and Plantain and Avocado Spring Rolls were just the beginning of an incredible culinary journey. The combination of flavors and textures was amazing, and we found ourselves wanting more. The pumpkin and sweet potato soup was a surprise hit, and I ended up devouring most of it. My husband's Kingston Rum Punch was potent, but delicious, and paired perfectly with the Rum Glazed Prawns and Roti Flatbread.

The Prawns were cooked to perfection, with a sweet and sticky glaze that complemented the tender roti flatbread. And the Pina Colada? Absolutely divine. It was clear that the bartender had put love and care into crafting each drink, using only the freshest ingredients and creative combinations. Even the bread pudding, which wasn't my favorite, was still enjoyable and a nice way to round off the meal.

What really impressed us, though, was the exceptional service. Tony and Beth were attentive, friendly, and made sure we had everything we needed throughout our meal. They were happy to answer our questions, make recommendations, and even shared some fun stories and anecdotes. The Rum Bar at Breadfruit is more than just a restaurant - it's an experience. And we can't wait to come back, bring our friends, and indulge in more of their delicious Caribbean cuisine and craft cocktails. If you're looking for a fun and lively spot with amazing food and drinks, look no further than Breadfruit. We'll definitely be back!

However, I must admit that Grape Street has a certain charm to it, and the ambiance is quite pleasant. The dim lighting and wooden decor do give it a cozy feel, reminiscent of a traditional wine cellar. The service, as I mentioned earlier, was prompt and efficient, with friendly staff who attended to our needs without being overly intrusive. Despite the improvements in my second visit, I still can't help but feel that the food is not quite up to par. The prices are also a bit steep for the quality of cuisine they offer. Overall, while Grape Street is a decent option for a casual meal, it falls short of being a truly exceptional dining experience. If you're in the area and looking for a reliable Italian meal, I would still recommend Parma over Grape Street. That being said, Grape Street might be worth a try if you're looking for a unique atmosphere and are willing to compromise on the food.

Overall, my dining experience was a letdown. The combination of the muddy tilapia, sweet sauce, and chemically-tasting avocados made for a dish that was both unappetizing and confusing. I appreciated the management's kindness in honoring our gift certificate, but the food itself was a major disappointment. With so many great fish taco options in the Valley, it's clear that this restaurant needs to go back to the drawing board and rethink their recipe. Unfortunately, I wouldn't recommend their fish tacos to anyone, and I'm still trying to figure out what inspired such a strange and unpalatable flavor combination.

Overall, our experience was a letdown, especially considering the high prices. With so many other excellent steakhouses in the area, it's unlikely we'll give this one another chance. The inconsistency in food quality and unimpressive dishes, like the rib steak and dessert, outweighed the pleasant ambiance and service, making it a disappointing evening for our large group.

The staff was friendly and the atmosphere was casual, making it a great spot for a quick lunch. The burger was cooked to perfection and the fries were crispy. I loved the nostalgia of drinking a Shasta soda from a can. Overall, I'm so glad I tried this place and I'll definitely be back for another delicious and affordable meal. The value for the price is unbeatable, and I've already recommended it to my coworkers.

I've never had a bad experience here, and the consistency is impressive. Friendly staff and great food make it a staple in our household, we always leave feeling satisfied and already looking forward to our next visit, it's a truly exceptional fast food establishment.

Overall, the experience was disappointing and overpriced. For a high-end steakhouse, I expected much better quality and attention to detail. The ambiance was nice, but it couldn't make up for the subpar food and service. Unfortunately, Craftsteak did not live up to its reputation, and I would not recommend it to others. With so many other excellent steak options in Vegas, there's no need to settle for a lackluster meal like the one we had at Craftsteak.

The lack of customer service and attention to detail is appalling. It's clear that the morning staff is not properly trained or managed. The constant mistakes and rude behavior have driven me away for good. I've taken my business elsewhere and will make sure to share my horrific experiences with friends, family, and online platforms. The location desperately needs a overhaul of their staff and customer service policies to improve their reputation and retain customers. Until then, I strongly advise others to avoid this location at all costs.

I have to say, my experience at this establishment was a mixed bag, to put it mildly. The room, as I mentioned, was fantastic - the modern decor, the gorgeous glass accents, and that incredible patio all combined to create a truly exceptional ambiance. But, unfortunately, the rest of my visit didn't quite live up to the same standards. The food, while not bad by any means, was just so... average. I mean, who serves water chestnuts wrapped in bacon with a side of straight-up honey? It's just not impressive. And don't even get me started on the service - our server seemed more interested in flirting with the other staff members than actually attending to our needs. But, I will give them credit where credit is due: those martinis were expertly crafted, even if they were a bit on the full side. All in all, I'd say my visit averaged out to about 3 stars, which is a shame, because with a bit more attention to detail and some better training for the staff, this place could really be something special.

As the show progressed, we found ourselves giggling at the over-the-top antics and cheesy one-liners. The crowd around us was fully immersed, cheering and clapping along to Rick's every word. But my friend and I were having a different experience, analyzing every trick and illusion, trying to figure out the method behind the magic. It was almost like a fun challenge, seeing if we could debunk his claims before he even finished speaking. Despite the initial skepticism, I have to admit that Rick's energy is infectious, and by the end of the show, even we were caught up in the excitement. The VIP tickets, which included a meet-and-greet and photo opportunity, were a nice touch, although, as I mentioned earlier, the photo itself is still a bit cringeworthy. All in all, if you're looking for a lighthearted, entertaining evening that's fun for the whole family, Rick's show might be worth checking out – just don't expect to be blown away by groundbreaking magic or profound philosophy.

As I sat down at my table, I couldn't help but feel like a VIP, with the attentive staff catering to my every need. The menu is extensive, with a wide range of options to suit every taste and craving. I opted for the sushi, and let me tell you, it was some of the freshest and most delicious I've ever had. The presentation was also top-notch, with each dish carefully crafted to be almost too beautiful to eat. Almost. The atmosphere is electric, with a constant buzz of excitement and energy emanating from the crowd. Whether you're looking for a romantic evening out or a night on the town with friends, Tao has something for everyone. And don't even get me started on the people-watching - it's like a never-ending parade of interesting and fashionable individuals. Overall, I would highly recommend Tao to anyone looking for a unique and unforgettable dining experience in Las Vegas. Just be prepared for the hefty price tag, but trust me, it's worth every penny. With its impeccable service, stunning atmosphere, and mouth-watering cuisine, Tao is a must-visit destination for anyone looking to live it up in Sin City.

The atmosphere is modern and sleek, with a vibrant energy that complements the bold flavors of the dishes. Our server was knowledgeable and attentive, happy to answer questions about the menu and make recommendations. The prices were reasonable, especially considering the high quality of the ingredients and the care that clearly goes into preparing each dish. Overall, I'm so glad I stumbled upon this hidden gem and I'll definitely be back to try more of the innovative Spanish-inspired cuisine. With its unique flavor profile, excellent service, and extensive tequila selection, this restaurant is a must-visit for anyone looking to shake up their dining routine in Phoenix.

Overall, I'm glad we stumbled upon this hidden gem, thanks to the Yelp reviews. The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, making it a perfect spot to catch up with my friend. The prices were reasonable, and the portion sizes were just right. I would definitely recommend this place to others and look forward to trying more of their menu items in the future, especially if they have that balsamic dressing available for sale.

The combination of flavors and textures was absolute perfection. The spicy kick from the tuna paired beautifully with the sweetness of the salmon, all tied together by the tangy garlic ponzu. It was a truly unforgettable dish that left me wanting more. Despite the unusual music choice, our dining experience was exceptional, and we can't wait to return to Sumo and try more of their creative sushi rolls.

The service was also subpar, with our server seeming uninterested in our table. The overall atmosphere was lacking, making the experience even more disappointing. For the prices they were charging, I expected much better quality and service. Unfortunately, this place did not meet my expectations in any way, and I would not recommend it to anyone. The fact that we opted to buy groceries instead of finishing our meals speaks volumes about the poor quality of the food and drinks.

I was really looking forward to a fun night out with my friends, but the experience at Marquee was a major letdown. The crowd was not what I expected, and the constant pressure to buy a table and drinks was overwhelming. It felt like the bouncers were more interested in making a sale than in ensuring that we had a good time. The fact that they kept trying to seat us with older men or guys who seemed out of place was just weird and uncomfortable. 

We decided to leave early, which is unheard of for me in Vegas, and I wouldn't recommend Marquee to anyone who's looking for a genuine party experience. The stairs were also a major turn-off, and I can see why some people might feel uncomfortable or even unsafe walking up them alone. Overall, I think Marquee is a club that's more focused on its luxurious decor and making a profit than on providing a fun and welcoming atmosphere for its patrons. Unless they make some changes, I wouldn't waste my time or money on this club again.

As I look back, Macayo's was more than just a restaurant to me - it was a staple of my childhood, a place where family gatherings and celebrations were commonplace. The familiarity of their menu and the warmth of their staff, despite the gaudy uniforms, evoke a sense of nostalgia that's hard to shake off. While the food may not be authentic Mexican cuisine, it's a unique blend of flavors that has become synonymous with Vegas-style Mexican food. The TCT remains a guilty pleasure, and I often find myself driving out of my way to satisfy the occasional craving. Macayo's may not be the most sophisticated dining experience, but its nostalgic charm and comforting dishes have earned it a special place in my heart, and I'm sure, in the hearts of many other Vegas natives. It's a testament to the power of food to evoke emotions and create lasting memories.

Overall, I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of the haircut, especially given the affordable price. The lady who cut my hair seemed experienced and confident in her work, which made me feel at ease. The fade was even and well-defined, and she took just the right amount of hair off the top. I appreciated that she didn't try to make small talk or upsell me on any additional services, she just got the job done quickly and efficiently.

Despite the initial confusion when I first arrived, I would still recommend this place to others who need a quick and simple military-style haircut. Just be aware that you might not get much communication about wait times or what to expect, so it's best to plan accordingly. If I were to come back, I would definitely ask for the same stylist, as she did a great job and seemed to know what she was doing. With a little improvement in customer communication, this place could easily earn a full 5 stars from me. For now, I'm happy with the value and quality I received, and I would come back if I need another quick trim in the future.

The ambiance was chaotic and overwhelming. I was expecting a cozy pizza spot, but instead, it felt like a noisy nightclub. The prices were outrageous, especially considering the unusual pizza options. I left feeling disappointed and frustrated, definitely not planning to return. The server's attitude was the final nail in the coffin, making me wonder how a place like this stays in business. Needless to say, I won't be recommending this overhyped, overpriced spot to anyone.

The service was also top-notch, with friendly staff and quick turnaround. Overall, I'm glad we took a chance on Rock-n-Roll fingers, and I highly recommend it to anyone craving delicious, high-quality chicken strips. We'll definitely be back for more of their mouthwatering food.

The atmosphere was cozy and inviting, perfect for a snowy evening. Our server was friendly and attentive, ensuring our glasses were always full. The pub's decor added to the authentic Irish experience, with dark wood and lively music. Although the portions could be larger, the quality of the food made up for it. Overall, I'd definitely recommend this pub to anyone looking for a delicious pint and tasty pub fare. We'll be back, and I'm already looking forward to trying more of their menu offerings.

Overall, it's a nostalgic spot that hasn't kept up with the times. The atmosphere feels outdated, and the service, although friendly, is slow and inattentive to table maintenance. While the sweet tea is a highlight, the reheated food and lackluster dining experience make it unlikely I'll return or recommend it to others anytime soon.

I was really looking forward to exploring every nook and cranny, but unfortunately, the overpowering scents cut my visit short. The store's potential is immense, with its unique and carefully selected items, but the fragrance issue is a major deterrent. I would highly recommend this store to anyone who can tolerate strong smells, but for those with sensitivities, it's best to proceed with caution. Perhaps the owners could consider alternative fragrance options or scent-free days to accommodate customers with allergies or asthma, allowing them to fully appreciate the store's incredible inventory and curated selection.

I was thoroughly impressed with the overall experience and can't wait to go back. The combination of delicious food, extensive beer options, and welcoming atmosphere makes it a standout destination. Whether you're a beer connoisseur or just looking for a casual spot to grab a bite, this place has something for everyone. The happy hour specials and free tastings are a great bonus, and the staff's passion for beer is evident in their knowledgeable and enthusiastic service. Overall, it's a must-visit for anyone in the area, and I'm already planning my next trip back to try more of their amazing sandwiches and beers.

Overall, my experience at Jack in the Box was underwhelming. The food was mediocre and the service was subpar. While I appreciate the variety of options on the menu, it felt like they were trying to do too much and not excelling at any one thing. The lack of enthusiasm from the staff was also a turn-off. For a fast food joint, you'd think they'd prioritize efficiency and friendliness, but that wasn't the case here. Unless they revamp their service and focus on perfecting a few key items, I just don't see myself returning. There are better fast food options out there, and I'll be sticking to those. Maybe other locations are better, but this one didn't win me over.

Clearly, the establishment is severely understaffed, leading to poor service and food safety issues. The fact that my uncovered food was left waiting to be delivered is alarming. This experience was a complete disappointment, and I would not recommend this place to anyone. The lack of organization and attention to detail is unacceptable, making my decision to never return an easy one.

The problem with Topman, in my opinion, is that it's trying too hard to be trendy and fashionable, but ultimately falls flat. The clothes are not particularly well-made, and the designs are often unoriginal and lacking in creativity. I've seen the same styles and patterns repeated in various forms throughout the store, which makes it feel like they're just churning out generic, mass-market clothing without much thought or effort.

My friends seem to like the store, but I think that's because they're drawn in by the trendy branding and the promise of being fashionable. However, when you actually look at the clothes and consider the prices, it's hard to justify spending so much money on something that's not particularly special or unique. Overall, I think Topman is a bit of a disappointment, and I would recommend shopping elsewhere for better value and quality. Unless they revamp their designs and pricing, I'll stick to shopping with my friends, but only if they're buying.

The seafood pan roast is a must-try, packed with succulent shrimp, scallops, and mussels. Service is always friendly and attentive, despite the chaos during peak hours. Be prepared for a wait, but trust me, it's worth it for this hidden gem's mouth-watering dishes and unique atmosphere that will keep you coming back for more.

The atmosphere at Harold's is undeniably laid-back and welcoming, making it an excellent spot to unwind with friends or catch a game. The live band adds a lively touch, playing a mix of classic rock and country tunes that gets the crowd singing along. While the bar menu may not be fancy, it's hearty and satisfying, with plenty of options to pair with your favorite beer. I've tried their burgers and wings, and both were cooked to perfection. The staff is also friendly and attentive, always happy to refill your drink or offer recommendations. One thing to note is that the patio can get a bit smoky, as mentioned earlier, but it's a small trade-off for the overall experience. Overall, Harold's is a great spot for those looking for a casual, no-frills good time, and I'll definitely be back to enjoy another sunset and some live music.

We will definitely return, highly recommending Arrivederci to friends and family for its exceptional cuisine and warm atmosphere, making it a perfect spot for special occasions and everyday dining alike, with great prices too.

As I walked around the store, I noticed that the shelves were well-stocked and the aisles were clean, which is more than I can say for some of the other retail stores I've visited recently. The furniture pick-up area was also well-organized, and my friend was able to quickly and easily collect her purchases. I was impressed by the efficiency of the process, and the staff member who assisted her was friendly and helpful.

One thing that did strike me as a bit odd was the layout of the store. It seemed like some of the departments were tucked away in corners or down long aisles, which made it a bit difficult to navigate. However, this wasn't a major issue, and I was able to find everything I needed without too much trouble.

Overall, my experience at this Walmart was pleasant and uneventful, which is exactly what I'm looking for in a shopping trip. I wouldn't hesitate to return if I needed to, and I appreciate the convenience of having a McDonald's and self-checkout lanes on site. While I understand that Walmart may not be everyone's favorite retailer, I think it's unfair to judge the store or its customers based on preconceived notions or stereotypes. This location, at least, seemed like a friendly and welcoming place to shop.

The service was friendly and attentive, making our overall experience pleasant. Prices were reasonable, considering the convenience of being located within Bass Pro. While the food wasn't exceptional, it was satisfying enough to fuel our shopping trip. If I were to return, I'd be curious to explore their dinner options and see if they offer anything more impressive. Overall, it's a decent choice if you're looking for a bite to eat while visiting Bass Pro.

The service was attentive and friendly, which somewhat made up for the disappointing food. However, the quality of the breakfast dishes was a major letdown. For a cafe with such high ratings, I expected more flavorful and well-prepared meals. Unfortunately, my experience was subpar, and I wouldn't recommend their breakfast options to others. Perhaps they excel in other areas, but for now, I'll have to give them an average rating, solely thanks to the pleasant staff who tried to make my visit more enjoyable despite the lackluster food. Overall, a mediocre experience.

Overall, my experience was underwhelming and overpriced. The chicken sandwich, although cooked well, lacked any distinct flavor profile. The onion rings were crispy but unremarkable. For the cost, I expected a more satisfying meal. The friendly service was a redeeming quality, but not enough to justify the premium pricing. Unless they revamp their menu or pricing strategy, I'll be taking my lunch business elsewhere. There are simply too many other options that offer better value and flavor, making it unlikely for me to return to this establishment in the near future.
Staff seemed completely unbothered, no apology or explanation offered, making the whole experience even more frustrating and disappointing.

As we waited for our food, I couldn't help but notice the stark contrast between the website's promises and the actual dining experience. The "striking murals" of Farhad Elahi were nowhere to be found in our section of the restaurant, and the "plush seating" was replaced with standard, unremarkable tables and chairs. The ambiance, or lack thereof, was only the beginning of our disappointing evening. The food, which we had been looking forward to all day, was a major letdown. The mulagatani soup, as I mentioned earlier, was flavorless and uninspiring, and the other dishes we ordered were not much better. The Pakistani-style dishes, which I had been excited to try, were boring and lacking in both flavor and heat.

The service, unfortunately, was not much better. Our server seemed overwhelmed and inattentive, and it took an inordinate amount of time to get our food and drinks. Considering it was Valentine's Day, I had expected a more romantic and attentive experience, but sadly, that was not the case. As we finished our meal and prepared to leave, I couldn't help but feel disappointed and frustrated with the entire experience. The high prices and pretentious atmosphere only added to my dissatisfaction, and I left feeling like I had been duped by the restaurant's misleading website and promises of a "hipster hangout." Overall, I would not recommend this restaurant to anyone looking for a romantic or authentic dining experience, and I will not be returning anytime soon.

As I reflect on my experience at OTB, I'm still trying to process how a place that showed such promise on my 21st birthday could fall so short on a subsequent visit. The special martini they crafted for me was a lovely touch, and I had high hopes that the $5 burger deal would be a great way to spend a casual evening with friends. Unfortunately, the subpar service, questionable food quality, and unprofessional behavior of the kitchen staff left a sour taste in my mouth.

The fact that our server seemed overwhelmed and unable to attend to our needs was frustrating, but I tried to be understanding given the unique setup of the restaurant. However, when I took a bite of my burger and was met with a charred, grayish-brown patty, I knew something was seriously amiss. The combination of toppings, which sounded intriguing on the menu, was overshadowed by the unpleasant texture and flavor of the overcooked meat.

What really took the cake, though, was the smell of marijuana wafting from the kitchen. It's unacceptable for any establishment to allow employees to engage in such behavior on the job, let alone in a kitchen where food is being prepared. The fact that this smell was able to permeate the entire back area and make its way to our table is a clear indication of a lack of supervision and regard for customer comfort.

The aftermath of our meal was even more disturbing, as several members of our party experienced stomach pains and discomfort after consuming the burgers. While I can only speculate about the cause, it's certainly possible that the restaurant is trying to move old or spoiled product by offering it at a discounted price. This is a serious concern, and one that I hope the management will take seriously.

In the end, my curiosity about OTB's unique burger offerings has been thoroughly extinguished. While I appreciate the creativity of their menu, it's not enough to outweigh the numerous issues we encountered during our visit. Until the restaurant addresses its problems with service, food quality, and kitchen professionalism, I would advise others to steer clear. There are plenty of other establishments in the area that offer delicious, safely prepared food in a comfortable and respectful environment. OTB, unfortunately, is not one of them.

"The service was also subpar, our server seemed overwhelmed. For a Christmas buffet, the quality and variety were lacking. Given the high prices, we expected much more. Overall, a disappointing experience, especially considering the long wait times and limited seating. Definitely not worth the hassle or cost, especially for a special occasion like Christmas."

I'm extremely disappointed in the decline of service quality at this Gruelich's location. The constant push for unnecessary repairs has become overwhelming, and it's clear that their priority is no longer the customer's satisfaction, but rather their own profit. The fact that they didn't even bother to check their computer records before recommending the transmission flush is not only unprofessional, but also a clear indication of their dishonest intentions. As a loyal customer for over 15 years, it's disheartening to see such a drastic change in their business practices. I've always appreciated the convenience of having a trustworthy mechanic nearby, but unfortunately, I can no longer recommend this location to anyone. The lack of transparency and integrity has led me to take my business elsewhere, and I hope that others will do the same. It's time for Gruelich's to re-evaluate their priorities and focus on providing honest, quality service to their customers. Until then, I'll be taking my cars (and my business) to a more reputable mechanic.

I was thoroughly impressed with the overall experience at Rick's shop. The staff were friendly and knowledgeable, and the tour was well-organized and informative. Meeting Rick himself was the highlight of the visit, and he was more than happy to take photos and sign autographs. What struck me was how down-to-earth and genuine he was, taking the time to chat with each person and make them feel welcome. The shop itself was also impressive, with a wide range of interesting items on display. Compared to the other shops I visited, Rick's stood out for its warm and welcoming atmosphere. I would highly recommend a visit to anyone who is a fan of the show or just looking for a unique experience. The fact that Rick and other stars of the show are often onsite makes it a must-visit destination. Overall, I would give Rick's shop a well-deserved 5 stars, and I look forward to visiting again in the future.

The ambiance was cozy and intimate, perfect for a night out with someone special. The tapas dishes were creatively prepared and presented, with generous portions that allowed us to try a variety of flavors. While not every dish blew me away, the overall experience was enjoyable and the prices were reasonable. I appreciated the wait staff's knowledge and enthusiasm for the wine list, which added to the evening's charm. Overall, I would recommend Pullman to anyone looking for a relaxed, wine-focused dining experience with a touch of elegance. It's a great spot to unwind and savor good food and wine.

As I finally emerged from the labyrinthine entrance, I couldn't help but feel a sense of accomplishment, as if I had just completed an obstacle course. The fact that I had to navigate through a maze of temporary corridors and stairways just to reach the main concourse was not only frustrating but also exhausting. And to make matters worse, the signage throughout the station was inadequate, to say the least. I saw several people, including tourists and commuters alike, looking around confused, trying to make sense of the convoluted layout.

I decided to take a deep breath and approach one of the station staff to ask for directions to platform 1. The poor soul looked just as frazzled as I did, and I could sense her frustration as she tried to explain the complex route to me. It was clear that even the staff were struggling to navigate the temporary layout. I felt a pang of sympathy for her, having to deal with irate commuters like myself all day.

As I finally made my way to platform 1, I couldn't help but notice the state of the station. The building works had left the area looking like a construction site, with scaffolding and temporary walls blocking off large sections of the concourse. The noise level was deafening, with drills and hammers ringing out throughout the station. It was clear that the renovation was a much-needed one, but the execution was leaving much to be desired.

I took a seat on the platform and waited for my train, observing the other commuters around me. Some were typing away on their laptops, while others were scrolling through their phones, trying to distract themselves from the chaos around them. I struck up a conversation with a fellow commuter, and we commiserated about the state of the station. It was clear that we were not alone in our frustration.

As the train arrived and we boarded, I felt a sense of relief wash over me. I was finally leaving the chaos of Waverley Train station behind, at least for a little while. But as I looked out the window and watched the station recede into the distance, I couldn't help but feel a sense of dread. I knew that I would have to navigate that labyrinthine entrance again on my return journey, and I wasn't looking forward to it.

In conclusion, my experience at Waverley Train station was a frustrating and exhausting one. The temporary layout, combined with the inadequate signage and confusing directions, made for a stressful and overwhelming experience. While I understand that the renovation is necessary, I implore the station management to take steps to improve the navigation and signage throughout the station. Perhaps a more comprehensive map or clearer directions would help to alleviate some of the frustration. Until then, I'll just have to grit my teeth and prepare for the challenge that is Waverley Train station.

As I settled into my seat and the train pulled out of the station, I couldn't help but wonder what other commuters had experienced at Waverley Train station. Had they too struggled to navigate the temporary layout? Had they also felt the frustration and exhaustion that I had? I decided to take to social media to share my experience and see if others had similar stories to tell. And as I scrolled through the comments and messages, I realized that I was not alone. Many others had shared my frustration, and some had even worse stories to tell. It was clear that Waverley Train station was a source of stress and anxiety for many commuters, and it was time for something to be done about it.

Prices were reasonable, service was friendly, but not overly attentive. The burger truly stood out, juicy and flavorful, making it a highlight of the meal. Overall, a solid choice, but not exceptional enough to warrant frequent visits, hence the moderate priority for return trips.

to grab a quick bite or fill up on gas, as the overall experience was pleasant and convenient, making it a great stop for travelers and locals alike, with its well-maintained facilities and ample options.

As I sat there, disappointed and frustrated, I couldn't help but think that this place had fallen short of my expectations. The atmosphere, which had initially impressed me, now felt like a facade, a distraction from the subpar food and service. The huge assortment of options, which had seemed like a strength, now seemed like a weakness, a sign that the kitchen was spread too thin and unable to deliver on quality.

I've been to several other pastry places that have gotten it right, where the pastries are kept warm in the oven and served hot, fresh, and delicious. Those places may not have as many options, but what they do offer is made with care and attention to detail. It's clear that quality control is a priority, and it shows in every bite.

In contrast, this place seemed to be prioritizing quantity over quality, and it showed in the cold, soggy mess that was served to us. The staff's lack of concern and half-hearted offer to heat it up only added to our disappointment. We left feeling let down and unlikely to return, which is a shame, because with a bit more attention to quality control, this place could be truly great.

The value for the price was definitely a highlight of our experience. The soup and salad were standard, but the entree was cooked well and presented nicely. The dessert was also a pleasant surprise, with a decent selection to choose from. Our server, as I mentioned, was friendly and attentive, but the delay in receiving our food was noticeable. Despite the initial disappointment with the singing waiters, the overall atmosphere was lively and enjoyable. The decor was quaint and added to the charm of the restaurant. However, the food and entertainment didn't quite live up to our expectations. Overall, it was an average dining experience, but the set meal deal made it a decent value. If you're looking for a affordable and casual meal on the strip, this might be a good option, but don't go in with high hopes for exceptional food or entertainment.

We left feeling underwhelmed and not impressed by the quality of food. The service was friendly, but that wasn't enough to make up for the lackluster dishes. Given the numerous exceptional restaurants in Las Vegas, it's hard to recommend this place when there are better options available. Overall, our comped meal was a nice gesture, but not enough to win us over as paying customers in the future.

The service was also subpar, with our server seeming overwhelmed and inattentive. It took a while to get our orders taken and even longer to get the check. For the price, I expected a lot more quality and attention to detail. Unfortunately, this place failed to deliver on both counts. The atmosphere was nice, but that's not enough to make up for the lackluster food and service. Overall, I would not recommend this place to anyone, especially for the price they're charging. There are far better options available for Sunday brunch.

Unprofessional and uninformative experience overall, putting my son's skin health at risk. We will be taking our business elsewhere to ensure proper care and attention to detail. Very disappointed in the lack of transparency and poor communication from the PA.

As a parent, it was disappointing to see the amount of smoking allowed in the casino area, and the smell of smoke often wafted into the non-smoking areas, including the elevators and hallways. I understand that casinos and smoking often go hand-in-hand, but it would be nice to see Aria take steps to better contain the smoke or provide more non-smoking areas.

Despite this, our stay at Aria was overall very enjoyable. The staff was friendly and helpful, and the hotel's modern amenities and technology were impressive. The room was clean and comfortable, and the kids loved the high-tech controls and the large TV. The location was also convenient, with many restaurants and shops within walking distance.

One of the highlights of our stay was the buffet at Aria. While we didn't have a chance to try many of the other restaurants, the buffet was excellent, with a wide variety of options and high-quality food. The kids especially loved the dessert section, which featured a wide range of sweet treats.

In addition to the buffet, we also enjoyed the hotel's pool area, which was clean and well-maintained. The kids had a blast swimming and playing in the water, and the adults appreciated the comfortable lounge chairs and umbrellas.

Overall, I would recommend Aria to anyone looking for a modern and convenient hotel in the heart of Las Vegas. While the smoking in the casino was a drawback, the hotel's many amenities and excellent service made up for it. With a few tweaks to their smoking policy, I would have no hesitation in giving Aria a full 5-star rating.

It's worth noting that Aria is a large hotel, and it can take some time to get from one place to another. However, the hotel provides a convenient tram service to help guests get around, and the staff is always happy to provide directions or assistance.

In conclusion, our stay at Aria was a great experience, and I would definitely consider staying here again in the future. The hotel's modern amenities, convenient location, and excellent service make it a great choice for anyone looking for a comfortable and enjoyable stay in Las Vegas.

The lack of attention to detail and subpar cuisine was shocking, especially given the chef's reputation. For a restaurant of this caliber, the mistakes were inexcusable. The atmosphere, although elegant, couldn't compensate for the poor food and service. It's clear that the Las Vegas location is resting on the coattails of its NYC counterpart. With so many exceptional dining options in Las Vegas, it's hard to recommend Charlie Palmer. Unless significant changes are made, I'd advise others to explore alternative restaurants that can deliver on both flavor and service. Sadly, this experience was a letdown.

As I reflect on our experience, I'm reminded that the high price point during regular hours is a major deterrent for me. The fact that we were able to get such a good deal during happy hour was a blessing, but I couldn't justify paying full price for the quality of food we received. Perhaps the restaurant is trying to cater to a specific crowd that is willing to pay a premium for the trendy atmosphere, but for a foodie like myself, it's just not worth it.

The more I think about it, the more I realize that the atmosphere, although cool and trendy, feels somewhat superficial. The dark red lighting, while chic, seems like a attempt to distract from the lackluster decor and ambiance in other areas of the restaurant. It's almost as if they're trying to create a certain vibe, but it doesn't feel entirely genuine.

In terms of the food, I was disappointed by the lack of creativity and flavor in the dishes we tried. The sushi, as I mentioned earlier, was a letdown, and the other items on the menu were hit or miss. The calamari and tofu were standouts, but everything else was forgettable. It's possible that the kitchen is still working out some kinks, but based on our experience, I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone looking for a memorable dining experience.

The service, as I mentioned earlier, was mediocre at best. Our waiter was friendly and attentive, but the hostess and other staff members seemed completely uninterested in providing good customer service. It's disappointing, because a little bit of friendliness and hospitality can go a long way in making a customer feel welcome and valued.

Overall, I would say that this restaurant is a great spot for people who are looking for a trendy place to grab drinks and take some Instagram-worthy photos. However, if you're a foodie like myself, or if you're looking for a restaurant that serves high-quality sushi, you might want to look elsewhere. There are plenty of other restaurants in the area that offer better food, better service, and a more authentic atmosphere.

As I finish writing this review, I'm left with a sense of indifference. I don't feel strongly about this restaurant one way or the other, which is perhaps the most telling sign of all. It's not a place that I would actively recommend to friends or family, but it's also not a place that I would warn people to avoid. It simply exists, a mediocre establishment that fails to leave a lasting impression. And for that reason, I don't think I'll be returning anytime soon.

Overall, my experiences at this BRU have been consistently positive, and I appreciate the knowledge and assistance provided by the staff. The store's layout makes it easy to navigate, even with a toddler in tow. I've never had to wait long for help or checkout, which is a plus for busy parents. While the newer location on North 5th may have a more modern aesthetic, this store's warmth and personalized service keep me coming back. I highly recommend it to expecting and new parents in the area. The staff truly make the shopping experience exceptional.

Overall, my experience was lackluster due to the subpar food, but the exceptional pies and outstanding service from Kelly made it somewhat redeeming. The pies are truly a masterpiece, with each flavor more delicious than the last. Kelly's exceptional service skills and friendly demeanor made our visit enjoyable, despite the mediocre food. It's a shame the restaurant doesn't live up to the high standards set by their baked goods and certain staff members. With some improvements to their menu, this establishment could reach its full potential, but for now, it's the pies and Kelly that make it worth visiting.

The fact that we've been coming here every week and have grown accustomed to the mediocre service and food makes this experience even more disappointing. It's clear that the staff is overwhelmed and understaffed, which is no excuse for the subpar food and service. As a regular customer, it's disheartening to see the decline in quality and service. The waiter, who seems to be shouldering the entire workload, deserves better support and resources to provide a decent dining experience. It's not too much to ask for hot, cooked food and attentive service, especially when there are only a handful of tables to attend to. The lack of attention to detail and care in preparing our meals is appalling, and it's a wonder that this location hasn't been shut down yet. Unless some serious changes are made, including adequate staffing and quality control, it's unlikely that we'll be returning to this IHOP again.

Overall, I'm satisfied with my experience at this Hallmark location. The store was well-organized and easy to navigate, making it simple to find what I needed. Although the staff could be more attentive, the one who helped me was friendly and courteous. I appreciate the wide range of products they offer, from unique ornaments to thoughtful cards. Despite the minor issue with staff attention, I'll still return next year for my holiday shopping needs. The convenience and selection keep me coming back, even if the prices can add up quickly, as my $60 spend can attest.

As I reflect on my experience at é, I am still in awe of the culinary mastery that Chef José Andrés and his team have achieved. The attention to detail, the creativity, and the sheer artistry that goes into each dish is truly remarkable. From the amuse-bouche to the final mignardise, every bite was a testament to the chef's innovative spirit and commitment to using only the freshest, highest-quality ingredients.

One of the things that struck me most about é was the sense of community that pervades the dining room. Despite being seated with strangers, the warm and welcoming atmosphere, coupled with the interactive nature of the meal, quickly broke down any barriers and created a sense of camaraderie among the guests. It was fascinating to watch the other diners react to each new dish, and to share in their delight and surprise as the meal progressed.

The service, as I mentioned earlier, was impeccable. Our server was knowledgeable, attentive, and passionate about the food, and took the time to explain each dish and answer our questions. The chefs, too, were friendly and engaging, happy to chat with us about their creations and share their inspiration behind each dish.

As for the price, I must say that I was initially hesitant about the cost of the meal. However, as the evening wore on and I experienced the sheer magnitude of the culinary expertise on display, I began to see the value in what we were being offered. This was not just a meal, but an immersive experience that combined food, art, and entertainment in a way that was both unique and unforgettable.

In terms of criticisms, I would say that the only potential drawback to é is the unpredictability of the seating arrangements. As I mentioned earlier, I was seated on the end of the table and spent a fair amount of time watching the chefs, which, while fascinating, did make it difficult to fully engage with my fellow diners. However, this is a minor quibble, and one that I would gladly endure again in order to experience the magic of é.

In conclusion, my meal at é was a truly unforgettable experience that has left an indelible mark on my culinary psyche. The combination of creative, expertly prepared food, exceptional service, and unique, interactive atmosphere makes é a must-visit destination for anyone who loves food, art, and entertainment. Whether you are a seasoned gourmet or just looking to try something new and exciting, é is an experience that is sure to delight and inspire. I, for one, cannot wait to return and experience it all again.
I highly recommend it to anyone craving authentic Vietnamese flavors, the prices were reasonable and the service was friendly, making it a must-visit spot for a delicious and satisfying meal.

As I sit here reminiscing about Beto's, my stomach is growling with anticipation. The combination of textures and flavors is truly unique and has yet to be replicated by any other pizzeria. I've tried to explain the magic of Beto's to friends and family who haven't had the pleasure, but it's one of those experiences that needs to be tasted to be believed. The simplicity of the ingredients belies the complexity of the flavors, and the care with which each slice is prepared is evident in every bite. Whether you're a lifelong fan like me or just discovering Beto's for the first time, this Pittsburgh institution is sure to leave a lasting impression. So, if you ever find yourself in the area, do yourself a favor and stop by Beto's for a slice (or two, or three...) - your taste buds will thank you, and you might just create some memories of your own.

To make matters worse, the entire process of selecting and purchasing the cable boxes was a tedious and inefficient one. The sales representative seemed to be lacking in knowledge about the products they were selling, and I had to ask multiple times for clarification on the different options available. It was clear that they were not well-versed in the technical aspects of the boxes, and I was starting to lose patience.

As I was finally about to complete my purchase, I noticed that the representative was not offering me any additional services or promotions that might be relevant to my grandmother's needs. I had to specifically ask about any discounts or bundles that might be available, and even then, the representative seemed hesitant to provide me with the information. It was as if they were not incentivized to upsell or provide additional value to customers, which is a major missed opportunity.

The lack of attention to detail and customer care was evident throughout my entire experience. From the initial check-in process to the final purchase, I felt like I was just another number in a long line of customers. The representatives seemed overwhelmed and undertrained, and it showed in the way they interacted with me and the other customers.

The fact that one of the boxes I purchased is faulty is just the cherry on top of a disappointing experience. I will have to return to the store, which will undoubtedly be another frustrating and time-consuming ordeal. I can only hope that the return process will be smoother and more efficient than the initial purchase, but based on my experience so far, I am not holding my breath.

In conclusion, my visit to this store was a disaster from start to finish. The long wait times, confusing check-in process, and lack of trained representatives made for a frustrating and disappointing experience. The fact that they were not equipped to handle customers with disabilities is a major concern, and the lack of attention to detail and customer care is unacceptable. Unless this store undergoes significant changes to its operations and customer service, I would not recommend it to anyone.

Overall, my stay at this Hilton property was enjoyable, and I appreciated the cleanliness and comfort of the room. The bed was extremely comfortable, and the amenities provided were sufficient for my needs. However, I do think that the hotel could improve in a few areas, particularly with regards to the parking garage and the checkout time. As I mentioned earlier, the walk from the garage to the hotel was quite uncomfortable due to the heat, and I think an enclosed and air-conditioned walkway would make a big difference. Additionally, the early checkout time of 10 am seems unreasonable, especially on a Sunday morning in a city like Las Vegas where people often stay out late. Despite these minor complaints, I would still recommend this hotel to others, especially those who have access to a car and don't mind the location. The staff were friendly and helpful, and the hotel's amenities were on par with what I've come to expect from the Hilton brand. With a few tweaks to address these issues, I think this hotel could truly excel and provide an even better experience for its guests.

The serene atmosphere and attentive staff made my experience truly unforgettable. Every detail was carefully considered to ensure my comfort and relaxation. I left feeling refreshed, renewed, and already looking forward to my next visit. The combination of skilled therapists and tranquil surroundings makes this spa a must-visit destination for anyone seeking a luxurious escape.

The atmosphere of the shop is also worth mentioning, as it's modern, sleek, and incredibly welcoming. The staff is friendly and knowledgeable, happy to answer any questions you may have about their unique flavor combinations or help you create your perfect treat. I was impressed by the efficiency of the service, even on a busy day, as the line moved quickly and orders were fulfilled with a smile.

What truly sets Oh Yeah apart, though, is the passion and creativity that goes into every aspect of their business. From the carefully crafted flavor profiles to the presentation of each dessert, it's clear that the team is dedicated to providing an exceptional experience for every customer. Whether you're a longtime ice cream lover or just looking to try something new, Oh Yeah is a must-visit destination that is sure to delight and inspire.

I've already started thinking about my next visit and which incredible combination I'll try next. Perhaps a sundae with their famous freshly made waffle, or a coffee-infused milkshake to start my day off right. Whatever I choose, I know it will be a treat that I'll savor and enjoy, and that's what makes Oh Yeah a true gem in the world of ice cream shops. With its unbeatable selection, welcoming atmosphere, and commitment to quality, Oh Yeah has earned a loyal customer in me, and I'm excited to see what the future holds for this innovative and exciting shop.

The lack of attention to basic dining ambiance, such as adequate lighting, was astonishing. It's not as if I was asking for elaborate decorations or excessive illumination, just enough to be able to see my food and enjoy my meal. The fact that the manager had already left for the day and couldn't be bothered to ensure a comfortable dining experience for the remaining patrons was disappointing. The food, although tasty, was not enough to redeem the overall experience. I was looking forward to trying this place, but the combination of poor service, bland salsa, and inadequate lighting made for a lackluster visit. As a paying customer, I expect a certain level of quality and attention to detail, which this restaurant failed to provide. Needless to say, I will not be returning and would not recommend it to others. The potential for a great dining experience was there, but it was ultimately squandered by poor management and inattention to customer needs. With so many other excellent dining options in Tempe, it's unlikely that I will give this place another chance.

As we finished our meal, I couldn't help but feel a sense of disappointment and disillusionment. The prices were not cheap, and for what we paid, I expected a lot more in terms of quality and flavor. The atmosphere was pleasant, but it wasn't enough to make up for the subpar food. I started to think that maybe I was just being too harsh, that maybe my expectations were too high. But then I looked over at my friend, who was equally unimpressed, and I knew that I wasn't just being picky.

We decided to skip dessert, not because we were full, but because we just didn't want to give them any more of our money. As we left, I noticed that the place was still bustling with people, and I wondered if we had just caught them on a bad day. But then I saw the reviews on my phone, and it seemed that we were not alone in our disappointment. Many people had similar complaints about the food being bland and overpriced.

I think what really got me was that this place had so much potential. The menu read like a love letter to classic deli cuisine, and the photos looked amazing. But it seems that they are more focused on presentation than actual flavor and quality. It's a shame, because with a little more attention to detail and a lot more flavor, this place could be a real gem.

As we walked out, my friend turned to me and said, "You know, I think I'm going to start a petition to bring back Foxy's and Jackie's." I laughed, but deep down, I knew exactly what she meant. There's just something about a good deli that can't be replicated, and Weiss unfortunately falls short. Unless they seriously revamp their menu and cooking techniques, I wouldn't recommend this place to anyone. And as for me, I'll just have to keep searching for that perfect cabbage soup and brisket sandwich. Maybe someday I'll find a place that lives up to my expectations, but until then, I'll just have to keep dreaming of the good old days at Foxy's and Jackie's.

I've found that the selection at Monroe Hardware is decent, but not extensive. They carry the basics, such as tools, paint, and gardening supplies, but if you're looking for something more specialized, you might be out of luck. The prices are generally competitive with the bigger chain stores, which is a plus. However, I've noticed that they often have sales and promotions, which can be a good way to save some money.

One thing that I do appreciate about Monroe Hardware is the staff's willingness to help. While they may be spread thin due to the large store size, they are always friendly and knowledgeable when you do manage to track them down. They've been able to answer my questions and offer some helpful advice on more than one occasion.

Overall, I think Monroe Hardware has the potential to be a great local hardware store, but it falls short due to its sprawling layout and limited selection. If they could find a way to make the store feel more cozy and intimate, and perhaps expand their inventory, I think they could give the big chain stores a run for their money. As it stands, it's a convenient option for quick trips, but for bigger projects, I'll still be heading to Home Depot or Lowe's.

Despite the order mishap, I was willing to give them the benefit of the doubt, considering my positive interaction with Jema. However, the incorrect order was a letdown, especially since I was looking forward to a satisfying meal after a long hiatus from Burger King. The "have it your way" slogan seemed like a distant memory as I accepted my modified meal. The Buy 1 Get 1 Free Whopper deal was a great incentive, but the execution fell short. I hope that in the future, they can work on getting orders just right, so customers can truly enjoy their meals. For now, I'll take this experience as a one-off and might consider giving them another chance to redeem themselves. Perhaps with a little more attention to detail, this Burger King location can live up to its promise.

The food itself was mediocre at best, with overcooked dishes and lackluster presentation. For the prices they're charging, you'd expect a much higher quality of cuisine. The atmosphere was also uninviting, with a dated decor that seemed to be crying out for a renovation. It's clear that this establishment is prioritizing profits over people, and it's a shame because with a bit of effort, they could truly thrive. Until they revamp their customer service and menu options, I'd advise others to take their business (and appetite) elsewhere. A disappointing experience overall, and a missed opportunity for a great dining experience in Vegas.

Overall, my experiences have been consistently positive, with the friendly staff and delicious food making up for the unassuming location. The atmosphere is lively and welcoming, making it a great spot to catch a game or meet with friends. With its excellent service, tasty menu options, and inviting ambiance, I highly recommend this hidden gem to anyone looking for a great casual dining experience.
Save your money and find a more reputable and honest mechanic who actually cares about their customers and does the job right the first time, no exceptions or excuses.

The lack of respect and courtesy from the staff is appalling, and it's clear that they are not held to any standards of customer service. I've tried to give them the benefit of the doubt, thinking that maybe it was just a bad day or a new employee, but the consistent rudeness and disregard for customers is staggering. The store itself is well-stocked and convenient, but the horrible customer service far outweighs any benefits. I've started taking my business to other local grocery stores, even if it means driving a bit further, just to avoid the unpleasant experience of shopping at this store. It's disappointing that a company of this size and reputation can't seem to get it together and treat their customers with the respect and courtesy they deserve. I hope that someone in management will take notice and make some changes, but until then, I'll be taking my business (and my family) elsewhere.

Overall, the experience fell short of expectations. With numerous other dining options in Vegas, it's unlikely I'll give them another try, especially when the initial visit was underwhelming and the sushi lacked freshness and flavor, making it a disappointing start to our trip.
